can only imagine more lovely piles of dirt, rocks, and bat droppings.

descKeys: faded, you can't seem to make out the scrawlings on the wall and look very old.
r207.description:
Opening up a bit to the north, the cavern walls are smooth and the ceiling is
low.  There is little of interest around here except for the markings on the
walls.  Illegible and faded, you can't seem to make out the scrawlings on the
wall and look very old.

descKeys: cing at the rocks and stones they seem to have traces of some sort of raw metal.
r208.description:
The path here slopes up a bit making it seem a bit difficult to dig up anything
yet there is evidence that someone is in fact mining here.  The stray rocks and
stones are evidence to that.  Glancing at the rocks and stones they seem to have
traces of some sort of raw metal.

descKeys: tle rock with a chair carved into it sits against the wall, the seat very rough.
r209.description:
The bat rustles his wings and goes to sleep.
The path slopes up toward the northwest and in the other direction continues
east on a level bearing.  A few small piles of rocks here indicate that mining
was going on here at some point.  A little rock with a chair carved into it sits
against the wall, the seat very rough.

descKeys: clears, you are again presented with the tunnel and the choice of left or right.
r210.description:
Through the darkness you make out the sides of the tunnel, and you see that it
leads west and northeast.  Dust in the air irritates your eyes, and rubbing only
makes it worse.  After your sight clears, you are again presented with the
tunnel and the choice of left or right.

descKeys: the reasons. the broken pick-axe here seems to confirm the general idea though.
r211.description:
The tunnel curves around sharply here, heading south-southwest and east.  Pits
in the wall indicate that mining was attempted here, but stopped.  Perhaps the
rock here is too hard, but you can only speculate as to the reasons.  The broken
pick-axe here seems to confirm the general idea though.

descKeys: ound sharply. the dust in the air irritates your nose, almost making you sneeze.
r212.description:
The tunnel is rocky and uneven here, and you have trouble traversing it.  Trying
not to stub your toe on the large rocks lying around the area, you manage to
move about the tunnel a little.  To the west the tunnel seems to curve around
sharply.  The dust in the air irritates your nose, almost making you sneeze.

descKeys: eeching in the tunnel hurts your ears with their shrill cries from time to time.
r213.description:
The tunnel makes a sharp corner here, distinctly dividing the tunnel into two
paths.  The tunnel leads northwest in one direction, and eastward in the other
direction.  The sound of bats screeching in the tunnel hurts your ears with
their shrill cries from time to time.

descKeys: you make a note to come back later with a pick-axe and see what you might find.
r214.description:
Here you can see a small pile of rocks from one of the mining denizens of this
cavern.  Looking at the pile you generally see nothing valuable.  Apparently
whatever the miners here are looking for it is scarce.  You make a note to come
back later with a pick-axe and see what you might find.

descKeys: ar things in life such as very homely women and extremely nasty tasting potions.
r215.description:
The tunnel curves around more, heading generally to the southwest and northern
directions.  The lack of anything here at all makes you appreciate some of the
less spectacular things in life such as very homely women and extremely nasty
tasting potions.

descKeys: look down at the pile of feces glad that you haven't accidentally stepped in it.
r216.description:
The tunnel here slopes up a bit to the northwest and slopes down a bit to the
east.  To the south you still hear faint sounds of pick against rock.  You
notice a pile of feces on the ground, thankfully your feet missed touching it by
a bit.  With much disgust you look down at the pile of feces glad that you
haven't accidentally stepped in it.

descKeys: es with the ladder you might be able to go down it and explore more of the area.
r217.description:
Here the tunnel floor opens up into a small hole through which a ladder leads
down.  The ladder itself seems old and not very sturdy at all.  If you wish to
take your chances with the ladder you might be able to go down it and explore
more of the area.

descKeys: e the miners of the tunnel rest when they aren't being beaten and forced to dig.
r218.description:
Standing next to a seemingly nearly rotten wooden ladder, you see a hole in the
ceiling and two other paths leading north and south.  Some scrawlings on the
wall indicate that this area seems to be where the miners of the tunnel rest
when they aren't being beaten and forced to dig.

descKeys: haps something in the shadows. it could also be your imagination, but who knows?
r219.description:
The tunnel here runs southward to a ladder, westward to what looks to a row of
bunks, and eastward where the walls seem to get smoother.  In the darkness you
think you see shadows moving, or perhaps something in the shadows.  It could
also be your imagination, but who knows?

descKeys: can be seen crawling here and there and you wonder if it's a sign of something.
r220.description:
The tunnel curves around lazily to the northeast, and to the west where it
intersects with another dark passage.  While you seem to smell something nice
coming from the tunnel to the northeast, the other directions could have
nothing but dust and uninteresting things of that nature.  Unusually large
spiders can be seen crawling here and there and you wonder if it's a sign of
something.

descKeys: it seems the inhabitants of this mine are far too busy to take care of the bats.
r221.description:
Curving around nicely and smoothly, the tunnel heads east and southwest.
Blemishing the smoothness of the walls is a small alcove where a miner has
obviously tried to harvest some raw material.  A screetch from bat pierces
through your head, echoing and hurting your ears.  It seems the inhabitants of
this mine are far too busy to take care of the bats.

descKeys: continues to the south, but not to the west where the normal dirty tunnels are.
r222.description:
You see the tunnel is sloped downward from the room to the south to where it
barely rises above your head.  A special looking carpet starts here, and looks
very clean and neat for the use it probably ends up getting.  The carpet
continues to the south, but not to the west where the normal dirty tunnels are.

descKeys: ur body and half again. the carpet here lines the tunnel and is very well-kempt.
r223.description:
The tunnel turns west north of where you are standing and makes a 'T' with
another tunnel to the south.  To the north the tunnel ceiling slopes downward
with little room above your head, but to the south the ceiling is high enough
for the height of your body and half again.  The carpet here lines the tunnel
and is very well-kempt.

descKeys: y them. to the north and south the tunnels turn westward and back into the mine.
r224.description:
The 'T' the two passages make connects them squarely, and east of here the
passage leads to a fancy room.  Someone of relative power must reside here, the
workers of this mine probably ultimately being driven to work by them.  To the
north and south the tunnels turn westward and back into the mine.

descKeys: trace of bat droppings anywhere despite numerous bats inhabiting these tunnels.
r225.description:
The tunnel looks as if it turns west south of here, and makes a 'T' with another
passage north of here.  You stand comfortably with a good amount of room above
your head and a nice carpet under your feet.  There isn't even a trace of bat
droppings anywhere despite numerous bats inhabiting these tunnels.

descKeys: mining. the tunnel looks like it comes to a 't' a small distance north of here.
r226.description:
The tunnel coming from the west turns here, and looks more like a normal
hallway than a rocky tunnel as it runs north.  The carpet lies perfectly flat
and looks like it is kept very clean despite looking a bit worn from being
walked on, aside from the corner of the room where someone has been mining.
The tunnel looks like it comes to a 'T' a small distance north of here.

descKeys: s. the faint screeches of bats can still be heard echoing throughout the tunnel.
r227.description:
The tunnel heads eastward here, and then around a corner with the carpet lining
the whole way.  Still spotless and clean, you feel compelled to follow it to see
where it leads.  The faint screeches of bats can still be heard echoing
throughout the tunnel.

descKeys: ine the floor as it heads southeast, which unbelievably is in perfect condition.
r228.description:
The tunnel curves a bit in an easy fashion, with the walls sloping smoothly
along with it.  It's easy to stand upright here, because the ceiling above your
head is higher.  Under your feet is a dark brown carpet that seems to line the
floor as it heads southeast, which unbelievably is in perfect condition.

descKeys: level and not a single stray stone lies there. it must lead somewhere important.
r229.description:
To the west you can see a long, thin tunnel lined with small uncomfortable
looking beds, and to the east you see a well maintained path.  The ground to the
east looks completely level and not a single stray stone lies there.  It must
lead somewhere important.

descKeys: t very much use, and it makes you glad you're not one of the mining slaves here.
r230.description:
The bunks here are jammed together to conserve space, and line the outer wall
as the tunnel curves clockwise around.  Every bed looks like it hasn't been
touched in days, and is almost as dirty as the tunnel itself.  They don't seem
to get very much use, and it makes you glad you're not one of the mining slaves
here.

descKeys: ugh to make you want to leave, and a lot has settled on the closely spaced beds.
r231.description:
You can't even stand up straight here, because the tunnel is low and you would
hit your head.  These tunnels were obviously meant for small beings, and you do
not feel at home here at all.  The dust in the air choking you is enough to make
you want to leave, and a lot has settled on the closely spaced beds.

descKeys: all kinds of rock piles and stones lay about, and just generally get in the way.
r232.description:
The row of beds ends here, and to the east is a large area that looks well
mined.  Stray mining picks lay about the area, and you see this must be a major
place for the miners to work on.  All kinds of rock piles and stones lay about,
and just generally get in the way.

descKeys: nearth something valuable, but whomever or whatever it was seems to be gone now.
r233.description:
This area has been well dug at and mined.  Large and small rocks lay all around
here, some looking like they hold ore and some looking just worthless.  A large
crack in the dead end of this tunnel looks like it was desperately dug at
to possibly unearth something valuable, but whomever or whatever it was seems to
be gone now.

descKeys: here around a bend in the tunnel. the beds also continue to look dirty and worn.
r234.description:
This part of the cavern is barely wide enough for the beds that line the wall,
all of which look strangely inviting, but completely worn out.  The beds that
line the wall continue southwest of here around a bend in the tunnel.  The beds
also continue to look dirty and worn.

descKeys: stale, the beds are cold, and you think you see something moving in the shadows.
r235.description:
The bunks here are totally empty, probably a result of the slave drivers here
making the workers work constantly day and night.  You wonder if you could slip
in a few minutes of sleep here, but the air is stale, the beds are cold, and
you think you see something moving in the shadows.

descKeys: one using the beds, and you begin to wonder to yourself if they're used at all.
r236.description:
The row of beds along the wall don't seem to be ending, but as you glance to
the west you indeed see them stop right up against the stone wall of a dead-end.
There still is no one using the beds, and you begin to wonder to yourself if
they're used at all.

descKeys: om dust and soot that it's hard to even tell the beds from piles of dirty rocks!
r237.description:
The tunnel stops here abruptly at a dead-end and a pile of rocks.  Apparently
even the sleeping quarters of the slaves is a potential dig site, and there are
stones and pebbles all over the place from the work of a miner's digging.  The
beds here are so dirty from dust and soot that it's hard to even tell the beds
from piles of dirty rocks!

descKeys: e any longer. the fire that was burning here must have went out before you came.
r238.description:
The tunnel curves around to the west and southeast here, giving little room to
walk around.  You can barely make anything out and stumble around pointlessly.
Pebbles under your feet cause you to slip and almost fall, and you wonder if
there is any reason to be here any longer.  The fire that was burning here must
have went out before you came.

descKeys: ng tools from both directions, indicating that more workers inhabit these caves.
r239.description:
Though it is still a bit dark here, you can see a fire to the southeast.  From
the faint light of the fire you can see a large rat at your feet, but
thankfully it is already dead and half rotted away.  You still hear the clinking
of mining tools from both directions, indicating that more workers inhabit
these caves.

descKeys: and the occasional large rocks look dangerous if you were to stumble over them.
r240.description:
It's very dark here, but a short distance to the east you see light flickering
off of the smooth rock wall.  Rocks are littered across the floor making it
difficult to walk properly, and the occasional large rocks look dangerous if
you were to stumble over them.

descKeys: ses your nose, but you are quickly distracted by an insect crawling up your leg.
r241.description:
The tunnel here is quite dark, but you see enough to make out the walls of the
tunnel.  Reaching out a hand, you steady your crouched body more comfortably
between the cramped walls.  Obviously whoever had made these tunnels was smaller
than average size.  The faint smell of burning wood crosses your nose, but you
are quickly distracted by an insect crawling up your leg.

descKeys: here from the door. perhaps you should head east into the room and check it out?
r242.description:
The fancy furniture and fixtures here give you the faint feeling that someone
is flaunting their fortune.  The room here is fairly large and decorated, but
you can't get a good look at anything here from the door.  Perhaps you should
head east into the room and check it out?

descKeys: left now. a terrific looking chair is here, and looks too comfortable to resist.
r243.description:
The room here is immaculately decorated as only a woman can do, with everything
either gold or silver in color.  The table at the side of the room look as if a
large meal was just eaten there recently, and nothing but scraps and bones are
left now.  A terrific looking chair is here, and looks too comfortable to
resist.

descKeys: oth sides of the cavern. back to the northwest you can see that a tunnel starts.
r244.description:
Drakkay instructs you in the finer art of climbing.
Drakkay instructs you.
You finish practicing with Drakkay.
You are in a large cavern.  At this point you cannot go any further into the
cavern, as it is blocked by a huge boulder of sorts that is directly in the
middle of the area, and touches both sides of the cavern.  Back to the
northwest you can see that a tunnel starts.

descKeys: nonexistent. the ground beneath your feet is solid, with no discernable cracks.
r245.description:
You are in a small tunnel that is leading west, where it turns back again to
the northwest, and east where it hits a small intersection of tunnels.  The
sound in this area is pretty much nonexistent.  The ground beneath your feet
is solid, with no discernable cracks.

descKeys: o way of knowing. a small rock near the northern wall is the only object around.
r246.description:
The tunnel curves here, heading both east and also back to the northwest.  It
seems that there is a lot of visitors to this section of the tunnels, but
whether those visitors are friendly, you have no way of knowing.  A small
rock near the northern wall is the only object around.

descKeys: f marks in the dirt. the unnatural silence of this region unnerves you slightly.
r247.description:
You are in a small tunnel that is going southeast and west from this point.
There is not much to see around here, just a few patches of bat guano on the
walls and a few scuff marks in the dirt.  The unnatural silence of this region
unnerves you slightly.

descKeys: a glow about it, as if some sort of strange and glowing fungus is growing on it.
r248.description:
The tunnel is running east and also southwest.  The hushed silence in this
area is strange, considering that there are billions of tons of rocks above
your head.  The northern wall has a glow about it, as if some sort of strange
and glowing fungus is growing on it.

descKeys: ce of a cave-in. seeing that nothing else is around here, you decide to move on.
r249.description:
The tunnel turns, heading both northeast and northwest.  There are several
small boulders in this area, rough and edgy.  The rocks must have been put
here by someone, as you see no evidence of a cave-in.  Seeing that nothing
else is around here, you decide to move on.

descKeys: oks to be natural in origin, but from this viewpoint you cannot be totally sure.
r250.description:
The tunnel takes a turn here, heading west where it widens out into a small
cavern, and southeast where it turns again sharply to the left.  The cavern
west looks to be natural in origin, but from this viewpoint you cannot be
totally sure.

descKeys: looking at your feet you see that the ground is littered with many small rocks.
r251.description:
You are in a small cavern that looks to be natural in origin.  The cavern
continues to the south and southwest.  To the east lies a tunnel that is
leading away from the cavern.  Looking at your feet you see that the ground
is littered with many small rocks.

descKeys: north it looks like a small tunnel runs into the northern section of the cavern.
r252.description:
This small cavern is rife with fissures and cracks in the walls and ceiling.
That being fact, many rocks are around the room, here and there on the rocky
ground.  Up to the north it looks like a small tunnel runs into the northern
section of the cavern.

descKeys: e. a little ways to the west you can see a stalactite hanging from that ceiling.
r253.description:
You are in the southeastern region of the cavern.  Looking up at the ceiling,
you see a hole that is about three feet in diameter.  The walls of this area
are smooth, as if there has been rushing water through here.  A little ways to
the west you can see a stalactite hanging from that ceiling.

descKeys: ee that the cavern turns to the northeast and keeps going, at least for a while.
r254.description:
You are near the southern edge of the cavern.  There is a peculiar odor in this
part of the region, reminding you of something dead, or dying.  Back to the
north you can see that the cavern turns to the northeast and keeps going, at
least for a while.

descKeys: lso, allowing you to think that perhaps this area had running water at one time.
r255.description:
The cavern is not very tall in height, only reaching upwards about twenty
or so feet.  The ceiling, as far as you can tell, is smooth and unblemished.
The walls around this region are smooth also, allowing you to think that
perhaps this area had running water at one time.

descKeys: ere is no deposit of calcite directly beneath it, as you have usually witnessed.
r256.description:
You are in the lower southwest corner of the small cavern.  Near the southern
wall is a large stalactite hanging from the ceiling.  The funny thing, you
note with some trepidation, is that there is no deposit of calcite directly
beneath it, as you have usually witnessed.

descKeys: s in several directions. the walls of this tunnel are quite smooth to the touch.
r257.description:
The tunnel is low here, the ceiling being only about five feet off the ground.
Up to the northeast of here you see that this tunnel intersects with another
larger tunnel that leads in several directions.  The walls of this tunnel are
quite smooth to the touch.

descKeys: dle of this section of the tunnel, looking strangely forlorn just sitting there.
r258.description:
This part of the tunnel is only leading north and southeast.  Both directions
look the same, as they both lead off into the darkness of the UnderDark.  A
small boulder is right in the middle of this section of the tunnel, looking
strangely forlorn just sitting there.

descKeys: unnel are smooth to the touch, remarkable because the ground is rough and rocky.
r259.description:
The tunnel curves here, heading northwest and southwest.  A faint dripping
sound can be heard at this point.  Perhaps there is an underground lake that
is nearby.  The walls of the tunnel are smooth to the touch, remarkable because
the ground is rough and rocky.

descKeys: higher at this point, rising to about ten or fifteen feet from the rocky ground.
r260.description:
The tunnel curves here, heading northeast where it turns again to the left,
and also south where it turns sharply again to the left as well.  The ceiling
of the tunnel gets a bit higher at this point, rising to about ten or fifteen
feet from the rocky ground.

descKeys: you can hear a faint dripping sound, no doubt coming from a nearby water source.
an hear a faint dripping sound, no doubt coming from a nearby water source.
r261.description:
The UnderDark is not a safe place, as many travellers have found out.  All
sorts of evil beings and non-sentient monsters roam the tunnels, looking for
food.  Listening closely, you can hear a faint dripping sound, no doubt coming
from a nearby water source.

descKeys: tion. a smaller tunnel is to the south- west, looking less-used than the others.
r262.description:
The tunnel branches here, heading in three separate directions.  By heading
west you will hit a sharp turn to the north.  If you went south the tunnel
seems to keep heading in that direction.  A smaller tunnel is to the south-
west, looking less-used than the others.

descKeys: all fissure in the rock, causing you to assume there is seismic activity nearby.
r263.description:
This tunnel is leading both north and south.  To the north you can see a large
intersection with other tunnels, and to the south you can see a similar
meeting point.  Along the bottom of the eastern wall runs a small fissure in
the rock, causing you to assume there is seismic activity nearby.

descKeys: 's ceiling is a large crack in the rock. perhaps this tunnel is not that stable?
r264.description:
The tunnels lead off to the west, north, and south from this point.  Each of
the tunnels look the same, although the one to the west is slightly lower in
height.  Near the apex of the tunnel's ceiling is a large crack in the rock.
Perhaps this tunnel is not that stable?

descKeys: efore recorded time, no one has bothered in getting the answer to that question.
r265.description:
This path in the tunnel curves here, heading both north and east.  The walls
of the tunnel, although smooth, feel like they shake every now and then.  Who
knows how stable they are, or even how they came into being.  Since these
tunnels have been around before recorded time, no one has bothered in getting
the answer to that question.

descKeys: her direction from this point will lead you to a similar section of the tunnels.
r266.description:
You are in the UnderDark, travelling in a dark and damp tunnel that is heading
south and west.  The tunnel walls are quite smooth, and the tunnel ground is
very rough and extremely rocky.  Either direction from this point will lead
you to a similar section of the tunnels.

descKeys: lmost blocking the path. however, it looks like you could easily walk around it.
r267.description:
This tunnel is going north and south.  To the south you can see that this
tunnel hits another one, forming a small intersection.  A large boulder is
right in front of you, almost blocking the path.  However, it looks like you
could easily walk around it.

descKeys: have smooth walls, but the one to the northwest is a bit smaller and less used.
r268.description:
This is a small intersection of two tunnels.  The main one runs north and
south. with a smaller tunnel also running off to the northwest.  Both of the
tunnels have smooth walls, but the one to the northwest is a bit smaller
and less used.

descKeys: st you can tell that the tunnel curves to the left a bit, but then continues on.
r269.description:
The tunnel curves here, heading to the west and also to the north.  Towards
the north you can see that a small intersection in the tunnels occurs.  Back
to the west you can tell that the tunnel curves to the left a bit, but then
continues on.

descKeys: ink you can spot a large metal object, standing out from the nearby rocky walls.
r270.description:
This tunnel is fairly small, only being about five feet in height from the
ground to the ceiling.  Leading in two directions, the tunnel looks like it
is fairly well-used.  To the southwest you think you can spot a large metal
object, standing out from the nearby rocky walls.

descKeys: r magical. beyond that stout gate is the city of the svirfneblin, called granei.
r271.description:
You are before a large metal gate.  The gate, which is directly west of this
point, is made out of a strong material that is resistant to most any attack,
melee or magical.  Beyond that stout gate is the city of the Svirfneblin,
called Granei.

descKeys: aces for the guards of the city to hide in. there is a stone door leading west .
r272.description:
You are just inside the Svirfneblin city of Granei.  East of you is the large
city gate that protects the city from the denizens of the UnderDark.  This
small tunnel runs from the gate for about forty feet west, where it hits a
large stone door.  All along the sides of the tunnel are muder holes and
other various hiding places for the guards of the city to hide in.
There is a stone door leading west ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: giving this small area a greenish glow that perhaps may draw unwanted attention.
r274.description:
You are at another intersection in the tunnels.  The tunnels lead off towards
three directions, each looking similar to the others.  The ceiling in this
area is covered with bits of fungus, giving this small area a greenish glow
that perhaps may draw unwanted attention.

descKeys: e is a water source nearby? ah well, you can ponder that thought as you move on.
r275.description:
This tunnel looks to be fairly new, due to the fact of the many cracks that
can be found in the walls and near the ceiling.  A faint sound of dripping
water reaches your ears.  Perhaps there is a water source nearby?  Ah well,
you can ponder that thought as you move on.

descKeys: walls. the reason for constructing this tunnel completely escapes you, however.
r276.description:
This tunnel is running a straight shot to the northwest and southeast.  The
tunnel looks like it was constructed recently, due to the cracks and fissures
in the otherwise smooth walls.  The reason for constructing this tunnel
completely escapes you, however.

descKeys: ely abrupt incline starts to the north. the air is dank and almost unbreathable.
r277.description:
The tunnel continues northward as usual, but sharply gets smaller to the
south, getting to the point where you will have to get on your hands and
knees and start crawling.  An extremely abrupt incline starts to the north.
The air is dank and almost unbreathable.
r277.title: Tunnel narrows south; steep incline north

descKeys: ddar. there are lots of drow walking about there buying and selling their items.
r278.description:
This is a rather splendid building.  It is very spacious and has beautiful
decorations throughout the room.  There is a colorful carpet that lines the
hallway here.  There is a lot of light and you get the feeling that whoever
lives here has a lot of money.  You can look out of the building and see
north of here.  North of here is the market center of Nal Shaddar.  There are
lots of drow walking about there buying and selling their items.

descKeys: addar. the hallway also runs south, where there is another part of the building.
r279.description:
The decoration and exquisite colors of this building amaze you.  The carpet
is a bright red color that looks pefect.  There are lots of decorations
hanging from the walls.  North of here you can see the exit out of the
Merchant's guild that will take you back into the city of Nal Shaddar.  The
hallway also runs south, where there is another part of the building.

descKeys: ng area. a small set of stairs leads down, seemingly heading into a lighted pit.
r280.description:
You are standing at the intersection of two hallways.  The hallway is very
clean, and looks to be taken care of very well.  There are lots of
decorations that are mounted on the walls throughout this building.  East of
here it is a bit darker than here, and you can't see in there.  To the west
you can see some furniture, and it looks to be some kind of small living
area.  A small set of stairs leads down, seemingly heading into a lighted
pit.

descKeys: erything in it looks very costly. back towards the west you can see the hallway.
r281.description:
This is a very extravagant room.  There are expensive pieces of furniture all
around the room.  There is no carpet on the floor, instead there is green
marble.  On the walls there is some expensive artwork.  There must be a rich
man that lives in this room, because everything in it looks very costly.
Back towards the west you can see the hallway.

descKeys: se for the wear. there is a small set of stairs in the corner that lead upwards.
r282.description:
You are standing in a large room filled with weird devices and instruments
that have been set around the area.  Large scorch marks and acid burns are
on the walls and tables, making the room look quite worse for the wear.  There
is a small set of stairs in the corner that lead upwards.

descKeys: time. large tables with various alchemy equipment have been set around the room.
r283.description:
You are in the extensive alchemy lab in the Merchant's Guild.  Members of
the guild come here to brew their potions and to generally have an
outstandingly rip-roaring good time.  Large tables with various alchemy
equipment have been set around the room.

descKeys: . you can head towards the east to get back to the intersection of two hallways.
r284.description:
This is the living area of any of the merchants that live or work around
here.  There are couches and chairs placed around the room that look very
comfortable.  There must be daily upkeep, every part of this building is
perfect.  There is no dirt, cobwebs, or smudges anywhere around here.  You
can head towards the east to get back to the intersection of two hallways.

descKeys: particularly taxing on your strength. the tunnel continues levelly to the south.
r296.description:
You are at the bottom of a steep incline, staring through the tunnel up into
the darkness, wondering where it might take you.  Although you do not see
any handholds, you do not think the climb will be particularly taxing on your
strength.  The tunnel continues levelly to the south.
r296.title: The tunnel inclines

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r297.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: ded from years of exposure to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.
r298.description:
The tunnel starts to widen out here, gaining in size to the south.  Directly
in the middle of the tunnel lies a peculiar rock.  The rock is shaped like
a head, although the facial features have been rounded from years of exposure
to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.

descKeys: lowly growing in height and majesty. the tunnel continues unabated to the north.
r299.description:
You are standing at the beginning of a tunnel, or maybe it is the end of the
tunnel you are witnessing.  A large cavern starts here and extends to the
west, slowly growing in height and majesty.  The tunnel continues unabated
to the north.

descKeys: esembles a normal tunnel. a small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.
r300.description:
The large cavern to the west has slowly dimished to about half of its height
and reached a steadying height of about forty-five feet at this juncture.
Off to the east, the cavern slopes down until it resembles a normal tunnel.
A small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.

descKeys: source of the glow. a small tunnel breaks off from the cavern to the northwest.
r301.description:
The cavern grows in size to the south, and gently diminishes to the east.  The
point of the cavern you are now in glows faintly with a greenish hue.  Looking
at the walls, you notice a strange type of fungus attached to it.  The fungus
must be the source of the glow.  A small tunnel breaks off from the cavern
to the northwest.

descKeys: undred feet up into the darkness, with stalactites being seen along the ceiling.
r302.description:
You are travelling along a small path set in a large and spacious cavern.  The
path meanders along the cavern wall, dodging between large stalagmites which
dot the cavern's floor.  The cavern itself must stretch at least a hundred
feet up into the darkness, with stalactites being seen along the ceiling.

descKeys: the rock which would allow you to climb the short distance to the tunnel above.
r303.description:
A large cavern stops here, but does continue to the northwest.  A cliff face
is right in front of you, preventing you from moving in that direction.  You
can spot several handholds in the rock which would allow you to climb the
short distance to the tunnel above.

descKeys: f's surface and reach the continued path in the tunnel, which you can see below.
r304.description:
You have reached the end of the tunnel, or such is your first impression.  The
tunnel ends abruptly to open air towards the east, but glancing down you do
in fact see that it would be possible to climb down the cliff's surface and
reach the continued path in the tunnel, which you can see below.

descKeys: it a mirror-like surface. towards the south, the tunnel gets more and more damp.
r305.description:
You are travelling in a dark and mysterious tunnel, trying not to bump your
head on a low-hanging stalactite.  The surface of the tunnel's wall is quite
smooth and uninterupted by scratches here, giving it a mirror-like surface.
Towards the south, the tunnel gets more and more damp.

descKeys: ooth for some reason. the path through the tunnel is relatively clear of debris.
r306.description:
The tunnel is running to the southeast, where you detect a hint of dampness,
and also to the north, where you can see the tunnel ending.  The walls of
the tunnel are quite smooth for some reason.  The path through the tunnel
is relatively clear of debris.

descKeys: along the sides of the stairs, you feel perfectly safe traversing them upwards.
r307.description:
A bat chitters nervously.
You have stumbled across a crude set of stairs that has been carved out of
the cavern's wall, leading up into the gloomy darkness.  Although there are
no handrails along the sides of the stairs, you feel perfectly safe traversing
them upwards.

descKeys: , you shudder to think what lies in wait. a slight breeze brushes by your cheek.
r308.description:
A crude set of stairs lead down into the darkness.  The stairs must have been
constructed by the early explorers who probably built this tunnel.  Looking
down into the darkness, you shudder to think what lies in wait.  A slight
breeze brushes by your cheek.

descKeys: ing. hoping that you will not get hit with some flying guano, you trudge onward.
r309.description:
The tunnel curves here to the north and south, leading into two equally dark
and gloomy passageways.  Looking at the ceiling, you can see several groups
of bats hanging on the edge of the cavern walls and ceiling.  Hoping that you
will not get hit with some flying guano, you trudge onward.

descKeys: ilt up on the cave walls, leading you to believe that there may be water nearby.
r310.description:
The small tunnel ends abruptly against a stone wall, preventing you from
moving in any direction except for south.  A large and wide crack is set in
the western wall.  Condensation has built up on the cave walls, leading you
to believe that there may be water nearby.

descKeys: own almost to dust. a thin layer of webbing is covering the walls of the tunnel.
r312.description:
The tunnel broadens out a bit to the south and also runs into an inter-
section to the east.  The floor of the tunnel is littered with small bits
of bone that has been ground down almost to dust.  A thin layer of webbing
is covering the walls of the tunnel.

descKeys: ls. near one of the walls is a large rock that is flat on top, being a bit worn.
r313.description:
The tunnel is fairly wide here, being about ten feet in width.  The walls of
this area of the tunnel are covered in silky webs, blanketing the entire
surface of the walls.  Near one of the walls is a large rock that is flat
on top, being a bit worn.

descKeys: eiling, you can see a small hole that is about three feet across in its surface.
r314.description:
The tunnel is quite wide here, about fifteen feet from wall to wall.  The
scent in this part of the tunnel is of a dampness for certain.  A water
source must be nearby.  The tunnel does about a ninety degree turn here,
heading to the north and east.  Looking at the ceiling, you can see a small
hole that is about three feet across in its surface.

descKeys: ebs, the largest web being about twenty feet in width. the webs look fairly new.
r315.description:
The tunnel is about ten feet wide here, and opens up a bit more to the west.
To the southeast it looks like the tunnel comes to an abrupt end.  The walls
in this area are all covered with spider webs, the largest web being about
twenty feet in width.  The webs look fairly new.

descKeys: orthwest, winding its way through the dark and oftentimes treacherous underdark.
r316.description:
The tunnel ends abruptly here, running up into a wall to the south.  Something
about the southern wall is strange, although you cannot put your finger on it.
The tunnel leads back to the northwest, winding its way through the dark and
oftentimes treacherous Underdark.

descKeys: lling what is around this area. a small patch of fungus is in the northern wall.
r318.description:
The tunnel takes a sharp turn here, heading to the south where it turns again
and to the east where it continues straight.  The walls and ceiling of the
tunnel are quite smooth.  No telling what is around this area.  A small
patch of fungus is in the northern wall.

descKeys: ously like dried blood. it is hard to say how long the substance has been there.
r319.description:
You are at a sharp turn in the tunnel.  The tunnel leads north and also
to the west.  A large patch of a rust-colored substance is on the floor of
the tunnel, looking suspiciously like dried blood.  It is hard to say how
long the substance has been there.

descKeys: he tunnel continues to the northwest and also to the east where it widens a bit.
r320.description:
The tunnel narrows down to about three feet across and five feet high.  It
is a tight squeeze in some places.  The walls of the tunnel are quite smooth,
however, so it is not too difficult to move around.  The tunnel continues
to the northwest and also to the east where it widens a bit.

descKeys: k into the darkness. the tunnel continues to the southeast but gets very narrow.
r321.description:
The tunnel dead-ends here abruptly.  The walls and ceiling of this area are
quite smooth and free of any blemishes, which seems odd.  A small crack is
in the western wall, stretching far back into the darkness.  The tunnel
continues to the southeast but gets very narrow.

descKeys: and climb it. a small crack is in the eastern wall, evidently leading somewhere.
r322.description:
You suck in your gut and squeeze in the crack.  After about fifty or so
feet of scraping along, you come into a very open area.
You are standing at the bottom of a deep 'chute' that leads quite a ways
upwards through solid rock.  The sides of the chute are fairly rocky, and
should provide a few handholds for anyone foolish enough to try and climb
it.  A small crack is in the eastern wall, evidently leading somewhere.

descKeys: ks upon them, as if some large and fearsome creature regularly visits this area.
r325.description:
The tunnel branches off here, leading three separate ways.  The stagnant air
in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.

descKeys: king to the south you can see a dark lair, obviously a home for something large.
r329.description:
make an abrubt turn and head northwest (you think) for about fifty feet and
then pop out to the other side.
The mine tunnel looks in bad shape around here.  The walls have been scratched
by some huge sharp tool or something like that.  Burn marks are upon the
ground and walls, giving you an eerie feeling.  A particularly large crack in
the eastern wall garners your attention also.  Looking to the south you can see
a dark lair, obviously a home for something large.
r329.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: ks upon them, as if some large and fearsome creature regularly visits this area.
r330.description:
The tunnel branches off here, leading three separate ways.  The stagnant air
in this part of the mines causes you to gag slightly.  While gagging, you
notice that the walls have scratch marks upon them, as if some large and
fearsome creature regularly visits this area.
r330.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: jected to many gases, and should not be breathed for prolonged portions of time.
r331.description:
There is a large hole in the ceiling here, with several handholds along the
wall leading up into it.  The air down in the bottom part of the mines has
most likely been subjected to many gases, and should not be breathed for
prolonged portions of time.
r331.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: as you try to firmly grasp them. in fact, a few of the rungs are indeed missing.
r332.description:
The mine shaft you are in now seems to have been hastily constructed.  The
sides of the shaft have been sloppily drilled, and the handholds almost
fall out into your hands as you try to firmly grasp them.  In fact, a few of
the rungs are indeed missing.
r332.title: Mine Shaft

descKeys: own in the hole, you do not relish the thought of running into anything hostile.
r333.description:
The tunnel stops here, but continues on to the west.  A large hole is in the
ground here, gaping open like a whale's mouth.  Several handholds have been
set inside of the hole, allowing you to descend down into it.  Although you
are curious to see what is down in the hole, you do not relish the thought of
running into anything hostile.
r333.title: Hole in the ground

descKeys: tunnel walls. strangely enough, the moss is giving off a faint and bluish aura.
r334.description:
The mine tunnel slopes a bit here, going downwards to the east.  Looking
around at the tunnel walls, you see that a small moss-like plant is growing
upon the tunnel walls.  Strangely enough, the moss is giving off a faint and
bluish aura.
r334.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: he west, you see that hardly any dust has been disturbed upon the cavern ground.
r335.description:
The mine tunnel gets a little cramped here, shrinking in size until you
almost have to bend over to prevent from hitting your head on the ceiling.
Looking to the west, you see that hardly any dust has been disturbed upon
the cavern ground.
r335.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: a large fissure is in the ceiling, telling you that this shaft may be unstable.
r336.description:
The mine tunnel branches off into three separate directions here.  A strong
odor reminding you of dead rats eminates from the southeast.  Darkness is
the only discernable property about the other two directions.  A large fissure
is in the ceiling, telling you that this shaft may be unstable.
r336.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: e driving them. you can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the west a bit.
r337.description:
There have been several torches set about the tunnel walls, contained within
a few rusted and warped metal pegs, slammed into the wall with some incredible
force driving them.  You can faintly see the entrance to the mines to the
west a bit.
r337.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: to the west. the mine's dirt floor is almost smooth, with hardly any footprints.
r338.description:
The mine tunnel follows a set of metal tracks which run through the middle
of the tunnel.  The walls are smoke-stained and reek of bat guano.  You can
see a faint and inviting sliver of light to the west.  The mine's dirt floor
is almost smooth, with hardly any footprints.
r338.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: travelling east will take you farther and farther into these treacherous mines.
r339.description:
The entrance to the Kulajo Mines has been boarded up, albeit a poor job of
doing so.  The boards have been almost totally ripped away by eager treasure
seekers and flung halfway down the mountainside.  The mines open up into
daylight to the west, while travelling east will take you farther and farther
into these treacherous mines.
r339.title: Mine Tunnel

descKeys: silver were gone, the miners packed up and left, moving on to the next mountain.
r340.description:
You are just outside of the entrance to Kulajo Mines.  The mines burrow way
back into Mt. Kulajo.  They were built many years ago by prospectors looking
for mostly silver, although some gold was also found entrenched within the
mountain.  After all of the gold and silver were gone, the miners packed up
and left, moving on to the next mountain.
r340.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: itself with a few twists and turns. the mines are to the northeast a few steps.
r341.description:
The path to the mines winds a bit here, wrapping itself around a large
boulder that has rolled itself into the middle of the trail.  Lichens and
moss are growing on the huge rock, giving evidence to support the fact that
the boulder for been here for some time.  A lesser-used path winds off to the
north, losing itself with a few twists and turns.  The mines are to the
northeast a few steps.
r341.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: ver your shoulder, you can see threshold sitting near the base of this mountain.
r342.description:
The rocky path is getting to be very inclined, making you work for every
foot you gain.  Off to the northeast a ways you can barely spot the entrance
of Kulajo Mines.  Gazing back over your shoulder, you can see Threshold
sitting near the base of this mountain.
r342.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: andscape here and there, looking ill and starved for some life-giving nutrients.
r343.description:
The small mountain path goes through a switchback here, making you put out
a little more exertion just to climb the route.  Small and scraggly trees dot
the landscape here and there, looking ill and starved for some life-giving
nutrients.
r343.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: urmise that you be the first person to have come around this area for some time.
r344.description:
You are travelling along a small path that is clinging precariously to the
rocky side of Mt. Kulajo.  The small dirt path is not very well-used, as if
nobody bothers coming up to this part of the mountain anymore.  Judging from
the thick foliage on and around the path, you surmise that you be the first
person to have come around this area for some time.
r344.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: t be seen from here, with its opening jutting out from the side of the mountain.
r345.description:
The small path is winding along the side of Mt. Kulajo.  Although you are high
off of the ground, you seem to feel at least marginally safe for the moment.
The mine can almost be seen from here, with its opening jutting out from
the side of the mountain.
r345.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: mine shaft. mt. kulajo looms over you like some sort of benefactorial presence.
r346.description:
This small path leads to either Kulajo Mines or gateway Road, depending on
which way you were headed.  The path runs along side Mt. Kulajo, winding its
way towards the old and mostly unused mine shaft.  Mt. Kulajo looms over you
like some sort of benefactorial presence.
r346.title: Path to Mine

descKeys: range, with the largest of the giants, mt. kulajo, being right in front of you.
r349.description:
This road is leading its way along a northeast-southwest route.  Off to the
east you can see a large body of water, which is probably the Kendrite Sea.
To the north lies the Absinthe Mountain Range, with the largest of the giants,
Mt. Kulajo, being right in front of you.
r349.title: Absinthe Mountain Range - Caravan Route

descKeys: mountain. a tumble off the path from this height would certainly be a bad thing.
r413.description:
The small mountain path is quite sturdy, if not unnerving to traverse.
Looking over the side of the path, you stare at least two hundred feet down
into the valley next to the mountain.  A tumble off the path from this height
would certainly be a bad thing.

descKeys: dy and solid a few steps down from here to the southwest. some flowers are here.
r414.description:
You are travelling along a small mountain path.  It seems as if the path
was hastily constructed, without regard to safety or any other regulations.
However, the path looks a little more sturdy and solid a few steps down from
here to the southwest.  Some flowers are here.

descKeys: ty of the surrounding snow drifts and snow-covered trees takes your breath away.
r419.description:
The small mountain path is almost indiscernable underneath the large piles
of snow that has accumulated over the years.  It is getting very difficult
to walk around in this area.  Although it is extremely cold and you feel as
if your nose would fall off if you tweaked it, the natural beauty of the
surrounding snow drifts and snow-covered trees takes your breath away.

descKeys: ighwaymen. the second reason is the number of yeti sightings in the recent past.
r420.description:
Cutland's Pass has become infamous over the years for a few different reasons.
The first reason is the number of ambushes that have occurred here by some
rebel highwaymen.  The second reason is the number of Yeti sightings in the
recent past.

descKeys: h looks out of the ordinary. the ceiling and floor of the tunnel is also smooth.
r431.description:
You search around the wall for a few minutes.  Running your hand over a
certain section of the wall you find a small lever.  Turning it, you find
that a section of the wall starts to revolve.  You ride the moving section
and end up in a different tunnel.
The tunnel is running east and west, hitting a sharp turn in either
direction about forty feet away.  The walls of the tunnel are smooth with
the exception of the northern wall, which looks out of the ordinary.  The
ceiling and floor of the tunnel is also smooth.

descKeys: the tunnel are quite smooth. that fact in itself sets off your internal alarms.
r432.description:
The tunnel takes a sharp turn here, heading to the west and also to the
south towards a small intersection.  The floor, walls, and ceiling of this
part of the tunnel are quite smooth.  That fact in itself sets off your
internal alarms.

descKeys: to the left. the walls and ceiling of this part of the tunnel are quite smooth.
r433.description:
The tunnel splits off into three separate directions.  To the east is a
large alcove, to the southwest the tunnel seems to dead-end, and to the
north the tunnel goes into a sharp turn to the left.  The walls and ceiling
of this part of the tunnel are quite smooth.

descKeys: ng the ceiling. a small hole, about three feet in width, is in the western wall.
r434.description:
The tunnel suddenly stops here, only heading back to the northeast towards
a small intersection.  The walls of the tunnel are very smooth and free of
any blemishes, including the ceiling.  A small hole, about three feet in
width, is in the western wall.

descKeys: e chasm in the wall is a large crack that looks like it may lead somewhere else.
r436.description:
The giant spider is chittering to itself.
You are standing in a three-way intersection of the tunnels.  A small chasm
is against the eastern wall.  The chasm is only a few feet across, but there
is no way to tell how deep it is.  Across the chasm in the wall is a large
crack that looks like it may lead somewhere else.

descKeys: , you shudder to think what lies in wait. a slight breeze brushes by your cheek.
r437.description:
A crude set of stairs lead down into the darkness.  The stairs must have been
constructed by the early explorers who probably built this tunnel.  Looking
down into the darkness, you shudder to think what lies in wait.  A slight
breeze brushes by your cheek.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r438.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r440.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: be seen to the north, and a large cavern is through the tunnel to the southeast.
r441.description:
The small tunnel has not been used much, judging by the many rocky spires that
are jutting about along the tunnel floor.  If you do not watch your step, you
just might injure yourself.  A large mushroom grove can be seen to the north,
and a large cavern is through the tunnel to the southeast.

descKeys: a large cavern to the south. the mushroom grove also continues to the northwest.
r442.description:
The young Myconid jumps up and down on a mushroom.
You are standing in a small mushroom grove.  The mushrooms here are small ones,
only standing about eight feet in height on average.  The mushrooms provide
a continual diet for many of the Underdark's denizens.  A small tunnel leads
back to a large cavern to the south.  The mushroom grove also continues to the
northwest.

descKeys: oint. the route back to the southeast looks to eventually lead out of the grove.
r443.description:
The young Myconid jumps up and down on a mushroom.
The mushrooms in this large grove oftentimes grow to over fifteen feet high,
but most of them are around eight feet in height.  The grove travels off into
three general directions at this point.  The route back to the southeast looks
to eventually lead out of the grove.

descKeys: he region northwest of here. something must make this mushroom grove their home.
r444.description:
The young Myconid jumps up and down on a mushroom.
This area of the grove looks like it has been tampered with.  Some of the
mushrooms look to have been cleared away to the north, allowing travel in that
direction.  The same goes for the region northwest of here.  Something must
make this mushroom grove their home.

descKeys: around, maybe used for bedding. back to the south the grove looks more natural.
r445.description:
This looks like some sort of living area for something.  Several mushroom
stumps are around, evidently used for sitting, or perhaps tables.  There are
also a few piles of mushroom shavings around, maybe used for bedding.  Back
to the south the grove looks more natural.

descKeys: e mushrooms have been cleared from here, allowing more room for the inhabitants.
r446.description:
This part of the mushroom grove is obviously used for living quarters.  All
around this area are piles of what looks like mushroom shavings, evidently
used for bedding.  Most of the mushrooms have been cleared from here, allowing
more room for the inhabitants.

descKeys: sides. the walls of the cavern, strangely enough, are very smooth to the touch.
r447.description:
This area of the grove looks to be a living quarter.  Along the two walls of
the cavern are several long benches, made from large mushrooms that are laying
on their sides.  The walls of the cavern, strangely enough, are very smooth
to the touch.

descKeys: a mushroom is set directly in the center of this area, perhaps used as a table.
r448.description:
You are in the northwest part of the living quarters of the mushroom grove.
Several piles of mushroom shavings are on the floor of the cavern, probably
used for bedding.  A large stump of a mushroom is set directly in the center
of this area, perhaps used as a table.

descKeys: u can see that a wall of mushrooms goes across the way, almost blocking passage.
r449.description:
You rocked Myconid's world with that double thrust attack!
The mushrooms in this area are a different color than the rest of the grove.
They appear to have been 'smoked', as they are darker in color and also much
smaller, as if they shriveled up.  Up ahead to the north you can see that a
wall of mushrooms goes across the way, almost blocking passage.

descKeys: in neat rows, as if someone planted them in a certain order, like a small farm.
r450.description:
The mushroom grove is continuing here along the western side of the cavern.
It looks like the mushrooms in this part of the grove are smaller than normal.
They are also running in neat rows, as if someone planted them in a certain
order, like a small farm.

descKeys: passage to the north. south of here is the rows of mushrooms, resembling a farm.
r451.description:
You are near a large wall of mushrooms that almost prevent movement to the
north.  The densely-packed mushrooms run in a straight line and only have a
five foot wide opening near the center, allowing passage to the north.  South
of here is the rows of mushrooms, resembling a farm.

descKeys: looks to only be a few months old. amind the mushrooms is growing a small plant.
r452.description:
It looks like you are on the western side of the large mushroom grove, right
beside the cavern wall.  This route only heads to the north and back to the
southeast, as the mushrooms prevent you from heading any other direction.
To your left is a small mushroom, and it looks to only be a few months old.
Amind the mushrooms is growing a small plant.

descKeys: larger one. a small carving of some sort has been etched into one of the walls.
r453.description:
The small tunnel you are in is very damp and moldy.  There must be a source
of water nearby that is causing all of this wetness.  To the north you can
see that the tunnel intersects with another larger one.  A small carving of
some sort has been etched into one of the walls.

descKeys: water. you may be able to wade out to it, if you care to brave the murky water.
r454.description:
You are on the shore of an underground lake.  The lake stretches out to the
south as far as you can see, with the cavern walls reaching far upwards into
the darkness.  Along the shores of the lake lie several bones and a few
complete skeletons.  About ten feet from the shore is a large clam, just
barely sticking its shell out of the water.  You may be able to wade out to
it, if you care to brave the murky water.

descKeys: ind the door is evidently a jail of sorts. there is a wooden door leading east .
r455.description:
You are standing in a small room carved out of a grayish rock.  A small set
of stairs is in the middle of the room, heading upwards.  A small desk
is against one wall, facing a large door that is probably locked.  The room
behind the door is evidently a jail of sorts.
There is a wooden door leading east ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: to their surface, as if something big has passed through here in recent history.
r456.description:
The tunnel walls close in slightly here, giving you a sense of feeling like
you have been stuffed in a coffin, and unable to move.  The walls have many
scratches marked into their surface, as if something big has passed through
here in recent history.

descKeys: e recently, you can tell. back to the south, the tunnel seems to get a bit damp.
r457.description:
The tunnel suddenly stops here, leaving you to only head back to the south
if you are wanting to go anywhere.  The walls of the tunnel are smooth, but
something has been here recently, you can tell.  Back to the south, the
tunnel seems to get a bit damp.

descKeys: unique color. the shore continues on to the northeast and also back to the west.
r466.description:
You are on the shoreline of Rothe Island, right beside the water.  The sand
beneath your feet is very fine, and also very dark.  The mineral content
of the water must make the sand its unique color.  The shore continues on
to the northeast and also back to the west.

descKeys: s here, evidently having been missed by the rothe herds on their daily feedings.
r467.description:
The shore continues here to the east and also towards the southwest, where
it hits a landing, right in front of the dock.  There are several large
patches of moss here, evidently having been missed by the rothe herds on
their daily feedings.

descKeys: serving part of this establishment.
northwest. back to the south you can see many mushrooms that are dark in color.
r474.description:
There is a large wall of tightly-packed mushrooms that spreads almost all the
way across your path.  There is only a four foot wide opening that allows any-
thing to go northwest.  Back to the south you can see many mushrooms that are
dark in color.

descKeys: ning from the pit, or so it is rumored. the pit continues to the east and north.
notes: Zerif Pit: one-way drop from r95 d. Only exit is 'climb up' (rate-limited, often fails). Bots never walk r95:d (merchant param neverWalkExits/allowPitDescent); tagged no-explore for map-expand. Remove tag to explore on purpose.
r476.description:
You are in the mysterious Zerif Pit.  The dark hole runs beneath Nal Shaddar
and contains denizens of the UnderDark that are best left unseen.  The walls
of the Pit are covered in slime, so it is very hard to get out of it.  Right
above you is a large opening, the only opening from the Pit, or so it is
rumored.  The Pit continues to the east and north.

descKeys: of arach-tillith. you see that the pit continues south and east from this point.
r477.description:
You are in the Zerif Pit, below the Drow city of Nal Shaddar.  The Unfaithful
are thrown down here, to never come back.  It is rumored there is only one way
out of this Pit.  However, even if an Unfaithful escaped, they would be hunted
down and slaughtered by the members of Arach-Tillith.  You see that the Pit
continues south and east from this point.

descKeys: is causing that is something that you do not want to get in close quarters with.
r478.description:
Nameht emerges from hiding.
The Pit continues in several directions here.  The walls of the Pit are all
covered with a dense slime.  Every now and then you can see that the slime
shivers a bit.  Whatever is causing that is something that you do not want
to get in close quarters with.

descKeys: for a lifetime. the pit continues to the north, east, and also back to the west.
r479.description:
You are in the Zerif Pit.  The Pit is more like a series of caverns that run
underneath Nal Shaddar.  It is rumored that they go on forever, and that any-
one who is sent down here wanders those caverns for a lifetime.  The Pit
continues to the north, east, and also back to the west.

descKeys: no telling what diseases and other nasty things that are inhabiting that slime.
r480.description:
The Pit looks like it dead-ends to the south.  Perhaps it does, but you
cannot tell from this vantage point.  The walls of the Pit are covered with
a nasty-looking slime.  There is no telling what diseases and other nasty
things that are inhabiting that slime.

descKeys: but you cannot tell for sure. however, leaving this area would probably be wise.
r481.description:
It looks like the Pit dead-ends at this point.  On three sides of you are
slime-covered walls, with the only exit being north.  On the ground are
several red spots.  Perhaps the spots are blood, but you cannot tell for
sure.  However, leaving this area would probably be wise.

descKeys: rm. the lair continues to the south, although you hesitate to go that direction.
r486.title: Dragon's Lair
r486.description:
The bat flies circles around your head.
You are standing in (presumably) a dragon's lair.  Large skeletons and many
pieces of discarded armament have been strewn about, a testament to those
foolish enough to have entered the treacherous home of a giant wyrm.  The
lair continues to the south, although you hesitate to go that direction.

descKeys: source of the glow. a small tunnel breaks off from the cavern to the northwest.
r506.title: Large Cavern
r506.description:
The cavern grows in size to the south, and gently diminishes to the east.  The
point of the cavern you are now in glows faintly with a greenish hue.  Looking
at the walls, you notice a strange type of fungus attached to it.  The fungus
must be the source of the glow.  A small tunnel breaks off from the cavern
to the northwest.

descKeys: esembles a normal tunnel. a small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.
r507.title: Sloping Cavern
r507.description:
The large cavern to the west has slowly dimished to about half of its height
and reached a steadying height of about forty-five feet at this juncture.
Off to the east, the cavern slopes down until it resembles a normal tunnel.
A small cavern juts off through a tunnel to the north.

descKeys: lowly growing in height and majesty. the tunnel continues unabated to the north.
r508.title: The tunnel ends
r508.description:
You are standing at the beginning of a tunnel, or maybe it is the end of the
tunnel you are witnessing.  A large cavern starts here and extends to the
west, slowly growing in height and majesty.  The tunnel continues unabated
to the north.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r510.title: The tunnel descends
r510.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: ded from years of exposure to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.
r529.title: Dark Tunnel
r529.description:
The tunnel starts to widen out here, gaining in size to the south.  Directly
in the middle of the tunnel lies a peculiar rock.  The rock is shaped like
a head, although the facial features have been rounded from years of exposure
to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.

descKeys: near the bottom of the wall is a space that could probably be travelled through.
r532.description:
This dark cavern is unstable at best.  Looking around, you see that there is a
lot of dust swirling around, almost choking you.  The walls shake visibly e
every once in a while, and the ceiling of the cavern looks like it could fall
at any moment.  The cavern seems to dead-end here, but near the bottom of
the wall is a space that could probably be travelled through.

descKeys: at lead away from here, with the southern route ending in some sort of dead-end.
r533.description:
A pile of rocks right in front of you shifts suddenly.
The cavern has opened up a little at this point.  The ceiling of the cavern
is approximately twenty feet in height.  The dust is quite thick here, there
must be a lot of seismic activity in this region.  You see several routes
that lead away from here, with the southern route ending in some sort of
dead-end.

descKeys: head in several directions, with the cavern to the south opening up quite a bit.
r534.description:
Bat flies east.
This part of the cavern is very damp, as if there is a water source nearby.
The walls and ceiling are coated with moisture, with some of that moisture
dripping down and hitting the ground, stirring up some dust.  It looks like
you can head in several directions, with the cavern to the south opening up
quite a bit.

descKeys: rocks are around, some looking like they just got there during a recent cave-in.
r535.description:
The cavern grows much smaller to the north of here, forming a tunnel that is
about ten feet in height.  However, the cavern increases in size to the south
and southeast.  Large piles of rocks are around, some looking like they just
got there during a recent cave-in.

descKeys: el, almost blocking your progress to the east. there is a plant in front of you.
r536.description:
You are in a tunnel that is about ten feet in height.  To the south, the
tunnel opens up into a cavern, which is about twenty feet from ground to
ceiling.  Several piles of rocks are in the tunnel, almost blocking your
progress to the east.  There is a plant in front of you.

descKeys: . there are many piles of rocks around here, some of them looking newly-settled.
r537.description:
You are in a small tunnel that is leading west, where it turns again to the
south, and also south where it seems to dead-end.  The tunnel walls tend to
shake now and then.  This area must have a lot of cave-ins.  There are many
piles of rocks around here, some of them looking newly-settled.

descKeys: has a strange look about it. perhaps a closer inspection will turn something up.
r538.description:
Bat flies in from the west.
The tunnel evidently dead-ends here, only heading back to the north.  There
are several piles of rocks here, one of them being about five feet in height.
When you are facing the dead-end, the wall to your left has a strange look
about it.  Perhaps a closer inspection will turn something up.

descKeys: the cavern have large chunks 'torn' from them, evidently from periodic cave-ins.
r539.description:
You are standing in a large cavern that seems to be quite unstable.  Dust
is swirling around haphazardly, getting into your nostrils and your garments
as well.  The walls of the cavern have large chunks 'torn' from them,
evidently from periodic cave-ins.

descKeys: en fungus is growing on the cavern's floor, giving off a faintly greenish light.
r541.description:
This small cavern reminds you of a box canyon on the surface.  Three sides of
the cavern end in walls, while a small tunnel leads south into a large cavern.
A lush carpet of green fungus is growing on the cavern's floor, giving off a
faintly greenish light.

descKeys: piders who occupy this vicinity. an intersection in the tunnels is to the south.
r542.description:
The tunnels are running through a gauntlet of large webs.  The webs stretch
from the floor of the tunnel to the ceiling.  It seems that there must be
one or more large spiders who occupy this vicinity.  An intersection in the
tunnels is to the south.

descKeys: nels are covered with similiar webs. a few bones litter the floor of the tunnel.
r543.description:
The tunnels branch off in a few different directions, with each of those
routes going through large webs that have been torn to shreds.  The walls
of the tunnels are covered with similiar webs.  A few bones litter the
floor of the tunnel.

descKeys: e wispy and look quite old. this tunnel must not be travelled through very much.
r544.description:
The tunnel gets very narrow here, almost making you walk sideways to fit
through.  The walls of the tunnel are covered with webs, although the webs
are wispy and look quite old.  This tunnel must not be travelled through
very much.

descKeys: ng the entire surface of the walls. this looks like it could be a lair of sorts.
r545.description:
A large scattering of bones and old bits of armor are strewn about this
part of the tunnels.  The walls of the area are covered with large webs,
just about covering the entire surface of the walls.  This looks like it
could be a lair of sorts.

descKeys: f the arachnid type. the tunnel heads back to the north towards an intersection.
r546.description:
The tunnel ends here against a stone wall to the south.  A plethera of silky
webs are around this part of the tunnel.  It seems that this area of the
Underdark is occupied by many monsters of the arachnid type.  The tunnel
heads back to the north towards an intersection.

descKeys: ls here, however it is not as thick around here as it was back to the southeast.
r547.description:
The cave tunnel takes a slight turn here, heading north.  Back to the
southeast, you see a small intersection of three tunnels, one of them heading
to the place where you are standing.  You see a thin layer of webbing covering
the walls here, however it is not as thick around here as it was back to the
southeast.

descKeys: his far into it. a tunnel seems to break lose heading west, northwest from here.
r548.description:
As you head deeper into the cave tunnel you notice that the webbing that where
so thick back to the south are almost gone here.  One can start wondering why
the spider does not want to head this far into it.  A tunnel seems to break
lose heading west, northwest from here.

descKeys: t. the bridge seems to have been there for many years as it is some holes in it.
r549.description:
The huge spider is chittering to itself.
It seems like some fighting once took place here but that must have been a
while ago, because on the ground you see some skeletons and some old rusty
weapons lying around.  A smaller tunnel breaks off heading west from here and to
the north, you see a bridge with a small underground lake beneath it.  The
bridge seems to have been there for many years as it is some holes in it.

descKeys: ld move yourself to the south, you would have some solid ground under your feet.
r550.description:
You are standing on a bridge, which runs over a small underground lake.  The
lake does not seem to be so deep but it is hard to tell when the water is
murky.  The bridge itself seems to be very old and have some holes in it; there
is a big one a bit to the north.  If you would move yourself to the south, you
would have some solid ground under your feet.

descKeys: ter is coming from. the water is dirty and you cannot tell how deep the lake is.
r551.description:
There is a big hole, north from here that might hinder your way if you are
planning to cross the bridge in that direction.  The hole seems to be too big to
jump across, so flying over it might prove to be a smart thing to do.  Under
the bridge is a small underground lake, the strange part is that you cannot see
where the water is coming from.  The water is dirty and you cannot tell how
deep the lake is.

descKeys: h ending up on each side at two big tunnels. there is a small shore to the east.
r552.description:
The filthy water in which you are swimming seems to have been poisoned;
however, you do not know from what.  Right above you, a bridge is hanging about
six feet above your head.  The bridge heads north and south ending up on each
side at two big tunnels.  There is a small shore to the east.

descKeys: gh that. a bit down in the water you notice a rock seemingly covering something.
r553.description:
The poisoned water hurts you!
There is a bridge hanging about six feet above the water, leading north and
west.  The bridge seems to have been hanging there for quite a while without
being maintained, because there are many holes in the bridge.  One of the holes
draws your attention as it seems to be very big, it would not be fun falling
through that.  A bit down in the water you notice a rock seemingly covering
something.

descKeys: y dirty, and the thought that this water is somewhat poisoned crosses your mind.
r554.description:
You are swimming under a bridge.  It seems as if the bridge have not been used
or taken care of for some centuries because there are several holes in it.  The
water in this small underground lake seems to be very dirty, and the thought
that this water is somewhat poisoned crosses your mind.

descKeys: would swim east, you would be right under a bridge that crosses this small lake.
r555.description:
The water in which you are swimming has a very bad smell that stings your
nostrils.  You start wondering if this water is poisoned or in some other way
been made unhealthy.  There seems to be a shore a bit south of here with a
tunnel leading somewhere else.  If you would swim east, you would be right
under a bridge that crosses this small lake.

descKeys: is a cave tunnel southeast from where you are standing, heading from the shore.
r556.description:
There is a small lake in front of you; it seems as if you could enter it from
here.  A strong poisoned smell stings your nostrils and you cannot tell where
it comes from.  However the water in the lake seems to be very filthy, a guess
would be that the smell is coming from there.  Entering the lake would mean a
high risk.  There is a cave tunnel southeast from where you are standing,
heading from the shore.

descKeys: son in some way. there seems to be an intersection of three tunnels to the east.
r557.description:
You are standing in a small tunnel, which seems to turn northwest from here,
heading to a small underground shore.  The air here is very damp and a strange
smell stings your nostrils.  What is comes from you cannot tell, however you
get the feeling that it is poison in some way.  There seems to be an
intersection of three tunnels to the east.

descKeys: you can see a tunnel to the west that presumably runs throughout the underdark.
r558.description:
You are in a rather large alcove in the tunnels.  Piles of bones (stripped
clean) are on the ground.  This looks like some sort of lair.  The lair of
who or what, you are not certain.  There is a strange smell around these
parts, and it totally unnerves you.  The ceiling of the alcove also looks
quite strange.  You can see a tunnel to the west that presumably runs
throughout the Underdark.

descKeys: g towards the merchant area. a small space leads east, between two large houses.
r560.description:
You are on the east side of the Northern Warrens, in the north part of Dunkrist.
This section of the city looks to be newer than most, and the road has been
recently paved.  The Warrens continue in any direction you choose to take,
with the south route leading towards the merchant area.  A small space leads
east, between two large houses.

descKeys: a for wastes and such. the air in this portion of dunkrist is none too pleasant.
r562.description:
You are standing on a small trail that has been carved directly into the rock.
