The trail leads west towards the main plaza and also east towards what looks
like to be a dumping area for wastes and such.  The air in this portion of
Dunkrist is none too pleasant.

descKeys: many invaders could get past here and into the main hub of dunkrist to the east.
r565.description:
This tunnel is heavily fortified with rows of trenches, with the walls having
niches cut into them.  Stone foundations have been erected in the middle of
the tunnel, with platforms for arches to sit upon lining the sides of the
small towers.  Not many invaders could get past here and into the main hub
of Dunkrist to the east.

descKeys: de. it is obvious to you that this part of the city holds the wealthier duergar.
r566.description:
You are near the north side of the Northern Warrens, the residential district
of the Duergar city of Dunkrist.  The houses and living quarters around here
are usually large and well-made.  It is obvious to you that this part of the
city holds the wealthier Duergar.

descKeys: ide the path, trying to exist in this harsh mountain air. some flowers are here.
r571.description:
You are walking along a narrow path that is resting in the shadow of Mt.
Kulajo, which is just east of here.  Way off to the west you can see the
beginnings of the Plains of Nereka.  Small foliage is growing beside the
path, trying to exist in this harsh mountain air.  Some flowers are here.

descKeys: s been kept in good shape for those few travelers who choose to use the roadway.
r572.description:
The small path you are walking upon is winding its way around Mt. Kulajo's
west side, running between Kal-Thax and Threshold.  Although this small road is
not used very much, it has been kept in good shape for those few travelers
who choose to use the roadway.

descKeys: arge birds circle overhead, almost trailing you in your movements down the path.
r573.description:
The mountain path, although quite sturdy, is not well-used, and you get the
distinct impression that you are the only being who has been on the road for
some time.  A few large birds circle overhead, almost trailing you in your
movements down the path.

descKeys: of being caught in one. a small path leads off from the main one, heading east.
r574.description:
You try to climb the cliff's face.
Johans instructs you.
Johans instructs you.
You finish practicing with Johans.
The side of Mt. Kulajo is very steep, with this path you are standing upon
being about a third of the way up its west side.  The peak has been known to
to have many rock slides coming down from its heights, causing you to be
more than a little alarmed at the prospect of being caught in one.  A small
path leads off from the main one, heading east.

descKeys: lds have been carved into it. it looks like this is used by many a rock climber.
notes: Johans the Climber (surface): practice climbing costs 35 coins; same start/finish/refuse texts as Drakkay
r575.description:
You are standing just east of Mt. Kulajo.  The huge mountain towers above
you, dwarfing you in its majesty.  Look at the mountain's side, you can
see that several handholds have been carved into it.  It looks like this
is used by many a rock climber.

descKeys: not known as a very hospitable race, but neither are they know as being hostile.
r576.description:
The mountainous region in which you are traipsing about has been settled by
the dwarves of Kal-Thax for centuries.  The Kal-Thax region starts about here
and runs north for many miles.  The dwarves of Kal-Thax are not known as a
very hospitable race, but neither are they know as being hostile.

descKeys: lowly growing in height and majesty. the tunnel continues unabated to the north.
r583.description:
You are standing at the beginning of a tunnel, or maybe it is the end of the
tunnel you are witnessing.  A large cavern starts here and extends to the
west, slowly growing in height and majesty.  The tunnel continues unabated
to the north.

descKeys: ded from years of exposure to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.
r584.description:
The tunnel starts to widen out here, gaining in size to the south.  Directly
in the middle of the tunnel lies a peculiar rock.  The rock is shaped like
a head, although the facial features have been rounded from years of exposure
to determine to which race the rock's visage belongs.

descKeys: tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in that direction.
r585.description:
The tunnel descends sharply downward here, going almost straight down into
the darkness.  You could easily lose your footing if you are not cautious.
A small opening in the wall to your north looks a bit out of the ordinary.
The dark tunnel continues west and even looks like it widens out a bit in
that direction.

descKeys: ely abrupt incline starts to the north. the air is dank and almost unbreathable.
r587.description:
The tunnel continues northward as usual, but sharply gets smaller to the
south, getting to the point where you will have to get on your hands and
knees and start crawling.  An extremely abrupt incline starts to the north.
The air is dank and almost unbreathable.

descKeys: rom the gate towards the throne. the gate to the south leads out into a hallway.
r610.description:
This room is totally magnificient.  The walls are dressed in a goldish-yellow
wall paper.  In the center of the room you see a three feet high throne, most
likely belonging to the resident of this room; The Grand faerny.  A thin
white carpet with gold-red engravings leads from the gate towards the throne.
 The gate to the south leads out into a hallway.

descKeys: at meanders through the trees. the moon is somewhere between breath and arrival.
r639.description:
You are at an intersection in roads.  The road travelling north and south
is about twenty feet wide, and is known as the Caravan Route.  This Route
runs from Kalinport in the south all the way up to the northern towns and
villages.  To the southeast is a small road that leads into a small town.  To
the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.

The moon is somewhere between Breath and Arrival.

descKeys: s from threshold to kalinport. the moon is somewhere between breath and arrival.
used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r640.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: s from threshold to kalinport. the moon is somewhere between breath and arrival.
used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

r736.description:
You are standing on a trail deep in the forest.  This part of the forest is
covered with many trees.  To the northwest, it seems as if the number of
trees decreases.  To the south you can see a mountain range.  The forest
seems to surround you in all directions.

The moon is somewhere between Breath and Arrival.

descKeys: d with trees to the southeast. the moon is somewhere between breath and arrival.
r737.description:
You are on a trail in the forest.  This part of the forest seems to have
less trees than the part you just came from.  The trail seems to continue
to the northwest.  To the south and west you can see a mountain range.  The
forest becomes more populated with trees to the southeast.

The moon is somewhere between Breath and Arrival.

descKeys: seems to have been used a lot. the moon is somewhere between breath and arrival.
r738.description:
You are standing on a trail in the forest.  The trees here seems to be less
in number than earlier on the trail.  To the north you can see some
smoke, and to the south you see a mountain range.  This part of the
trail seems to have been used a lot.

The moon is somewhere between Breath and Arrival.

descKeys: source of the glow. a small tunnel breaks off from the cavern to the northwest.
r951.description:
The cavern grows in size to the south, and gently diminishes to the east.  The
point of the cavern you are now in glows faintly with a greenish hue.  Looking
at the walls, you notice a strange type of fungus attached to it.  The fungus
must be the source of the glow.  A small tunnel breaks off from the cavern
to the northwest.

descKeys: caravan route between kalinport to the south and the settled lands to the north.
r1238.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r1241.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r1243.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: ch you travel is well-worn. a smithy, looking like it is closed, is to the west.
r1244.description:
The citizen tries to elbow past you.
You are travelling upon Gateway Road, which runs north and south through the
town of Threshold.  Several people bump into you as they make their way to
the town square, which lies south of your current position.  The road on which
you travel is well-worn.  A smithy, looking like it is closed, is to the west.

descKeys: your path, pausing briefly to stare at you. there is a small house to the east.
r1245.description:
Gateway Road runs north and south through Threshold.  This part of town is
used mainly for housing, judging by the closely-packed smaller buildings that
line either side of the road.  A small feline crosses your path, pausing
briefly to stare at you.  There is a small house to the east.

descKeys: ed of spiritual guidance usually go. the houses around this area seem well-made.
r1246.description:
You are travelling upon Gateway Road, which runs north towards the mountains,
and south towards the town square.  A large and gleaming church is to the west
of here, where all those in need of spiritual guidance usually go.  The houses
around this area seem well-made.

descKeys: with the western route of frontiers street leading out of town into the forests.
t of town into the forests. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1247.description:
You are now standing in Threshold's main square.  Several different types of
shops line the sides of the square.  The townsfolk can be seen hurrying around
the square with bundles under their arms, stopping occasionally to gaze into a
shop's window.  Looking around, you can see that the town's two main roads
meet at this point.  Gateway Road leads north and south, heading towards
the mountains and swamp area, respectively.  Frontiers Street goes east and
west from here.  The docks of the city are to the east, with the western
route of Frontiers Street leading out of town into the forests.

descKeys: f the establishment to the northeast, which you assume to be some sort of a bar.
e to be some sort of a bar. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1248.description:
The guard scans the crowd for possible ruffians.
Frontiers Street leads east and west, with the main town square situated a
few steps to the west.  A shop to the north of here has several customers
perusing its fine wares.  You also see a few official types enter the building
to the south.  Gazing around, you see an older man staggering out of the
establishment to the northeast, which you assume to be some sort of a bar.

descKeys: looking to the east, you see that a small library has been built there recently.
r1249.description:
A guard eyes you over as you enter Threshold.
You are standing on Gateway Road in the town of Threshold.  Buildings line
the road, packed together snugly.  The town square is a ways to the south,
with several groups of people heading towards that direction.  Off on the side
of the road is a small vendor's stand.  Looking to the east, you see that a
small library has been built there recently.

descKeys: ople are mostly human, there is a large group of demi-humans residing here also.
r1250.description:
The guard shifts uneasily in his platemail armor.
You are travelling upon Gateway Road.  The town of Threshold lies towards the
the south, while Mt. Kulajo is north of here.  Small buildings line the sides
of the road, housing Threshold's citizens.  Although the local people are
mostly human, there is a large group of demi-humans residing here also.

descKeys: t they are all in great shape, as if the town paid someone to take care of them.
r1251.description:
You head north towards the mountain range.
You are near the town of Threshold, which is a little ways to the south.  All
along the road you are travelling upon, Gateway Road, there are small bushes
lining either side of it.  The funny thing is that they are all in great
shape, as if the town paid someone to take care of them.

descKeys: visit the outlying towns and villages. a smaller road also starts to the south.
r1252.description:
The Route continues north and west, heading towards the base of some large
mountain to the north, and heading through the foothills to the west.  The road
looks to be in good repair.  A lot of travellers use this road to visit the
outlying towns and villages.  A smaller road also starts to the south.

descKeys: mt. kulajo, which is rising high above the small town of threshold to the south.
r1253.description:
This large road is used often, judging from the many footprints and cart wheel-
tracks.  Small bushes line the road, hedged into a perfect square shape.  Off
to the north you can see Mt. Kulajo, which is rising high above the small
town of Threshold to the south.

descKeys: the walls, most of the being half-full with books. gateway road is to the west.
r1254.description:
This library was funded by a local Threshold group, intent on putting a bit
more culture in Threshold.  Although it is only one small room in a tiny
building, they are set to expand it at anytime.  Several bookshelves line the
walls, most of the being half-full with books.  Gateway Road is to the west.

descKeys: of the alley, making you wonder why this roadway is not in fact called as such.
r1255.description:
You are at the beginning of Snake Alley, which is in the northern section of the
human city of Threshold.  The alley runs east and looks to curve to the south
in that direction.  Small buildings line the sides of the alley, making you
wonder why this roadway is not in fact called as such.

descKeys: as any main road. small and cheery buildings line either side of the throughway.
r1256.description:
The gang member looks at you with disinterest.
Looking around, you note that Snake Alley does not really deserve its name.
This alley is not dark and foreboding like Kraken Alley, and it is open to the
sunlight as much as any main road.  Small and cheery buildings line either side
of the throughway.

descKeys: from their personal business. a small house to the west looks vaguely familiar.
r1257.description:
Snake Alley runs north and south here, running parallel to Gateway Road to the
west.  The buildings lining either side of the large alley seem to be in good
repair.  Many citizens of Threshold live around here, with some even living
right across from their personal business.  A small house to the west looks
vaguely familiar.

descKeys: uilding. a few piles of rubbish have been piled up here, left to rot in the sun.
r1258.description:
You have reached the end of Snake Alley.  The alley runs right into a large
brick building to the south.  Looking upwards, you can see a window on the
second floor of that building.  A few piles of rubbish have been piled up here,
left to rot in the sun.

descKeys: be, and where the cooling trench was as well. back to the east is gateway road.
r1259.description:
This shop used to be owned by an armorer who specialized in unique armors and
weapons.  However, recently he moved his shop to Kalinport.  You can see where
the large anvil used to be, and where the cooling trench was as well.  Back
to the east is Gateway Road.

descKeys: a sign on the wall which can be read, but it appears to be a list of some kind.
r1260.description:
This is an old house.  You can see by the antiques around the room that
someone with a lot of years resides here.  You can see the treasures of many
an adventure on tables around the room.  There is a sign on the wall which
can be read, but it appears to be a list of some kind.

descKeys: rch leads both downwards and upwards. to the right of the altar is a small door.
r1261.description:
You are standing inside of a huge and ornate church.  Having been erected
many years earlier, the main Church of Kertaine has grown in popularity, with
new converts in many other parts of the region.  A large and exquisitely-
crafted altar is against one wall, covering the entire length of one end.
Several rows of pews are in front of the altar, able to seat over a hundred
church-goers.  A large staircase in the northeast corner of the church leads
both downwards and upwards.  To the right of the altar is a small door.

descKeys: ng from before. a large staircase is in one corner of the room, leading upwards.
r1262.description:
In the early days of the Church there was not a readily-available supply of
construction materials.  Working around this shortage, the builders of the
Church constructed passageways and rooms underneath the main building.  At
first these passageways were rough rock, but over the years with the Church
garnering more wealth, floors made from marble were put in, replacing the
dirt and rock flooring from before.  A large staircase is in one corner of
the room, leading upwards.

descKeys: ath your feet, getting between you and the hard marble floor underneath the rug.
r1263.description:
The corridor is leading in the four principal directions.  Against one wall
is a small statue of Kertaine.  Having been carved in the early days of the
Church, the statue is not very impressive, but it is considered a holy relic
by the members of the Church.  A thick carpet of cloth is beneath your feet,
getting between you and the hard marble floor underneath the rug.

descKeys: aking up about ten feet of space. a wooden footlocker is at the foot of the bed.
r1264.description:
This medium-sized room belongs to an Acolyte of the Church.  The Acolyte works
as an aid to the Patriarch, helping him with the daily runnings of the Church
and other trivial matters that the Patriarch need not concern himself with.
A small bed is in one corner of the room, taking up about ten feet of space.
A wooden footlocker is at the foot of the bed.

descKeys: he room, with a small wooden footlocker having been set at the foot of that bed.
r1265.description:
The room you are standing in belongs to a low-ranking Acolyte of the Church.
This Acolyte's main job is keeping the Church free of debris.  In short, she is
a 'glorified' janitor.  A small bed is in one corner of the room, with a small
wooden footlocker having been set at the foot of that bed.

descKeys: . a nice rug is underneath your feet, running the entire length of the corridor.
r1266.description:
You are standing in an underground corridor, situated beneath the Church of
Kertaine's main parsonage.  The corridor runs east and west, with two rooms
branching off to the north and south.  A nice rug is underneath your feet,
running the entire length of the corridor.

descKeys: the room, with the only other item of furnishing being a small chest of drawers.
r1267.description:
You are in a large, yet sparsely furnished, room that has been reserved for
the Pastor of the Church.  The Pastor is in charge of the congregation, and
knows almost all of them by their first name.  He is the one who runs the
Church services, before and after the Patriarch speaks to the assembly.  A
medium-sized bed is against one wall of the room, with the only other item
of furnishing being a small chest of drawers.

descKeys: e desk, used by visitors of the pastor. to the north is an underground corridor.
r1268.description:
This large and spacious room is used by the Pastor as his personal study.
A large wooden desk is in the middle of the room, with a large and comfortable
chair being behind that desk.  A few wooden chairs are in front of the desk,
used by visitors of the Pastor.  To the north is an underground corridor.

descKeys: room is spacious, and most of that space is not being used for anything at all.

Church of Kertaine Guild Board [ 57 mess.name: Church of Kertaine Guild Board [ 57 messages, 57 new]

r1269.description:
This room was once used as living quarters, but now it is used for storage
only.  Several crates are in here, unopened and probably impposible to do
so.  The room is spacious, and most of that space is not being used for
anything at all.

descKeys: ceiling leads to the church's bell tower. the clerestory continues to the west.
r1270.description:
The upper clerestory of the church looks down at the altar below.  Everything
is calm and serene up here as light pours in from the great stained glass
windows.  A spiral staircase leads down, and a trapdoor in the ceiling leads
to the church's bell tower.  The clerestory continues to the west.

descKeys: west is an immense window heralding the glory of the original fifteen founders.
r1271.description:
You are directly overhead the altar.  Looking down, you see that there
is a small room hidden behind the altar, perhaps used to store items used
for services.  To the west is an immense window heralding the glory of the
original fifteen founders.

descKeys: it looks like there is some sort of a swamp to the south, outside of threshold.
outh, outside of threshold. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1272.description:
You are on Gateway Road, which travels north and south through the town of
Threshold.  The town square, with all of its shops and curiosities, lies a
few steps to the north.  It looks like there is some sort of a swamp to the
south, outside of Threshold.

descKeys: o the southwest. there is also a new building that has been erected to the east.
s been erected to the east. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1273.description:
You are on Gateway Road.  This part of Threshold looks to be a small business
emporium.  Small buildings line both sides of the street.  A few people walk
past you, heading north to the main shopping area of Threshold.  A large and
empty building stands off to the southwest.  There is also a new building that
has been erected to the east.

descKeys: town council has deemed the swamp off-limits. a small shop is open to the east.
l shop is open to the east. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1274.description:
You head into Threshold.
You are standing on Gateway Road, which leads north into Threshold.  A vast
swamp is to the south, ominous and dark.  For years the swamp has been
dormant, but now it seems to be growing, with Threshold in danger of being
swallowed up by its land-eating marshes.  Since many people have mysteriously
vanished while exploring the swamp, the Threshold town council has deemed
the swamp off-limits.  A small shop is open to the east.

descKeys: ded to move elsewhere. a small storeroom is to the southeast, through a doorway.
r1275.description:
This shop used to be home to an alchemist's shop, judging from all the many
different types of bottles and beakers left behind.  It seems that the
shop's recent owners decided to move elsewhere.  A small storeroom is to the
southeast, through a doorway.

descKeys: ned shop is to the northwest, through a small archway that has seen better days.
r1276.description:
You are standing in the back room of the alchemist's shop.  Mostly empty, the
room has a few shelves on the walls and a few small boxes spread about.  The
main part of this abandoned shop is to the northwest, through a small archway
that has seen better days.

descKeys: wood stacked on them. a small staircase in the southwest corner leads downwards.
r1277.description:
The owner of this shop, Murphye Stormwood, has recently moved into town and
has convinced the town council to allow him to open this small shop.  Murphye
has a passion for woodworking, so he saved up until he could afford to open
this establishment.  Shelves are around the area with various types of wood
stacked on them.  A small staircase in the southwest corner leads downwards.

descKeys: shop. three small windows near the ceiling of the room are used for ventilation.
r1278.description:
You are in a small woodworking shop, located beneath Murphye's Woodshop, in
the town of Threshold.  Various knives and cutting tools are laying around
on the wooden tables, all of the instruments being in good shape.  A few
pedal-driven saws are around the room as well.  A layer of wood chips covers
the entire floor.  A small staircase is in the southwest corner, running up
to the shop.  Three small windows near the ceiling of the room are used for
ventilation.

descKeys: the table seem a different shade of color from the rest of the building's floor.
r1279.description:
This building has been abandoned for some years, judging by the amout of
cobwebs that are hanging around.  There is a small table and a few termite-
eaten chairs splayed about.  The floorboards under the table seem a different
shade of color from the rest of the building's floor.

descKeys: ranquil atmosphere of threshold. the notorious kraken alley starts to the south.
r1280.description:
Frontiers Street runs east and west from here.  A little ways to the east
lies the town square, where you may find a plethora of shops.  A small and
weather-beaten house is right in front of you, marring the tranquil atmosphere
of Threshold.  The notorious Kraken Alley starts to the south.

descKeys: and more stagnant than the rest of threshold. frontiers street is north of here.
r1281.description:
You are standing in the infamous Kraken Alley.  Small shapes flitter in and
out of the shadows, prompting you to move on or be accosted.  Steam is also
rising from the ground, as if this part of the town is hotter and more
stagnant than the rest of Threshold.  Frontiers Street is north of here.

descKeys: zens get their water from other and newer wells, this one is not used very much.
r1282.description:
This part of Kraken Alley is somewhat more 'lit' than the other parts of the
alley.  This must be because of the presence of a town well.  For some odd
reason, the Threshold town government decided to put the well in this dark
alley.  Since most citizens get their water from other and newer wells, this
one is not used very much.

descKeys: ses of people moving in and out of the many shadows, looking for an easy target.
r1283.description:
Kraken Alley comes to an abrupt halt here, running into a wall of rubbish
that has been heaped up beside the wall of some building.  Occasionally you
catch glimpses of people moving in and out of the many shadows, looking for
an easy target.

descKeys: scattered about the place. there is only one exit, and that is to the southeast.
r1284.description:
You are in a small establishment in a rough part of town.  From the looks of
things, this building is now not used.  Empty boxes line the floor, and litter
is scattered about the place.  There is only one exit, and that is to the
southeast.

descKeys: ular dog, smallish and feral, wags his tail when he notices you glancing at him.
r1285.description:
The guard shifts uneasily in his platemail armor.
Frontiers Street passes trough a small business district here.  It looks
like these buildings are in need of repair however.  A few people push past
you, heading for the town square to the east.  A singular dog, smallish and
feral, wags his tail when he notices you glancing at him.

descKeys: right up to the gates of threshold. a small shop catches your eye to the north.
r1286.description:
You are standing on Frontiers Street, which runs east and west.  Judging by the
flow of people to the east, you surmise that east is where the main shops are.
A lush green forest full of huge and imposing trees can be seen to the west.
The forest seems to reach right up to the gates of Threshold.  A small shop
catches your eye to the north.

descKeys: ots and lots of shelves line the walls, holding various items for you to peruse.
r1287.description:
This small shop has been here for many years, founded by a respected member
of the community, a man named Willen Noggler.  Willen was a sell-sword as
a young man, but he eventually settled down in Threshold and made a good
name for himself.  Lots and lots of shelves line the walls, holding various
items for you to peruse.

descKeys: ather boots. a small shop is to the north, but it looks like it has closed down.
r1288.description:
details.
The buildings here which line Frontiers Street are of newer design.  People
bustle by you, generally heading east.  The road on which you stand is made
of rough, packed dirt.  Looking down at the grubby roadway, you suddenly wish
you had chosen to wear your hard leather boots.  A small shop is to the
north, but it looks like it has closed down.

descKeys: feet into the air. the edge of the forest reaches right up to the city's gates.
r1289.description:
Frontiers Street begins here and runs east, towards the main part of Threshold.
A large and deep forest is to the west of here, with huge trees rising
hundreds of feet into the air.  The edge of the forest reaches right up to the
city's gates.

descKeys: arge path that leads southwest, away from threshold. a large berry bush is here.
r1290.description:
You go west, heading for the forest.
A large and green forest full of huge trees begins to the west.  The small
town of Threshold is to the east, waiting to be perused.  The trees of the
forest look unnaturally large, as if someone had fed them some secret diet
of tree food.  There is a large path that leads southwest, away from Threshold.
A large berry bush is here.

descKeys: ry tall heights, towering far above your head. a large road is to the northwest.
r1291.description:
The squirrel chitters nervously.
This small path is leading northeast and northwest from here.  It seems that
a small town is to the east a ways, probably Threshold.  The forest is all
around you, with the trees growing to very tall heights, towering far above
your head.  A large road is to the northwest.

descKeys: leads into a small town. to the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.
r1292.description:
You are at an intersection in roads.  The road travelling north and south
is about twenty feet wide, and is known as the Caravan Route.  This Route
runs from Kalinport in the south all the way up to the northern towns and
villages.  To the southeast is a small road that leads into a small town.  To
the west is a trail that meanders through the trees.

descKeys: can see a large mountain range, and to the north of here are some rolling hills.
r1293.description:
You are on the main Caravan Route that runs throughout the eastern portion
of the Kalin continent.  At this time, the Route is running through a large
forest known as the Great Forest.  Up towards the northeast you can see a
large mountain range, and to the north of here are some rolling hills.

descKeys: d repair, considering the large amount of traffic that passes over it every day.
r1294.description:
The Caravan Route is running through many trees, twisting around them in an
orderly fashion.  The road itself is made from packed dirt, and looks to be
in good repair, considering the large amount of traffic that passes over it
every day.

descKeys: ike it is used quite often by travellers heading to and from towns and villages.
r1295.description:
You are on the Caravan Route, heading in an area that is between the Great
Forest to the south and the Absinthe Mountain Range to the north and north-
east.  The road is about twenty feet wide, and looks like it is used quite
often by travellers heading to and from towns and villages.

descKeys: you sense that by heading to the north, the elevation would rise significantly.
r1296.description:
The Route is passing through the buffer area between the Great Forest and
the large mountain range to the north.  A few trees are around, but they are
generally smaller than the ones to the south.  You sense that by heading to
the north, the elevation would rise significantly.

descKeys: bris. the surface of the road is smooth and looks relatively free from potholes.
r1297.description:
The Caravan Route curves here, heading both south towards a large forest, and
northeast towards a huge mountain range.  The sides of the roads are free of
brush and any other debris.  The surface of the road is smooth and looks
relatively free from potholes.

descKeys: eading to the northeast towards the mountains, and southwest towards the forest.
r1298.description:
You are just south of the Absinthe Mountain Range, travelling on the large and
expansive Caravan Route.  To the south, in the distance, you can see the start
of a large forest.  The road is heading to the northeast towards the mountains,
and southwest towards the forest.

descKeys: of 'highlands' area. past them to the northeast is the absinthe mountain range.
r1299.description:
The Route is heading east and west here, travelling remarkably straight.  To
the north you can spot some of the rolling hills, and near them looks to be
a sort of 'highlands' area.  Past them to the northeast is the Absinthe
Mountain Range.

descKeys: f you look closely through the trees to the southeast, you can see a small town.
r1300.description:
You are on the Caravan Route, travelling either east or west through a large
and expansive forest.  The trees in this area are very large, and have been
known to fall across the road now and again.  If you look closely through
the trees to the southeast, you can see a small town.

descKeys: the east you can see the route travelling through the trees of the great forest.
r1301.description:
The Route is running east and west here, but you can see that it curves to the
right if you were to head west.  That direction looks like it leads towards
a large and open plains area.  Back to the east you can see the Route
travelling through the trees of the Great Forest.

descKeys: t direction must head towards some sort of plains, perhaps the plains of nereka.
r1302.description:
This part of the Caravan Route is running through a large forest.  Towards the
east the trees get a lot thicker, but to the northwest they seem to fade out
until there are none about.  That direction must head towards some sort of
plains, perhaps the Plains of Nereka.

descKeys: outheast, but seems to also head towards an open area to the west and northwest.
r1303.description:
You are on the Caravan Route.  This part of the Route is nestled between
several small trees of the Great Forest.  The Route heads back into the
Forest to the southeast, but seems to also head towards an open area to the
west and northwest.

descKeys: and smells of nature. this wouldnt be a bad place to settle down at some point.
r1304.description:
You are standing in what appears to be a small clearing jsut outside of the
town of Threshold.  There is a small cottage here, and what appears to be a
garden off to the east.  All around you are the sounds and smells of nature.
This wouldnt be a bad place to settle down at some point.

descKeys: d potato plant. the smells coming from this garden are pleasant to your nostrils
r1305.description:
You are standing in what appears to be a small garden.  This garden looks to
have many different types of plants in it, some of which might be useful for
cooking some food.  You notice in particular the following plants: tomato
plant, carrot plant, celery plant, bean plant, and potato plant.  The smells
coming from this garden are pleasant to your nostrils

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r1306.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r1307.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort

Several ships are moored here, waiting to have their cargo unloaded, and then
sold in the city's open markets.  One ship, a three-masted schooner, catches
eyes with its gaily-colored sails.

used by Kalinport Merchants to prepare their Caravans for the long journey
to the northern regions.  A large tent-like material has been stretched

You are in the southern end of the Kalinport Stables.  These stables have

This is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.

This is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.
Abue Street ends to the west, running up against a large stone wall.  The wall

r1448.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

r1450.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

r1452.description:
You are in the Absinthe Mountain Range, travelling on the Caravan Route.
At this point, you are near the lower edge of the range, as the elevation is
only perhaps a thousand feet or so.  Way to the south you can spot the trees
of the Great Forest.

r1453.description:
The Caravan Route is heading east and west here, travelling through the
lower edge of the Absinthe Mountain Range.  The mountains, which are directly
to the north, rise high up into the sky.  The Route looks like it winds its
way around those mountains, heading to the northern villages.

This part of the Route is heading east and west.  A ways to the east you can
see where the road abruptly turns to the north.  Along the side of the road
is a small bush, looking quite forlone by itself.  However, it looks like
someone tends to it, as it is perfectly round.

descKeys: th the rest of the continent. at this point, the route is heading east and west.
r1455.description:
The Caravan Route is used by many people who are travelling between villages
and cities.  The road was constructed a few years after the Great War in order
to connect some of the outlying villages with the rest of the continent.  At
this point, the Route is heading east and west.

r1456.description:
The road is heading east and west here.  To the east you can see where it turns
to the north, climbing higher into the Absinthe Mountains.  Back to the west
you can see that the road turns to the left, heading south back towards the
large forest.

r1457.description:
This is the meeting room of the Threshold Militia.  A few long wooden tables
have been set up in the center of the room, with wooden chairs set around
those tables.  A map of the town is covering the entire eastern wall, having
been painted there many years ago.  On the western wall, a large plaque
hangs.  The Militia's headquarters continue to the north.

descKeys: and a plaque is on another. the door to the north leads out to frontiers street.
r1458.description:
The small building you are currently in is used by the Threshold populace as
a sort of town 'hall'.  The term is used roughly, as the building is not much
larger than Willen's shop, and is quite smaller than the Viper's Nest.  In one
corner of the room is a desk, used by the town's one clerk.  Usually he can
be found drinking at the Nest, though.  A large sign is on one wall, and a
plaque is on another.  The door to the north leads out to Frontiers Street.

r1459.description:
You succeed in prying up the floorboard, laying discovery to a small and
dark passageway underneath the building.  Looking around swiftly to see if
anyone is around, you lower yourself into the tunnel, replacing the floorboard.
The small and dark tunnel you are in has been here for many years, it seems.
The tunnel was hollowed out by skilled artisans, probably dwarves.  Looking
up, you can see light streaming through the floorboards of the building
that is above your head.  The boards are hinged, so it should be no problem
going up into the building.  Glancing down the tunnel, you can faintly see
a greenish light at the supposed end to this tunnel.  It should be easy to
head that way and see what the light is.

the entrance to this tunnel.  Slipping past the bush, you discover yourself
in a swamp.  Turning around, you cannot find the particular bush you just
came through.
The swamp is certainly adept at doing what it does best: Making you stink.
Catching a whiff of yourself, you decide that a nice bath would be nice.
The swamp is cut off by densely-packed trees to the north and west.  A large
forest blossoms off in that direction.

to where you are standing.  The bank of the lake runs about fifteen feet

the underbrush on the eastern side of the path.  The footprints are very
close together, so you assume that they have been left by some kind of
reptile.  As you stand here looking at the footprints, a rather strong breeze
whisps through the swamp.  The underbrush on the eastern side of the path
isn't as dense as the other parts of the swamp.  You can see the Kendrite Sea
through the eastern underbrush.  You can follow the small path towards the
north and south.

descKeys: impse of the kendrite sea. you can follow this path towards the north and south.
r1503.description:
The gator stares at you, not moving in the slightest.
The small path is getting quite difficult to follow.  The path is very muddy,
and lots of the underbrush is growing up onto the path.  There are lots of
large trees growing up out of the swamp, and reaching high up into the sky.
The trees have lots of dark moss hanging off of the limbs, which block out a
lot of the sun light.  East of the path, you can see through the underbrush
and you catch a quick glimpse of the Kendrite Sea.  You can follow this path
towards the north and south.

descKeys: but you can see the outermost parts of the sea, where it meets with the horizon.
r1504.description:
The small path that you have been following takes a turn here towards the
south and west.  There is lots of underbrush and trees surrounding the path.
As you try to walk through the underbrush you quickly find yourself caught
and decide to stay on the path.  Through the eastern underbrush you can see
lots of light shining in from the Kendrite Sea.  It is tough to see the whole
sea but you can see the outermost parts of the sea, where it meets with the
horizon.

descKeys: be able to get a better glimpse at what lies beyond the boundaries of the swamp.
r1505.description:
The ground on this part of the path is very damp and muddy.  You feel a
slight breeze rush through the swamp, the cold brisk air feels good on your
face.  You can see a small lake towards the southwest.  The small path you're
on heads towards the east and west.  As you look down the eastern path and
through some of the underbrush you can see some kind of light coming in.  If
you head further towards the east, you might be able to get a better glimpse
at what lies beyond the boundaries of the swamp.

descKeys: the lake. the small path you're on now also continues towards the east and west.
r1506.description:
The lizard man has a gleam in his eyes that you find unnerving.
You are two or three steps away from the northeastern bank of the lake.  The
water in the lake is very muddy and looks quite stagnant.  Amongst the plant
life that is living and growing on the bank of the lake, you can see tons of
insects skimming across the top of the water.  Out in the middle of the lake
the water isn't moving at all.  You can head south along the eastern bank of
the lake.  The small path you're on now also continues towards the east and
west.

descKeys: he eastern side of the path the underbrush is quite thick, and looks impassable.
r1507.description:
The small lake is just to the west of you.  As you look out over the lake,
you see a small fish jump out of the water.  There doesn't seem to be much
life out in the small lake though, because the majority of the lake is very
calm.  The path has eroded quite a bit into the bank of the lake.  The small
path stretches on towards the north and south.  On the eastern side of the
path the underbrush is quite thick, and looks impassable.

descKeys: he small path wraps around the lake towards the north and back towards the west.
r1508.description:
You are on the southeastern side of the small lake.  The small path runs
right next to the muddy bank of the lake.  On the bank there are all kinds of
strange vegetation thriving.  As you glare out into the depths of the lake
you can't see anything due to the murky water.  There are tons of small
insects that are out in the lake on an endless quest searching for food.  The
small path wraps around the lake towards the north and back towards the west.

descKeys: the underbrush towards the south allowing you to head in that direction as well.
r1509.description:
The lizard man licks his lips.
You find yourself located directly south of the small lake.  There is a lot
of vegetation on the southern bank of the lake, as you glance around the rest
of the lake you notice that there is a lot of vegetation around it.  There is
a small path around the circumfrence of the lake that you can follow.  From
here you can follow the path towards the east and west.  There is an opening
in the underbrush towards the south allowing you to head in that direction as
well.

descKeys: te a bit. down towards the southeast and southwest the path looks quite arduous.
r1510.description:
You find yourself amidst the thick glade, and it is quite difficult to find
your way in this part of the swamp.  There are openings towards the north,
southwest, and southeast.  There are lots of branches, bushes, and other
types of underbrush making your trek through here quite difficult.  You can
head towards the north, where the path opens up quite a bit.  Down towards
the southeast and southwest the path looks quite arduous.

descKeys: s it is here. you can also head towards the south where it opens up quite a bit.
r1511.description:
The lizard man licks his lips.
The lizard man licks his lips.
The underbrush here is very thick and you don't have much room to maneuver
yourself safely.  Everyway you look there are lots of branches and other
types of underbrush in your face.  There is a lot of water on the ground here
as well.  There is an opening through the glade towards the south and
northwest.  Northwest of here it looks just as cluttered with underbrush as
it is here.  You can also head towards the south where it opens up quite a
bit.

descKeys: just enough room for you to make it. the small path also extends east and west.
r1512.description:
This small path has a lot of vegetation growing on it and all around it.  The
ground is quite moist here, and it seems as if the path has been flooded
recently.  There is an opening in the swamp on the northern side of this
path, it is very small and looks like it will be a tight fit, but there seems
to be just enough room for you to make it.  The small path also extends east
and west.

descKeys: arked off by more swamp water, but you see that you can travel back to the west.
r1513.description:
You are standing on a small path that is elevated above the level of the
swamp water.  The path is a bit muddy, but you are about two or three feet
above the murky water that lies to the north and south of the path.  There is
lots of underbrush and other types of vegetation sprouting out of the murky
waters, making it impossible to leave the path.  The path leads to a dead-end
marked off by more swamp water, but you see that you can travel back to the
west.

descKeys: head in it will look similar to here. the small path also extends east and west.
r1514.description:
This small path has a lot of vegetation growing on it and all around it.  The
ground is quite moist here, and it seems as if the path has been flooded
recently.  As you glance around this part of the swamp, it appears that no
matter which direction you head in it will look similar to here.  The small
path also extends east and west.

descKeys: west. towards the west the path slopes down a bit and the path has been flooded.
r1515.description:
A baby alligator scurries across the path as you arrive.  The water on the
northern and southern side of the path are getting very close to reaching
your feet.  On the southern side of the path the underbrush is too thick to
get through, but on the northern side it is very possible for you to walk
through it safely.  You can also follow this path east and west.  Towards the
west the path slopes down a bit and the path has been flooded.

descKeys: inues, south of here though it opens up and looks like much easier travel there.
r1516.description:
The gator stares at you, not moving in the slightest.
You quickly find yourself in quite a sticky situation.  The path has
completey disappeared from beneath you, and you are lost in the vicious
underbrush of the swamp.  There are all kinds of underbrush poking, sticking,
and scratching you as you manage to make your way through here.  There are
openings towards the south and northeast.  Up towards the northeast it looks
like the glade continues, south of here though it opens up and looks like
much easier travel there.

descKeys: ou can follow the small path around the lake, it leads north and east from here.
r1517.description:
You are on the southern side of the small lake.  From here you can almost see
the whole lake.  There are some small insects that are skimming around the
surface of the water, but besides that there doesn't seem to be any type of
life.  On the bank of the lake there are lots of cat-tails that obstruct your
vision of the lake, but they are quite interesting plants and bring somekind
of a beauty to this place.  You can follow the small path around the lake, it
leads north and east from here.

descKeys: ng from the murky water. you can head north or south along the bank of the lake.
r1518.description:
There is a small lake that lies just to the east of you.  There doesn't look
to be any kind of life within the lake.  There is no movement in the water,
except a couple small ripples coming from the small insects that are skimming
across the surface of the water looking for some kind of food.  The muddy
eastern bank is about five or six feet from the path you're walking on.  On
the bank there are some large cat-tails protruding from the murky water.  You
can head north or south along the bank of the lake.

descKeys: of the lake. there is a small path that leads towards the east and west as well.
r1519.description:
You are located on the northwestern edge of the small lake.  The bank of the
lake is just just a couple steps towards the southeast.  The bank looks very
muddy, and there is quite a bit of plant life living within the bank of the
lake.  Out in the middle of the lake there isn't much movement in the waters,
except for a small group of insects skimming the top of the water looking for
food.  You can head south around the outside of the lake.  There is a small
path that leads towards the east and west as well.

descKeys: ed lake amongst the thick underbrush that strives in the moist and damp climate.
r1520.description:
The water from the small lake that is located just southeast of you is
flooding it's banks, and is making it rather hard to follow the small path
through the vicious swamp.  There are some trees north of the path, they all
have a large amount of dark moss hanging off of their limbs.  Glancing down
towards the southeast, you can see a decent sized lake amongst the thick
underbrush that strives in the moist and damp climate.

descKeys: of this part of the path. you can head towards the east or west along the path.
r1521.description:
The small path that you are following through the thick swamp is beginning to
be submerged by some of the surrounding waters.  The underbrush is very thick
on the northern and southern sides of the path making it impossible to leave
the path and venture elsewhere in the swamp.  As you glance into the
surrounding glade, it looks as if there might be some kind of pond or lake
southeast of this part of the path.  You can head towards the east or west
along the path.

descKeys: n the eastern path it looks as if the water from the bogs are flooding the path.
r1522.description:
The swamp seems as if it is closing in around you.  There are lots of small
insects buzzing around you.  The small path leading through the swamp is very
muddy and there's lots of water flooding up onto the path.  There are lots of
large trees situated around the path, and all of them have dark moss plaguing
them.  You can head east or west along the small path, down the eastern path
it looks as if the water from the bogs are flooding the path.

descKeys: nts scattered about. a large lake can be seen to the west. a tree is right here.
r1523.description:
You have run into yet another bog.  The large swampy lake extends south from
here, cutting off your route that way.  The bog is filled with large and
small animals, as evident by the many footprints scattered about.  A large
lake can be seen to the west.  A tree is right here.

descKeys: g how you will ever get those stains out. a small lake can be seen to the south.
r1524.description:
The slimy muck gets a little deeper here, causing you to have to wade through
it and get even more dirtier.  You glance down at your clothes with disgust
and loathing, wondering how you will ever get those stains out.  A small lake
can be seen to the south.

descKeys: wildlife reach your ears. two large birds fly overhead, skimming the tree tops.
r1525.description:
The swamp seems to go on forever, with no end in sight.  If it was not for
all of this muck laying around, this swamp would not be half bad.  Nice big
green trees are here and there, and sounds of wildlife reach your ears.
Two large birds fly overhead, skimming the tree tops.

descKeys: f the swamp is very quiet, as if every animal has fled the area. a tree is here.
r1526.description:
The swamp's ground gets a little more solid here, allowing you to bring your
feet out of the muck and slime.  Looking towards your feet, you spot several
very large footprints on the solid ground.  This part of the swamp is very
quiet, as if every animal has fled the area.  A tree is here.

descKeys: here. there is a large tree to your right, its branches hanging over your head.
r1527.description:
This part of the swamp is even more putrid-smelling than the rest.  The nasty
smell seems to originate from the south, wafting to your nostrils by way of
the soft marshy breeze.  Several large footprints are on the ground here.
There is a large tree to your right, its branches hanging over your head.

descKeys: h the constant annoyance of the myriads of mosquitos that continuously bite you.
r1528.description:
You are standing at the end of the swamp path.  You cannot head any further
towards the south, east, or west.  The underbrush that surrounds you is so
dense, that the only way you can travel is back up towards the north.  It is
quite difficult trying to trek through this swamp, especially with the
constant annoyance of the myriads of mosquitos that continuously bite you.

descKeys: rshy swamp. looking a bit to the south, you only spot the swamp going on and on.
r1529.description:
The swamp is riddled with sinkholes, as you almost find out first hand where
they lead when you almost fall into one that appeared right in front of you.
Caution should be in use as you traverse this marshy swamp.  Looking a bit
to the south, you only spot the swamp going on and on.

descKeys: h, where it will eventually lead into the main section of the reptiloid village.
n of the reptiloid village. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1530.description:
The path is becoming a bit smaller as the murky waters from the surrounding
swamp are creeping up.  While you are walking around the small path, a small
lizard scurries away into the water that is next to the path.  Towards the
south, you see this path intersect with another one.  You can also follow
this path to the north, where it will eventually lead into the main section
of the reptiloid village.

descKeys: at is sprawling all over the small path. this path heads to the north and south.
ads to the north and south. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1531.description:
You are standing in the midst of the small reptiloid village.  There are lots
of reptiloids wandering all around this part of the swamp.  You walk
extremely carefully to avoid all of the plant life that is sprawling all over
the small path.  This path heads to the north and south.

descKeys: you can see the entrance to the village. this path heads to the north and south.
ads to the north and south. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1532.description:
You are south of the main path of the reptiloid village.  There are lots of
reptiloids wandering about north of here.  The path is rather small, and you
can't head east or west, because all of the plant life on either side of you
is very thick.  Off towards the west, through the swamp you can see the
entrance to the village.  This path heads to the north and south.

descKeys: ned down by some kind of beast. the small path also heads back towards the east.
r1533.description:
You are directly south of Lena Lake.  There is lots of vegetation growing on
the bank of the lake so you can't see much of the lake itself.  You hear a
bit of the water splashing from somewhere in the plants, but you can't detect
what is causing it.  West of you, there is a strange opening in the swamp.
All of the trees, underbrush, and bushes have been flattened down by some
kind of beast.  The small path also heads back towards the east.

descKeys: a home. you would assume that the actual lair of the dragon is towards the west.
r1534.description:
The lizard man licks his lips.
You are standing in a large opening in the swamp, that looks to be a home to
some kind of dragon.  There aren't any trees, underbrush, or any other type
of shrubbery around and it seems as if the beast that lives in this area has
cleared all of it out for a home.  You would assume that the actual lair of
the dragon is towards the west.

descKeys: er recovered. it is said that a huge wyrm of some sort makes the swamp its home.
t makes the swamp its home. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1536.description:
The swamp starts here and stretches for many mile to the south and southwest.
Many hardy types have poked around in the swamp over the years, and most of
their bodies were never recovered.  It is said that a huge Wyrm of some sort
makes the swamp its home.

descKeys: looking quite dangerous. to the north you can barely see the gates of threshold.
see the gates of threshold. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1537.description:
You are now standing knee-deep in a foul mudpit.  The mud has collected here
over the last few rain showers, and is in no hurry of leaving.  A large swamp
can be seen to the south, looking quite dangerous.  To the north you can barely
see the gates of Threshold.

descKeys: south as far as the eye can see. a few dead ferns line either side of the road.
ne either side of the road. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r1538.description:
You head into the treacherous swamp.
The road turns into a muddy mess here, getting even muddier to the south.  To
the north you can see the gates of Threshold, a human settlement.  A large and
dreary swamp stretches out to the south as far as the eye can see.  A few
dead ferns line either side of the road.

descKeys: lso travel along either of the two paths that head in the northernly directions.
r1540.description:
You are at the start/end of the large Caravan Route, which leads southwest of
here towards the southern part of Kalin.  Mt. Kulajo looms before you, jutting
its spired peak far into the sky.  Besides the large road leading south, you
can also travel along either of the two paths that head in the northernly
directions.

descKeys: ce tend to its upkeep. this part of the road is heading northeast and southwest.
r1541.description:
This Route is a often-used roadway.  Many people use this route to travel
between most of the northern villages and towns.  The road itself is in great
shape, as if the local populace tend to its upkeep.  This part of the road
is heading northeast and southwest.

descKeys: must take good care the road. a ways to the east you can spot the kendrite sea.
r1542.description:
You are on a Caravan Route, which is running northeast and also southwest.  It
looks like a small town is to the south a ways.  The sides of the road are in
good shape, as the local populace must take good care the road.  A ways to
the east you can spot the Kendrite Sea.

descKeys: a desk is in the middle of the room, with a couple of chairs set in front of it.
r1543.description:
This is the recruiter's office for the Guild.  This young but skilled member
of the Assassin's Guild has only been in the guild for a short time, but in
that short time he has taken out many a top target with unparralled skill
and cunning.  A desk is in the middle of the room, with a couple of chairs
set in front of it.

descKeys: s of renegade assassins, who need to be taken out and dumped into the kalin sea.
r1544.description:
This is the meeting room of the Assassin's Guild.  A few tables have been
set in the middle of the room, with wooden chairs set around those tables.
Although the Guild is small in number, meetings are held regularly, to make
sure no unsanctioned assassinations have taken place, and to inform all of
the guild members of renegade assassins, who need to be taken out and dumped
into the Kalin Sea.

descKeys: est and you can also exit the guild, heading into a tunnel underneath kalinport.
r1545.description:
You are standing in the infamous and deadly Assassin's Guild.  Only members
of the Guild are allowed in here, all others are instantly killed to keep the
secret of its location.  A few more rooms of the guild are to the west and
you can also exit the guild, heading into a tunnel underneath Kalinport.

descKeys: n in shadows. on the western wall is an interesting small hole, about midway up.
r1546.description:
The small tunnel seems to end here.  However, you can still go back to the
south.  Looking closer at the eastern wall, you see that you can indeed go
that way, the exit was just hidden in shadows.  On the western wall is an
interesting small hole, about midway up.

descKeys: quite odd, as you wonder how it can even hold up the ceiling without collapsing.
r1547.description:
The tunnel ends here, right up against a building's foundation.  It looks like
you can only head to the west, where the tunnel turns again to the south.  The
walls of this tunnel are quite odd, as you wonder how it can even hold up the
ceiling without collapsing.

descKeys: lem. the tunnel continues to the north, where it looks like it may end abruptly.
r1548.description:
You are in a small tunnel, right below a manhole.  The manhole is about five
feet above your head, but there are cuts in the wall that should allow you to
go up with no problem.  The tunnel continues to the north, where it looks
like it may end abruptly.

descKeys: caravan route between kalinport to the south and the settled lands to the north.
r1549.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r1565.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r1566.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and

r1716.description:
You are standing somewhere in the Kalamshite Desert.  Huge sand dunes are
all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.

descKeys: ounds drift inside the shop from the diamond. there is a small sign on the wall.
r1729.description:
To the north is a single door, keeping the weather outside and the comfort
inside. Looking around, the walls have an interesting bumpy texture, colored
with bright colors behind the shelves of items for sale. The floor is an
obsidian like material, pure black, but no scratches exist. A counter leaves
part of the southern section of the room cut off, and a door behind it. The
door has in bright red, "Stockroom, Employees only." Under it, slightly
smaller type, reads, "Trespassers shot, Survivors shot again." Sounds drift
inside the shop from the Diamond.

There is a small sign on the wall.

descKeys: the city, to the west and northwest. the city sprawls out as far as you can see.
r1730.description:
The Kalinport Harbor stretches out before you, the largest you have ever seen.
Ships and sailing vessels of all shapes and sizes are docked in the harbor.
You can see the rest of Kalinport, the city, to the west and northwest.  The
city sprawls out as far as you can see.

r1748.description:
You are just south of a large house.  The large house is tall and bold, with
several large windows on each of its faces.  It is made out of packed stone
and dirt, and looks fairly new.  On the front side of this dwelling there is
a medium-sized door that presumably leads inside, with a small plaque beside
the door that states 'Zakath'.

r1749.description:
You touch the red stone and are transported instantly to Dunagin!
You are standing at an intersection of two roads.  To the north is Sailor
avenue, which heads into the main part of Dunagin.  To the east is the sea
and to the west is part of the city.  If you move to the east, it will lead
you back to the docks.  To the south there is a building.

descKeys: s you that this is a harbor city, and that they respect the sailors most of all.
r1750.description:
You are standing on Sailor Avenue, the main road through Dunagin.  To the
south you can see the docks, to the north you can see the rest of the city
of Dunagin.  Off to the east you can catch a glimpse of the Sea of Honshale.
The road that you are on now shows you that this is a harbor city, and that
they respect the sailors most of all.

descKeys: about the quality of their drink, and that is how this place stays in business.
r1751.description:
You are in the famous Cap'n Hook's pub.  This place is not known for its
high quality drinks, but the prices are reasonable.  By the time that most
of the sailors get into the harbor, they are not too picky about the quality
of their drink, and that is how this place stays in business.

descKeys: an othello game. situated in the middle of the room is a table with two chairs.
r1752.description:
This is a game room above Cap'n Hook's Pub in Dunagin.  There is not much
to this room, but supposedly there are plans to expand the room and put in more
gaming opportunities.  Apparently this is the room is used for many an Othello
game.  Situated in the middle of the room is a table with two chairs.

an old rugged mat, one of the windows is missing and there are chunks of
wood missing from the counter, showing that there was an armed robbery that

their contracts.  Only the toughest marks are allowed to be displayed in
the trophy case.  One of the other walls is layered with weapons and armor
taken from the mark's corpse.
