r1804.description:
You are on a beach in the south side of the Kalinport poor section.  The beach
is very dirty, and is in a total state of neglect.  Homeless people probably
use this as a sleeping area, or worse.  The water of the Kalin Sea is warm,
but looks grimy and full of filth.  A large street, Sorelle Avenue, starts
a few steps to the west.  You see some plants in the water.

descKeys: relle avenue. the beach continues to the east. you see some plants in the water.
r1805.description:
The sand of the beach is a bit more white than the regular sand that you
see through the rest of Kalinport.  This must be from the constant erosion
that the Kalin Sea provides.  Back to the west you can see a large street
called Sorelle Avenue.  The beach continues to the east.  You see some plants
in the water.

descKeys: into the water and vanishes from sight. right off the shore you see some plants.
r1806.description:
The beach curves here, heading both west and also back to the northeast.  The
water is warm, you can tell, but totally uninviting.  No telling what the
local populace dump into it.  A small crab, braving the filth, scurries into
the water and vanishes from sight.  Right off the shore you see some plants.

descKeys: elling east or southwest. you can see some plants in the water, right off shore.
r1807.description:
This part of the beach, strangely, is devoid of trash, unlike the rest of the
sandy beach.  Someone or something must clean this area up regularly.  Not
coming up with anything to explain the situation, you decide to move on
and head down the beach, travelling east or southwest.  You can see some
plants in the water, right off shore.

descKeys: h, is a small path that leads off to the northeast. you see plants in the water.
r1808.description:
You are on a sandy beach that is northeast of the Kalinport Harbor.  The water
that you see is blackish and uninviting.  You do not care to get in the water,
as you could not tell what could be in it.  To the north, past the beach, is
a small path that leads off to the northeast.  You see plants in the water.

descKeys: f the ruins. rumors of disease and plague are being whispered about those ruins.
r1809.description:
You are on a small path that is leading northeast towards the old Ruins, and
also south towards the beach.  The path is hardly ever used anymore, as
people tend to stay out of the Ruins.  Rumors of disease and plague are being
whispered about those Ruins.

descKeys: chaos, but nothing has been proven. the path leads both northeast and southwest.
r1810.description:
You are close to the Ruins, the oldest part of Kalinport.  Long abandoned, the
Ruins is now a breeding ground for decay.  Some say that a secretive and
evil organization is behind all the chaos, but nothing has been proven.  The
path leads both northeast and southwest.

descKeys: dings and rotted pieces of wood. a small path leads southwest towards the beach.
r1811.description:
You are directly south of the 'Ruins', an old part of Kalinport.  You see the
shells of several large buildings.  Most of the roofs are gone, as they are
open to the air.  The ground is littered with bits of buildings and rotted
pieces of wood.  A small path leads southwest towards the beach.

descKeys: before that time. some speculate that dark forces were at work when it happened.
r1812.description:
You are in the Ruins, the oldest part of Kalinport.  Many years ago a large
tidal wave slammed into this area and totally destroyed it.  No one knows
why or how that wave happened, as it has never happened since, or before
that time.  Some speculate that dark forces were at work when it happened.

descKeys: who or what started the fire. to the west is a small shop, abandoned of course.
r1813.description:
You are in the Kalinport Ruins, the oldest part of the city.  Here and there
you can see abandoned buildings, mostly destroyed.  Strangely enough, there
is a small fire right in the middle of this area.  There is no telling who
or what started the fire.  To the west is a small shop, abandoned of course.

descKeys: bandoned buildings are around this area, but nothing scary jumps out to get you!
r1814.description:
You are in the northern section of the Ruins of Kalinport.  Strange rumors of
'things' that kill in the night have been whispered about this place, but you
do not think it could be that bad.  A few abandoned buildings are around this
area, but nothing scary jumps out to get you!

descKeys: ly more than a path. a ways off to the southwest you can spot an abandoned shop.
r1815.description:
You are in the Kalinport Ruins, on a small 'road' that is leading east and
west, and also branches off to the south, where it curves again to the right.
Calling this a 'road' is a stretch, as it is barely more than a path.  A ways
off to the southwest you can spot an abandoned shop.

descKeys: it is any more. a ways to the west you can see a small shop, probably abandoned.
r1816.description:
The Ruins continue here, you can head either north or back to the west.  A
large wooden cart is here, rotted almost to nothing.  The road you are on is
in shambles, and hardly resembles what it is any more.  A ways to the west
you can see a small shop, probably abandoned.

descKeys: the emptiness starts to get to you, causing you to jump at the slightest noise.
r1817.description:
You are in a ruined shop, long-ago destroyed.  Most of the wood that was in
here (probably making up some shelves) is gone, probably taken for firewood
by the local populace.  Not much is here, and the emptiness starts to get
to you, causing you to jump at the slightest noise.

descKeys: of which are way off the mark. several buildings are here, about to topple over.
r1818.description:
The Ruins of Kalinport are said to be home to some secretive organization
that raids the local populace from time to time.  Who or what they are is up
to many interpretations, most of which are way off the mark.  Several buildings
are here, about to topple over.

descKeys: e in bad shape as well, with almost all of them about to crumble down into dust.
r1819.description:
You are on the shabby road that is running through the southeastern section
of the Kalinport Ruins.  The road is about ten feet wide, but is in terrible
condition.  The buildings around here are in bad shape as well, with almost
all of them about to crumble down into dust.

descKeys: fallen down. looking at the remains, you can see that it was once a large place.
r1820.description:
You are right beside a large and abandoned building that is to the east.  It
looks like the building was once a large home, but now it is barely a shell
of a structure, and is almost completely fallen down.  Looking at the remains,
you can see that it was once a large place.

descKeys: e jumps right in front of you and then darts away into a building to your right.
r1821.description:
The small road you are on turns here, travelling both south and west through
the Kalinport Ruins.  Abandoned buildings line the road, with some of those
buildings being mere shells of their once former selves.  A filthy and probably
lice-ridden feline jumps right in front of you and then darts away into a
building to your right.

descKeys: e east is the intersection with oasis avenue. vednyr road continues to the west.
r1823.description:
This is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.
Vednyr Road is home to the richest familes in Kalinport, besides the Pasha
himself.  Off to the east is the intersection with Oasis Avenue.  Vednyr Road
continues to the west.

descKeys: n with oasis avenue. vednyr road ends right here, only heading back to the east.
r1824.description:
This is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.
Vednyr Road is home to the richest familes in Kalinport, besides the Pasha
himself.  Off to the east is the intersection with Oasis Avenue.  Vednyr Road
ends right here, only heading back to the east.

descKeys: ny buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.
avenue and ruby way. oasis leads north and south, while ruby goes west and east.
s avenue, one of the more well-used roads in the northwest section of kalinport.
e, which travels north and south, and amarat road, which heads to the southwest.
ed for a large horn used for the warning of any enemies to the general populace.
r1825.description:
This is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.

descKeys: ue a little ways to the west. a small pile of trash is at the end of this alley.
r1826.description:
This is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.
You are in a small alley situated between several large houses.  You can
spot Oasis Avenue a little ways to the west.  A small pile of trash is at the
end of this alley.

descKeys: s avenue, one of the more well-used roads in the northwest section of kalinport.
r1828.description:
This is the middle- and upper-class section of Kalinport.  Most of the many
buildings and homes have been well-constructed using the finest of materials.
You are travelling along Oasis Avenue, one of the more well-used roads in the
northwest section of Kalinport.

descKeys: ypes. oasis avenue ends its southward trek here, but does continue to the north.
r1830.description:
You are in Kalinport's merchant section, called the Merchant's Diamond.  The
name of the area comes from the shape of the bartering and dealing center of
Kalinport: A diamond.  The Diamond is filled with merchants of various types.
Oasis Avenue ends its southward trek here, but does continue to the north.

descKeys: om. a small plaque is on one of the walls. there is a wooden door leading west .
r1831.description:
You are standing in a well-lit room of the Assassin's Guild.  Hundreds of
blood-red candles are all around the interior of the room.  The candles
are putting off a bright blue light, making the room quite bright.  A small
rug about three square feet in size has been placed in the middle of the
room.  It seems that the rug had been white at one time, but now is a deep
red in color.  Three tables are near the sides of the room.  A small plaque is
on one of the walls.
There is a wooden door leading west ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: lem. the tunnel continues to the north, where it looks like it may end abruptly.
r1832.description:
You are in a small tunnel, right below a manhole.  The manhole is about five
feet above your head, but there are cuts in the wall that should allow you to
go up with no problem.  The tunnel continues to the north, where it looks
like it may end abruptly.

descKeys: op has been here for over fifty years, having been passed on from father to son.
r1833.description:
This large shop is one of the more widely used in Kalinport.  Many shelves
are on the walls, full of goods both exotic and commonplace.  Owned by a
local, the shop has been here for over fifty years, having been passed on
from father to son.

descKeys: use while eating. a large oven is in the back, you can barely see it from here.
r1834.description:
sell?
     sell?
     sell?
You are standing in a large shop that sells and buys foodstuffs.  There is a
large counter on one end of the shop, covered with pastries of all types.
Several tables are around as well, probably put there by the owner of the
place for people to use while eating.  A large oven is in the back, you can
barely see it from here.

descKeys: ounded by water on all sides. (type 'start' to go through the creation process.)
r1835.description:
You are presently 'standing' in a room with no walls or ceilings.  The area
is basically devoid of anything, except for a sign that is floating right
in front of you.  To read the sign, type 'read sign' (without the quotes).
Glancing down through the clouds, you can faintly see a large continent that
is surrounded by water on all sides.

          (Type 'start' to go through the creation process.)

descKeys: ion, type 'choose <city>'. note: you can change your hometown later, if desired.
r1836.description:
Strating the creation process...
(Use 'stop' at any time to stop the process.)
Please enter your real name (or 'none') : Is 'none' your real name? (y or n) : Please enter your email address (or 'none') : Is 'none' your email address? (y or n) : Please enter your gender (male or female) : Is 'female' your choice of gender? (y or n) : Please choose a race ('h' to see choices) : That is not a valid race to choose from.  Choose again!
Please enter your race ('h' to see choices) : Is 'half-elf' your choice of race? (y or n) : You have been given generic abilities.  Use 'restat' to redo them.

As we are an evolving MUD, we do appreciate your help in finding any bugs or
errors that we may have missed.  We are looking for Builders, but anyone
interested will have to 'play' for a while to get a feel for the unique
systems we have here.  Please have fun and let the Admins know what you think!

*****Please type 'help newuser' for important information!*****

It is now time for you to choose where your character lives, basically your
'home town'.  To see the list of possible choices, type 'choices'.  If you
want to just choose the default for your race, just type 'exit'.  Or, when you
have reached your decision, type 'choose <city>'.

NOTE:  You can change your Hometown later, if desired.

descKeys: ademy, which all new players should go through. to leave the arena, type 'exit'.
r1837.description:
You are standing inside of a walled arena.  The ground is comprised of sand.
Above the walls lie many spectator stands, filled with cheering masses.  The
walls of the arena are too high for you to climb.  A small staircase leads down
into the arena floor.  Down those steps is a Donation room and also the famous
PowerMud Academy, which all new players should go through.

To leave the Arena, type 'exit'.

descKeys: gh for you to climb. looking around, you see evidence of a large rat population.
r1838.description:
item!
You are standing inside of a walled arena.  The ground is comprised of sand.
Above the walls lie many spectator stands, filled with cheering masses.  The
walls of the arena are too high for you to climb.  Looking around, you see
evidence of a large rat population.

r1908.description:
You vanish and then instantly appear in your homeland.
You are in a small alley off of the main road.  This alley seems to lead
east and west.  To the east you can see some sort of a building, but it is
too far away for you to tell what it is.  There are not many people in this
alley.  It seems that this part of the city is not as populated as the other
parts of the town.

descKeys: . there are a few more people in this part of the alley than at the start of it.
r1909.description:
You are in a small alley off of the main road.  This alley seems to run
east and west, and to the east you can see a building.  It appears to be
some sort of a church.  Back to the west, you can see the main road.  There
are a few more people in this part of the alley than at the start of it.

descKeys: ding is very large and has some of the most beautiful decorations you have seen.
r1910.description:
You are standing in one of the most holy spots you will see.  This is the
church of Dunagin.  The people of Dunagin are very devoted to their religion
and you can always find people around the church.  This building is very large
and has some of the most beautiful decorations you have seen.

descKeys: the south you can see the docks. there is an alley which leads off to the east.
r1911.description:
A new day dawns as the sun rises.
You are on the main road in Dunagin, which moves north and south throughout
the city.  To the north, you can see that the city becomes more populated
with trees, and to the south you can see the docks.  There is an alley which
leads off to the east.

descKeys: looking to the south you can see the docks, and the rest of the city of dunagin.
r1912.description:
The traveller looks around.
You are on the main road through the city of Dunagin, this road leads
north and south.  To the north you can see more of the city, it seems to
have more trees.  Looking to the south you can see the docks, and the rest
of the city of Dunagin.

descKeys: north you can see the rest of the city, and to the south you can see the docks.
r1913.description:
You are standing on a road that leads north and south through the city of
Dunagin.  To the east you can see some kind of a structure, and to the west
there is an alley.  Looking north you can see the rest of the city, and to
the south you can see the docks.

descKeys: u can see lots of trees, and to the south you can see the main part of the city.
r1914.description:
bartender for information.
You are in the northern part of the city of Dunagin.  The road that you
are on is the main one that moves north and south through the city.  To
the north you can see lots of trees, and to the south you can see the main
part of the city.

descKeys: suggestions, and since it is a harbor city, there are many people who visit it.
r1915.description:
You are standing in some kind of meeting place.  There has been a board
placed here for people to post and ideas about how the town of Dunagin can
accomodate people better.  This place is always open to suggestions, and
since it is a harbor city, there are many people who visit it.

descKeys: r. there are some small shops set up along the alley, and people are everywhere.
r1916.description:
You are walking through an alley off of the main road.  This alley seems
to be a busy place, so you assume that it must lead to some place that
the people of Dunagin have a need for.  There are some small shops set up
along the alley, and people are everywhere.

descKeys: is road leads you back to the docks if you go east, or into dunagin to the west.
r1917.description:
You are standing on a road that loops through the southern part of the
city of Dunagin.  To the east you can see the Bay of Frohan, which is part
of the Sea of Honshale.  To the north is the main part of Dunagin.  This road
leads you back to the docks if you go east, or into Dunagin to the west.

descKeys: itors. you can see people from many different places walking around on the road.
r1918.description:
You are standing on a road that moves through the southern part of the city
of Dunagin.  This city of Dunagin is a harbor city, and because of this it
gets many visitors.  You can see people from many different places walking
around on the road.

descKeys: you are able to use this at anytime, just make sure that you clean up the mess.
r1919.description:
You are in an open kitchen where the people of Dunagin come to cook.  Here
you can cook things for dinner, or any meal.  This room is used a lot by the
people of Dunagin.  You are able to use this at anytime, just make sure that
you clean up the mess.

descKeys: the city is in the south. there are not many people in this section of the town.
r1920.description:
You are in the northern part of the city of Dunagin.  The road that you are
on leads north and south through the city.  To the north is the forest,
and the main part of the city is in the south.  There are not many people
in this section of the town.

descKeys: these must lead to outside of the city. the road to the south leads to the city.
r1921.description:
You are at an intersection in the northern part of the city of Dunagin.
From here there are two paths that branch off and move different directions.
One path leads to the northeast, and the other to the northwest.  These must
lead to outside of the city.  The road to the south leads to the city.

descKeys: e start of some kind of a forest. all around you there are many different trees.
r1922.description:
You are on a path in the upper section of the city of Dunagin.  This part
of the city does not have any buildings that you can see.  It seems that
this area is the start of some kind of a forest.  All around you there are
many different trees.

descKeys: quite thick around here and they could be preventing you from seeing everything.
r1923.description:
You garner some energy from the Weave, feeling refreshed.
The Weave grants you a bit of power!
You garner some energy from the Weave, feeling refreshed.
You come out of your trance, as you are full.
This path that you are on seems to run east and west through the northern
part of the city of Dunagin.  There are no people or buildings that you can
see, but the trees are quite thick around here and they could be preventing
you from seeing everything.

descKeys: that surround you, except to the northwest. a wide path lies in that direction.
r1924.description:
You are in the northern section of the city of Dunagin.  The path that you
are on now seems to lead east and west.  To the east you can barely make
out some kind of structure.  In all other directions you can only see the
trees that surround you, except to the northwest.  A wide path lies in that
direction.

descKeys: d southeast. if you look through the trees carefully, you may even see the city.
r1925.description:
This path is about fifteen feet wide and is clear of any debris.  The path
looks to lead to and from a small castle, which is to the northwest.  The
coastal city of Dunagin is a ways to the south and southeast.  If you look
through the trees carefully, you may even see the city.

descKeys: ath intersects a larger path, with that larger path probably heading to dunagin.
r1926.description:
The path is heading both northwest and southeast at this point.  A ways to
the northwest you see a small castle, barely sticking up above the treeline.
Back to the southeast you see that this path intersects a larger path, with
that larger path probably heading to Dunagin.

descKeys: s back to the southeast where it eventually intersects with another larger path.
r1927.description:
You are just a hundred yards or so southeast of a small castle, set in the
middle of the forest.  The trees here are fairly large, and seem to be green
all year round.  The wide path also heads back to the southeast where it
eventually intersects with another larger path.

descKeys: he castle are open, and they look like they have not been closed in a long time.
r1928.description:
You head through the gates and arrive on a wide path.
You are right in front of a small castle.  The castle, which is a few steps
to the west, is not very large, but it looks well-defended.  The gates that
lead into the castle are open, and they look like they have not been closed
in a long time.

descKeys: aining ground for their order. a set of large gates are in the wall to the east.
r1929.description:
The Battlemage studies the ground intently.
You are in the courtyard of Gloriath Castle.  This small castle has been
here for a few centuries at least.  The original owners and builders of the
castle have been lost to time, but the organization that currently owns the
place is well-known.  The Celtian Battlemages took the castle over some time
ago and turned it into a training ground for their Order.  A set of large gates
are in the wall to the east.

descKeys: . the barracks are used to house the members of the order, between mock battles.
r1930.description:
The courtyard is a mess of activity.  There are battles going on all over the
place.  Here and there you see blood flowing.  If it is real or not, you
cannot tell.  Directly south of here is the barracks of the castle.  The
barracks are used to house the members of the Order, between mock battles.

descKeys: rrounding the gates, and it looks like the forest thickens outside of the gates.
r1931.description:
You are standing before some massive gates.  These gates help to protect
the people in the city from invaders and from any types of dangerous things
that could be out there.  There are many trees surrounding the gates, and it
looks like the forest thickens outside of the gates.

descKeys: ns of wildlife in the area, as you can see some footprints of different animals.
r1932.description:
You are walking on a trail that goes through the forest on this continent.
This forest seems to be filled with many trees, which are very tall. There
are signs of wildlife in the area, as you can see some footprints of
different animals.

descKeys: seems to be covered by leaves and an occasional footprint from a forest animal.
r1933.description:
You are in a forest on the continent of Celtia.  This forest is a very big
place, in fact the trees are so large that you can barely see the sky above.
The ground here seems to be covered by leaves and an occasional footprint
from a forest animal.

descKeys: nts all over the trail. the trees in this part of the forest are also very tall.
r1934.description:
The Weave grants you a bit of power!
You garner some energy from the Weave, feeling refreshed.
You come out of your trance, as you are full.
You seem to be located inside of a huge forest on the continent of Celtia.
This forest is rumored to be full of wandering creatures, so perhaps only
the brave should venture in this forest.  There are signs of forest animals
here, as you can see their footprints all over the trail.  The trees in this
part of the forest are also very tall.

descKeys: r things. you can see the bottom of the hole, and it is lined with sharp sticks.
r1935.description:
You are in the middle of the Castle's courtyard.  A large hole is in the
ground, looking to be about ten feet deep.  The sides of the hole are quite
slippery, lined with mud and other things.  You can see the bottom of the
hole, and it is lined with sharp sticks.

descKeys: s castle is fairly old. a ways to the south you see the main part of the castle.
r1936.description:
You are in the northernmost section of the Castle's courtyard.  The ground
is chewed up here a lot, so it is hard to traverse this area.  The walls of
the Castle have a few holes in them, as this Castle is fairly old.  A ways
to the south you see the main part of the Castle.

descKeys: he area, allowing you to smell the pine tar from the trees outside of the walls.
r1937.description:
This part of the courtyard is relatively unscathed.  The ground is not torn
up much.  It seems that this area is used for the basic instruction on tactics
and other cerebral activities.  A slight breeze is wafting through the area,
allowing you to smell the pine tar from the trees outside of the walls.

descKeys: . there is a large gate to the south that evidently leads outside of the castle.
r1938.description:
The Weave grants you a bit of power!
You come out of your trance, as you are full.
The Battlemage studies the ground intently.
You are on the eastern side of the Castle's courtyard.  The walls here seem
fairly stable, but looks could be deceiving.  The ground is completely torn
up and looks like many a battle has been waged on this spot.  There is a
large gate to the south that evidently leads outside of the Castle.

descKeys: any holes that you can see. off to the southeast is the main part of the castle.
r1939.description:
You are against the western wall of the Castle.  The wall has several large
cracks in it, evidently put there by errant magical bursts of energy.  The
ground is all chewed up as well, with many holes that you can see.  Off to
the southeast is the main part of the Castle.

descKeys: having mock battles. you see a large 'dent' in the ground right in front of you.
r1940.description:
The Castle's courtyard is not overly large, probably seventy-five yards wide,
but it serves the purpose.  The Celtian Battlemages thrive on combat, and they
are always having mock battles.  You see a large 'dent' in the ground right
in front of you.

descKeys: magic come to your eyesight, coming from various locations around the courtyard.
r1941.description:
The courtyard of the Castle is in a constant state of battle.  You see several
portions of turf that have been thrown up in the air several hundred feet and
then toppled back down to the ground, leaving huge chunks of a sodden mess.
Flashes of battle magic come to your eyesight, coming from various locations
around the courtyard.

descKeys: the courtyard of the castle. the walls here are quite smooth from years of use.

Celtian Battlemage Guild Board [ 40 mess.name: Celtian Battlemage Guild Board [ 40 messages, 40 new]

r1942.description:
This is the barracks of Gloriath Castle.  This narrow hallway leads to various
places within the barracks.  To the west it looks like there is a kitchen.
Through an archway to the north lies the courtyard of the Castle.  The walls
here are quite smooth from years of use.

descKeys: heir time is spent on the fields of battle. a small hallway is to the northwest.
r1943.description:
This part of the baracks is used by the general populace of the Order.  Rows
and rows of various sized beds line the floor.  The members of the Order do
not have much in liue of personal possessions, as all their time is spent on
the fields of battle.  A small hallway is to the northwest.

descKeys: as well. back to the east you see a small hallway that leads several directions.
r1944.description:
You are in the kitchen of Gloriath Castle.  You see a large fire pit in the
middle of the room, and a huge kettle perched on top of it.  There are various
other cooking instruments around as well.  Back to the east you see a small
hallway that leads several directions.

descKeys: is a large mural depicting a large battle that took place during the great war.
r1945.description:
You see several beds in this part of the barracks.  It looks like this room
is used by the senior members of the Order, as the beds here are quite nice.
Along the eastern wall is a large mural depicting a large battle that took
place during the Great War.

descKeys: le. the docks are to the southeast, and the main part of dunagin is to the west.
r1946.description:
You are standing on a road that loops through the southern part of the
city of Dunagin.  To the north is the main part of Dunagin.  To the east
you can see the Bay of Frohan, which is part of the Sea of Honshale.  The
docks are to the southeast, and the main part of Dunagin is to the west.

descKeys: the bay of frohan, and to the north you catch a glimpse of the rest of dunagin.
r1947.description:
The sailor takes a deep breath of the sea air.
You are standing on a road that loops through the southern part of the city
of Dunagin.  This road is made from some beautiful stones, ones that you
have never seen before.  To the east you can see the Bay of Frohan, and to
the north you catch a glimpse of the rest of Dunagin.

descKeys: e is made from one of the most beautiful looking stones that you have ever seen.
r1948.description:
This appears to be the route from the docks to the main part of the
city.  You can see the sea off to the east, and to the west you can
see the city of Dunagin.  The road here is made from one of the most
beautiful looking stones that you have ever seen.

descKeys: rest of the continent. there is a brick road leading east to the dunagin docks.
r1949.description:
You are standing in the harbor city of Dunagin.  The people here in this
town have taken to the seas for the main part of their lives.  This city
is always open to people from far away lands, and is the gateway for
accessing the rest of the continent.  There is a brick road leading east to
the Dunagin docks.

descKeys: the city of dunagin, but you can head east to make your way back into the docks.
r1950.description:
You have reached the west end of a brick road.  You can hear lots of
noise in the building to your northeast and notice some kind of office
to the southeast.  Heading west must lead into the city of Dunagin, but
you can head east to make your way back into the docks.

descKeys: ks. to the south, however, you can walk through the doorway to enter the office.
r1951.description:
In this section of the road, there is an enormous amount of trash.  You
suspect that the inhabitants of the barracks to the north most likely
are responsible for such a mess.  There is a door to the north leading
into the barracks.  To the south, however, you can walk through the
doorway to enter the office.

descKeys: o often you see a few sailors or shorehands entering or leaving either building.
r1952.description:
The sailor longs to be out to sea.
You are standing on a road that leads from the city to the docks.  To the north
stands a building that appears to be some kind of housing.  To the south stands
another building which appears to be some kind of office.  Every so often you
see a few sailors or shorehands entering or leaving either building.

descKeys: sits a steel crane that is used to lift crates out of the hold of the freighter.
r1953.description:
At this point on the docks, you have reached the one of the two planks in
which one can board the freighter.  The plank seems to be in better shape
than the other one and will most likely support your weight easily.  To the
southwest sits a steel crane that is used to lift crates out of the hold of
the freighter.

descKeys: t you also remember that many ships come through here from other unknown places.
r1954.description:
From this point you can barely see the tip of the bow of a freighter that lies
to the east.  You spot a flag flying on the guard rail at the northernmost
tip of the bow.  You have never seen the markings on the flag before, but
you also remember that many ships come through here from other unknown places.

descKeys: ng in which the captain had supposedly slept with a powerful governess overseas.
r1955.description:
As the dock continues northeast and southwest here, you notice the name of a
freighter in large letters on the side, which reads: Governess Penelope.  An
odd name for a freighter you think to yourself.  You then remember some rumors
that you heard about a ship arriving in which the captain had supposedly slept
with a powerful governess overseas.

descKeys: large distance. to the south you can see some other ships docked in the harbor.
r1956.description:
You attention is diverted by some people yelling in the distance off to the
west and northwest.  The docks are separated somewhat from the main part of
city, which lies to the west and northwest.  The docks are rather large and
extend quite a large distance.  To the south you can see some other ships
docked in the harbor.

descKeys: plants. it is feared that an uncontrolled growth could hinder a ship's movement.
r1957.description:
The water seems abnormally green here than anywhere else.  You suspect that
the cause might be the abundance of water plants that are growing beneath
the docks.  Every so often somebody from the city maintenance department walks
the docks and clips the overgrowth of the plants.  It is feared that an
uncontrolled growth could hinder a ship's movement.

descKeys: dock sits. at the moment the dock is empty and looks to have been for some time.
r1958.description:
A large freighter lies to the south.  To the west, you spot an unknown
building that looks like some kind of barracks.  You can see somewhat past
the freighter to the east where another dock sits.  At the moment the dock
is empty and looks to have been for some time.

descKeys: e pattern on the flag includes a large creature that you have never seen before.
r1959.description:
To your south is the northernmost part of a freighter.  There is where the
port and starboard meet at the bow.  A short flagpole is mounted on the rail
that encircles the entire deck of the freighter.  This is your best view of the
flag, which have brown and red as its main colors.  The pattern on the flag
includes a large creature that you have never seen before.

descKeys: the gnomes who built the crane were unhappy with the little money they received.
r1960.description:
From this vantage point, you notice that the dock immediately south of
you is the only one which can support a freighter.  Rumor has it that
there are plans for expansion by putting another dock east of this one.
However, you have also heard that the gnomes who built the crane were
unhappy with the little money they received.

descKeys: port side. this must be so that the freighter can sail out of the docks easily.
r1961.description:
The path along the docks takes a sharp turn to the southeast at this point and
then angles back up to the northeast.  The path on the dock along the eastern
or starboard side of the freighter is much shorter than that along the western
or port side.  This must be so that the freighter can sail out of the docks
easily.

descKeys: all times of the day. the dock continues to the northwest, northeast, and south.
r1962.description:
Looking back toward the west, you notice something called a bowsprit
that you had not seen before.  The pole is pointing off the front edge
of the freighter, but you have no clue as to its intended purpose.  Sea
gulls like to perch on such poles at all times of the day.  The dock
continues to the northwest, northeast, and south.

descKeys: e that there have been efforts to repaint the side, but the job is not finished.
r1963.description:
You are now directly east of the starboard side of the freighter.
Strangely, the outside looks much more damaged than the other side.
The starboard side is covered with dents and scratches as if it had
run into a rock or cliff at one point.  You notice that there have been
efforts to repaint the side, but the job is not finished.

descKeys: of the poles. you notice that a small shop has opened to the southeast of here.
r1964.description:
You have reached the end of this branch of the docks.  Immediately to
the south, you notice four wooden poles breaching the surface of the
water.  Evidently, there might have been plans to extend this branch of
the docks, but the plan was never completed.  Water plants have grown
up each one of the poles.  You notice that a small shop has opened to the
southeast of here.

descKeys: with clever knots. the owner of this shop, bosefus, should be around somewhere.
r1965.description:
This small shop is situated on the end of a dock.  The shop is covered, but is
also open to the water on all sides.  There are many sailboats here, all tied
to the dock with clever knots.  The owner of this shop, Bosefus, should be
around somewhere.

descKeys: crane for the dock. without one, the shorehands could not unload the freighters.
r1966.description:
To your southeast, you notice somebody board a ship.  The dock to the east
looks almost temporary.  You remember rumors that there were further plans to
create another dock that can support a freighter but no such construction
occurred that you notice.  Part of the reason might have been because the
city council could not buy another crane for the dock.  Without one, the
shorehands could not unload the freighters.

descKeys: ds in the open sea. the company's private docks continue off to the east a ways.
r1967.description:
You exclaim in common : Wow that was a fun trip!

The Ship raises anchor and prepares to set sail.
You see some activity on the ship.  It looks like it is preparing to depart.
The ship clears the dock and raises its sails.
The ship is now clear of the dock area and is getting underway.
The worker complains about the pathetic pay.
     lost!
The worker complains about the pathetic pay.
The worker complains about the pathetic pay.
The worker complains about the pathetic pay.
The ships of the Kendrite Passages shipping company are berthed here.  The
three-masted schooners are very seaworthy and capable of attaining high
speeds in the open sea.  The company's private docks continue off to the
east a ways.

descKeys: east, through a small archway. the company's private docks continue to the west.
docks continue to the west. ships that are going to dunagin (celtia) dock here.
r1968.description:
The ships of the Kendrite Passages shipping company are berthed here.  The
three-masted schooners are very seaworthy and capable of attaining high
speeds in the open sea.  The main building for the company is a bit to the
east, through a small archway.  The company's private docks continue
to the west.

descKeys: stant ports and such. the west exit leads to the company's private docking area.
r1969.description:
You are in the Dunagin branch of the Kendrite Passages shipping company.
A large desk is in one corner, obviously used by an employee.  A few posters
are on the walls, showing distant ports and such.  The west exit leads
to the company's private docking area.

descKeys: ill operates. having multiple arms, one of them is currently over the freighter.
r1970.description:
You immediately notice a steel crane that you had not caught your eye too
intensely before.  On the crane, a sign reads: Gnomish Enterprises.  You
quickly assume that this is a gnome invention and feel surprised to see that
it looks like it still operates.  Having multiple arms, one of them is
currently over the freighter.

descKeys: . it is rectangular in shape just like many of the other ones here in the docks.
r1971.description:
As you arrive at this point in the docks, you are almost run over by a sailor
running down the plank that leads onto the freighter to the east.  The plank
is slightly warped due to much usage over the years.  Off to the west stands
another crate.  It is rectangular in shape just like many of the other ones
here in the docks.

descKeys: ccess to the shipping world unless this company ran their business above ground.
r1972.description:
As you walk you notice something peculiar about the crate to the west.  A
picture of a spider is on one of the corners.  In all of your travels you have
heard that only drow draw pictures of spiders like this one.  To the best of
your knowledge, the drow would not have access to the shipping world unless
this company ran their business above ground.

descKeys: e freighter, you realize that you have never seen a freighter this large before.
r1973.description:
To the east you can see the port side of the stern of a large freighter.  A
guard rail starts at southern most tip of the freighter runs along the entire
deck of the freighter.  The freighter looks very old, but extremely seaworthy.
Glancing down the side of the freighter, you realize that you have never seen
a freighter this large before.

descKeys: er's intelligent shipping. its contents a mystery, you cannot find a way inside.
r1974.description:
Yet another crate lies directly north of where you are standing.  This one has
a peculiar look to it, because it is shaped like a trapezoidal prism.  It is
dark green in color and looks fairly new unlike the rest of the crates.  The
side of the crate reads:  Havier's Intelligent Shipping.  Its contents a
mystery, you cannot find a way inside.

descKeys: dip suggests that the dock could buckle at any moment, yet nobody seems to care.
r1975.description:
You have reached one of the busier intersections on the docks.  Shorehands and
sailors especially bustle about in this area.  You notice that the dock has
a dip in the dock at this point.  Evidently, the heavy traffic puts much
stress and strain on the dock.  The dip suggests that the dock could buckle
at any moment, yet nobody seems to care.

descKeys: yourself that somebody should invent some kind of concoction that removes rust.
r1976.description:
To the immediate north sits one end of a large crate.  You notice a latch on
the end that seemingly suggests a door.  However, the latch looks way too
large to pry with what you are carrying.  To make the matter more complicated,
the latch is rusted.  You think to yourself that somebody should invent some
kind of concoction that removes rust.

descKeys: feet high and about 100 feet long. you are curious about what could be in them.
r1977.description:
Here is the receiving area in which all of the cargo from a freighter is
placed.  Shorehands are wandering around inspecting the cargo and crates
while others are unloading a freighter.  You are amazed at the size of some
of the crates.  Some look to be about fifteen feet high and about 100 feet
long.  You are curious about what could be in them.

descKeys: e a clue as to what it contains. the thought of smuggled goods enters your mind.
r1978.description:
Near to where you are standing is a very large crate about two armlengths
away.  Along the side in bold letters reads a company name of which you have
never heard: Viper Grok and Associates (VGA).  You knock on the side of the
crate, but you don't have a clue as to what it contains.  The thought of
smuggled goods enters your mind.

descKeys: l beer bottles. it seems that the shorehands and sailors had a party last night.
r1979.description:
You have reached the northwest corner of the receiving area.  To your
immediate northeast, you notice a small office.  You guess that it is most
likely the receiving office.  You also notice that all around you lie
several beer bottles.  It seems that the shorehands and sailors had a party
last night.

descKeys: g the citizens. the citizens fought back by hiring an assassin to eliminate him.
r1980.description:
You are standing north of a crate that blocks your view to the south.  You
suddenly feel anxious about turning the corner, but the feeling quickly
subsides.  You once heard a story of a ruthless assassin who hunted down a
certain merchant.  The merchant had considerable influence in the city and was
cheating the citizens.  The citizens fought back by hiring an assassin to
eliminate him.

descKeys: be a receiving office. the door is off the hinges and lying next to the doorway.
r1981.description:
You are now standing in what seems to be the busiest part of the receiving
area.  Shorehands and sailors are traversing quickly in all directions.  Some
even have the nerve to cut you off.  To the immediate north is the entrance to
what looks to be a receiving office.  The door is off the hinges and lying next
to the doorway.

descKeys: e weathered. the name of the company who owns the crate is faded and unreadable.
r1982.description:
You are now near the center of the receiving area.  To your immediate west
sits a very large crate.  On the side of it reads in large letters: Viper Grok
and Associates (VGA).  To the northeast sits another crate, but it is smaller.
It has a greenish tint to it and looks quite weathered.  The name of the
company who owns the crate is faded and unreadable.

descKeys: y is the first place that most people reach when they get to the land of celtia.
r1983.description:
The city of Dunagin is a friendly city located on the shores of the
Sea of Honshale.  The people here have relied on the the sea to give
them the things they need to survive.  This city is the first place that
most people reach when they get to the land of Celtia.

descKeys: le will see. the road that you are on leads you deeper into the city of dunagin.
r1984.description:
The city of Dunagin is located on the shores of the Sea of Honshale.  This
city is opened for people from far away lands, and is usually the first
sight of Celtia that the people will see.  The road that you are on leads
you deeper into the city of Dunagin.

descKeys: see some kind of a building, and it looks like there is a lot of activity there.
r1985.description:
You are standing on a road that leads deeper into the city of Dunagin.
This city is located on the Bay of Frohan, which is part of the Sea of
Honshale.  To the south you can see some kind of a building, and it
looks like there is a lot of activity there.

descKeys: s city seems to be a very popular place, because you have seen many people here.
r1986.description:
You seem to be moving into some kind of a merchant section of the town
because you can see many merchants walking around, and many small shops
set up along the road.  This city seems to be a very popular place,
because you have seen many people here.

descKeys: the dunagin branch of the merchant's guild. there is a iron door leading south .
r1987.description:
The city of Dunagin is a harbor town, with many people in it.  Now you
seem to be moving into some kind of a merchant section of the town
because you can see many merchants walking around, and many small shops
set up along the road.  A large building to the south is well-known to be
the Dunagin branch of the Merchant's Guild.
There is a iron door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: small shops set up along the road. to your southwest, you see a large colosseum.
r1988.description:
The city of Dunagin is a harbor town, with many people in it.  Now you
seem to be moving into some kind of a merchant section of the town
because you can see many merchants walking around, and many small shops
set up along the road.  To your southwest, you see a large colosseum.

descKeys: is road has been constructed to give you a small loop at the bottom of the city.
r1989.description:
The Merchant section of Dunagin seems to be owned by some very wealthy
merchants.  Looking to the north you can see more of the city, to the east you
can see the bay of Frohan, and the road seems to continue off to the west. This
road has been constructed to give you a small loop at the bottom of the city.

descKeys: th, the main road continues. you can see the main part of the city to the north.
r1990.description:
You are standing at a small intersection in this part of the city.  To
the west there is another road which will leads to the poor section of
the city.  To the north, the main road continues.  You can see the main
part of the city to the north.

descKeys: se there are not as many people here and the buildings seem to be in poor shape.
r1991.description:
This trail leads out of the city of Dunagin.  To the south, there is a
desert.  You are still in the city of Dunagin, but it seems that this is
a poorer part of the town, because there are not as many people here and
the buildings seem to be in poor shape.

descKeys: art of town do not seem as friendly as the people in the other parts of dunagin.
r1992.description:
This is the poor section of Dunagin.  The buildings here are in very bad
shape.  This trail leads you out of the city and into the desert.  The
people in this part of town do not seem as friendly as the people in the
other parts of Dunagin.

descKeys: are in very bad shape. this trail leads you out of the city and into the desert.
r1993.description:
The people in this area just stare at you as you walk by, because they are
not sure why you are here.  This is the poor section of Dunagin.  The
buildings here are in very bad shape.  This trail leads you out of the city
and into the desert.

descKeys: hotter than the other sections of the town. it must be closer to somewhere hot.
r1994.description:
You are in the poor section of the town.  This area seems to just be deserted.
There are only a few buildings around here, and those are scattered around.
This section of the town also seems to be hotter than the other sections of
the town.  It must be closer to somewhere hot.

descKeys: of the desert, and the hoplessness of entering there and coming out alive again.
r1995.description:
The poor section of the town of Dunagin is to the northeast.  This trail
that you are on now seems to be heading towards the desert.  From here you
can see the vastness of the desert, and the hoplessness of entering there
and coming out alive again.

descKeys: e grand city of dunagin. off to the east you can barely see the sea on honshale.
r1996.description:
You are on a trail that leads to the desert going south, and back to
Dunagin to the north.  The desert fills your view to the south, and back to
the north you can see the grand city of Dunagin.  Off to the east you can
barely see the Sea on Honshale.

descKeys: t out of the dunagin boundry, and what lies outside of those gates is a mystery.
r1997.description:
This is the trail that leads from Dunagin to the desert.  To the south you
can see some huge gates, which must be the entrance to the city of Dunagin.
This means you are almost out of the Dunagin boundry, and what lies outside
of those gates is a mystery.

descKeys: a pile of scrap metal consisting of various metals. there is a sign on one wall.
r1998.description:
You are standing in the only smithy in Dunagin.  Most of the business the
smith gets is from the sailors who bring in their tools.  Some of the items
in the room include hooks, hammers, jigsaws, etc.  Near one wall is a pile of
scrap metal consisting of various metals.  There is a sign on one wall.

descKeys: of frohan is off to the east, and to the south is the merchant section of town.
r1999.description:
You are on a road that goes through the southern part of the city of
Dunagin.  To the north, you can see the main part of the city, and to the
northwest you see some kind of a building.  The Bay of Frohan is off to the
east, and to the south is the merchant section of town.

descKeys: f the sea of honshale. there seems to be a lot of activity in this part of town.
r2000.description:
You are standing on a road that goes through the southern part of the city
of Dunagin.  To the north you can see the main part of the town, and to the
east you can catch a glimpse of the Bay of Frohan, part of the Sea of
Honshale.  There seems to be a lot of activity in this part of town.

descKeys: good! just from the smell, you can tell that this is going to be some good food.
r2001.description:
You are standing in the famous Fish Shack, a small seafood place in the
city of Dunagin.  Stories of this place have traveled all over the lands
and they are all good!  Just from the smell, you can tell that this is
going to be some good food.

descKeys: g. there are many people around this building, so it must be an important place.
r2002.description:
bartender for information.
You are walking in a small alley that runs east and west through the city
of Duanagin.  There are a few small shops scattered along the alley, and off
to the west you can see some sort of a large building.  There are many
people around this building, so it must be an important place.

descKeys: ded by the city. this is a large place, and there are many people who come here.
r2003.description:
You are walking along an alley that leads through the city of Dunagin.  To
the west you can see a building that draws your attention.  Looking in the
other directions you can see that you are surrounded by the city.  This is
a large place, and there are many people who come here.

descKeys: . the building is an older one, and there are not many items placed in the bank.
r2004.description:
You are standing in the bank of Dunagin.  While this place is far from
the city of Threshold, they still have communication with them via the ships
that are always traveling back, so you can access your money here too.  The
building is an older one, and there are not many items placed in the bank.

descKeys: eems that it was constructed in a hurry after the rest of the building was made.
r2005.description:
You are in a small room above the meeting place.  This place seems
to be used for people to talk about their travels all over the realm.
There are not many things in this room, it seems that it was constructed
in a hurry after the rest of the building was made.

descKeys: battle, they do make you look good. there is a small sign here for you to read.
r2006.description:
You are in the famous fine clothes store, Chaud's.  This place has some
fine looking items for you to buy.  While the clothes here will not help
you too much in a battle, they do make you look good.  There is a small
sign here for you to read.

descKeys: can see the city of dunagin. there are not many people in this part of the town.
r2007.description:
You are standing on a path that is in the upper section of the city of
Dunagin.  To the north you can see a forest that seems to thicken quickly
and to the south you can see the city of Dunagin.  There are not many people
in this part of the town.

descKeys: of then town, but the trees are very thick here and could be blocking your view.
r2008.description:
You are in the northern section of the city of Dunagin.  This part of the
city does not have many people around.  As far as you can tell there are no
buildings in this part of then town, but the trees are very thick here and
could be blocking your view.

descKeys: is part of the city. there are no people around here, that you can see at least.
r2009.description:
You are on a path in the upper section of the city of Dunagin.  To the north
you can make out some kind of a structure.  It is hard to tell what it is
because the trees are very thick in this part of the city.  There are no
people around here, that you can see at least.

descKeys: t you can smell the fresh air, wafting through the trees to reach your nostrils.
r2010.description:
You head north through the gates and enter a forest.
You are in a part of the forest that is populated by many tall trees.  These
trees are so tall that you can barely even see the sky above your head.  In
this part of the forest you can smell the fresh air, wafting through the
trees to reach your nostrils.

descKeys: tall. the ground is covered in leaves that have fallen from the trees over time.
r2011.description:
You are standing on a trail in the forest.  This forest is very large and is
populated by lots of tall trees.  In fact you can barely see the sky because
the trees are so tall.  The ground is covered in leaves that have fallen from
the trees over time.

descKeys: ees here are very tall, reaching heights of over one hundred feet in some cases.
r2012.description:
You are walking in the forest on the continent of Celtia.  This trail that
you are on seems to be well travelled by the local wildlife.  There are many
footprints around and on the trail.  The trees here are very tall, reaching
heights of over one hundred feet in some cases.

descKeys: ound is covered with many footprints and leaves that have fallen from the trees.
r2013.description:
The rabbit hops around.
As you look around youself, you can see many trees that are extremely tall.
In fact these trees are so tall that you are barely able to see the sky above
you.  The ground is covered with many footprints and leaves that have fallen
from the trees.

descKeys: ore. you can only imagine what it would be like to be able to climb those trees.
r2014.description:
The rabbit hops around.
You start to look around, and notice that compare to these tall trees you
are nothing!  The trees in this forest seem to be much larger than most of
the other trees you have ever seen before.  You can only imagine what it would
be like to be able to climb those trees.

descKeys: the ground here is covered with leaves and also footprints from forest animals.
r2015.description:
As you stop walking for a moment to look at your surroundings, you notice
that you are in an expansive forest.  This forest is full of many trees that
are so tall you can hardly even see the sky.  The ground here is covered with
leaves and also footprints from forest animals.

descKeys: forest are quite ferocious, so keep that in mind as you traverse the woodlands.
r2016.description:
You are walking on a trail which goes through the forest on the continent of
Celtia.  This forest is full of many things such as trees, bushes and animals.
Some of the denizens of this forest are quite ferocious, so keep that in mind
as you traverse the woodlands.

descKeys: eatures that are there just looking for someone like you to quench their hunger.
r2017.description:
You are in the great forest on the continent of Celtia.  This forest is some-
times a very dangerous place for people to venture alone.  There are rumors
that the forest is filled with wandering creatures that are there just looking
for someone like you to quench their hunger.

descKeys: think better of it. there are also many trees along the trail that you can see.
r2018.description:
As you look around you notice that the trail here is full of many types of
flowers.  These flowers seem very appealing to the eye, and you have a sudden
urge to pick them, but you think better of it.  There are also many trees
along the trail that you can see.

descKeys: he trail. you have the feeling that the populace of this forest live quite well.
r2019.description:
You are walking on a trail that goes through the forest.  This trail seems to
be very long, and well travelled.  There are many different footprints all on
and along the trail.  You have the feeling that the populace of this forest
live quite well.

descKeys: ough the forest. these creatures have been known to just randomly attack people.
r2020.description:
You are walking on a long trail that goes through the forest on the continent
of Celtia.  This forest is sometimes a very dangerous place for people to
to travel alone, because of all the creatures that wander through the forest.
These creatures have been known to just randomly attack people.

descKeys: with shelter and food. some of the trees reach over one hundred feet in height.
r2021.description:
You are located in the forest on the continent of Celtia.  This forest is
home to many different animals, both woodland and avian.  The trees here are
quite large, and provide those creatures with shelter and food.  Some of the
trees reach over one hundred feet in height.

descKeys: ive very well, since you can see all of their footprints along and on the trail.

path leading east through the forest.name: path leading east through the forest

r2022.description:
As you pause your walk in the forest to stop and observe your surroundings
you notice that this forest is a very well perserved environment.  The animals
in this forest must live very well, since you can see all of their footprints
along and on the trail.

descKeys: must be large, because some of them leave huge footprints behind on the trails.
r2023.description:
You are on a trail in this forest.  The trail that you are walking on is a
very well travelled trail, both by normal travellers and woodland animals.
The animals in this forest must be large, because some of them leave huge
footprints behind on the trails.

descKeys: ple to explore. the forest is one of the most beautiful places on the continent.
r2024.description:
You are on a trail in the great forest that is located on the continent of
Celtia.  This continent is a mythical place that hold many wonders for the
bravest people to explore.  The forest is one of the most beautiful places
on the continent.

descKeys: ry dangerous, so it is not a good idea to walk around in this forest unprepared.
r2025.description:
You are located on a trail that is going through the great forest on the
continent of Celtia.  This forest is full of many trees and lots of animals.
The forest also contains many creatures that are very dangerous, so it is
not a good idea to walk around in this forest unprepared.

descKeys: e sky because the trees are so tall. the ground is also covered by their leaves.
r2026.description:
You are on a trail in the forest.  This trail seems to be well travelled by
the animals of the forest.  There are many of their footprints that are on
the ground.  You can only stand in awe of the size of the trees in this part
of the forest.  You can barely even see the sky because the trees are so
tall.  The ground is also covered by their leaves.

descKeys: ere. the trees are so tall that you can barely even see the sky above your head.
r2027.description:
You are in a part of the forest that is populated by many tall trees.  Here,
apparently several of them are lined up to form a natural barrier to the
north, effectively stopping the trail here.  The trees are so tall that you
can barely even see the sky above your head.

descKeys: uiter. there is a iron door leading south . there is a iron door leading north .
r2028.description:
This part of the Guild is used mainly for meeting purposes.  There are several
tables in this room, accompanied by wooden chairs.  The floor of this room
is covered almost entirely by a large rug.  Off to the southeast is a large
office that is usually occupied by the merchant recruiter.
There is a iron door leading south ( CLOSED ).
There is a iron door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: ges. an exit to the northwest leads to the meeting area of the merchant's guild.
r2029.description:
You are in a large office in the Guild.  The desk near the eastern wall is
probably seven feet long, and takes up most of the space in this room.  A
large rug is on the middle of the floor, covering most of the floor except
for the edges.  An exit to the northwest leads to the meeting area of the
Merchant's Guild.

descKeys: lize you must watch where you step, because there are several gaps in the floor.
r2030.description:
You are standing in a small office that evidently keeps track of all the
cargo that is unloaded from the freighters.  You see books scattered
everywhere and quickly wonder how anybody finds any information.  The paint
is peeling off the wall, and patches cover holes in the ceiling.  You realize
you must watch where you step, because there are several gaps in the floor.

descKeys: ry once in a while, you can feel the the house bob up and down amidst the waves.
r2031.description:
You are inside what appears to be some sort of barracks.  After looking
around, you guess that the barracks might have been used by the military
at one time.  What makes this barracks unique is that it is actually
a boat house.  Every once in a while, you can feel the the house bob up
and down amidst the waves.

descKeys: hey finish eating, they dispose of their plates and utensils in the dish return.
r2032.description:
After arriving at the mess hall, you feel a sudden growl emerge from
the bowels of your being.  Tables are lined in neat and compact rows
and allow little room to walk.  To receive food, you suspect that the
sailors start the line in the room to the north.  After they finish
eating, they dispose of their plates and utensils in the dish return.

descKeys: with the female population. several beer bottles are scattered about the floor.
r2033.description:
You have arrived at some kind of lounging room.  Around you lies several
pieces of furniture including a couple of chairs and couches.  A table
lies in the middle of the room.  This room appears to be where the
sailors socialize and get a little frisky with the female population.
Several beer bottles are scattered about the floor.

descKeys: cated along one wall. in the fireplace, a pot of water is boiling over the fire.
r2034.description:
You have arrived at the kitchen of the barracks where the cooks prepare
the meals for the sailors.  The kitchen is spotless, unlike all of the
other rooms in the barracks.  There is a fire currently burning in a
fireplace located along one wall.  In the fireplace, a pot of water
is boiling over the fire.

descKeys: bout. despite all the crates, it looks like the cooks will have to restock soon.
r2035.description:
thing about relaxation.
The sailor takes a deep breath of the sea air.
This is the storage room for the kitchen.  The cooks keep all of the
pots, pans, and other items that they use to cook the food.  There are
also crates of food waiting to be prepared.  You find it very hard to
navigate through here, because the crates are scattered about.  Despite
all the crates, it looks like the cooks will have to restock soon.

descKeys: red throughout the room. comparable to the floor and walls, each tub is squalid.
r2036.description:
You have arrived in one of the bathrooms in the barracks.  You feel
so fortunate to have not walked in on some poor soul taking a bath.
The floor and walls are absolutely filthy, and there are several tubs
scattered throughout the room.  Comparable to the floor and walls, each
tub is squalid.

descKeys: h set of beds, there are dressers in which the sailors can put their belongings.
r2037.description:
You have reached a large room full of beds that must be the living
quarters.  All of the beds have been bunked to allow for maximum
occupancy.  Very rarely, however, is there enough sailors to fill all
of the beds.  Along with each set of beds, there are dressers in which
the sailors can put their belongings.

descKeys: help from a teller. through two glass doors to the north lies frontiers street.
r2038.description:
You go south, entering the bank.
The First Union Bank of Threshold was established some thirty years ago by a
prominent mayor.  The bank's interior has polished floors, several artistic
tapestries hanging from the walls, and several booths where you may receive
help from a teller.  Through two glass doors to the north lies Frontiers
Street.

The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

r2072.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

several windows on each floor.  It is made out of packed stone and dirt, and

There is a wood door leading south ( LOCKED ).

of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
