descKeys: d is about twenty feet wide, and looks like it sees a lot of traffic, every day.
r2155.description:
You are on the Caravan Route, sandwiched between the Great Forest to the east
and southeast, and the large Plains of Nereka which are to the north and
northwest.  The road is about twenty feet wide, and looks like it sees a lot
of traffic, every day.

descKeys: ea. you can see that the route continues to the southeast and also to the north.
r2156.description:
You are on the large and well-used Caravan Route that is travelling through
the Plains of Nereka.  Gritty sand from the Plains on either side of the road
stir up now and again, causing clouds of dust to roll around the area.  You
can see that the Route continues to the southeast and also to the north.

descKeys: a huge and imposing castle, bristling with activity from the knights of nereka.
r2157.description:
You are standing in the Plains of Nereka.  The Plains stretch on for miles
with nary a tree or bush to be found, except near the bordering regions.
A ways to the west you can see a huge and imposing castle, bristling with
activity from the Knights of Nereka.

descKeys: e landscape. looking towards the south you can see a vast and lush green forest.
r2158.description:
The Plains of Nereka stretch on as far as the eye can see.  To the far north-
east lie the foothills, running for miles.  Near those hills is the Kal-
Thax region, home to the dwarven race.  To the east is the Absinthe Mountain
range, rising high over the landscape.  Looking towards the south you can see
a vast and lush green forest.

descKeys: through the dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.
r2159.description:
The Plains stretch on and on, almost never ending.  Home to the nomadic
Plainsmen, the Plains provide game for the hunters and a much-needed sense
of openess that they so desire.  A tiny bush, trying to break through the
dirt to reach the sunlight, is at your feet, looking quite pitiful.

descKeys: small holes like his dot the plains, home to thousands of such varied varmints.
r2160.description:
A slight breeze is blowing around you, stirring up some dust, partially
obscurring your vision.  A small prairie dog pokes his head out of an
almost hidden hole, stares at you for a second, then pops back down into
the hole.  Small holes like his dot the plains, home to thousands of such
varied varmints.

descKeys: ects the sunlight right into your eyes, almost blinding you with its brilliance.
r2161.description:
Walking around in the Plains of Nereka, you sense a feeling of loneliness,
due to the open and vast region.  The grayish dirt beneath your feet is as
fine as any sand and just reflects the sunlight right into your eyes, almost
blinding you with its brilliance.

descKeys: destroyed vegetation. to the east you can see the huge absinthe mountain range.
you can see the huge absinthe mountain range. a small plant is in front of you.
r2162.description:
The never ending Plains of Nereka are expansive as well as full of bounty.
Scores of roaming herds of pack animals cross the plains, leaving behind
wide swaths of footprints and destroyed vegetation.  To the east you can
see the huge Absinthe Mountain Range.

descKeys: ers of the knights. a scraggly bush is right in front of, looking quite forlorn.
r2163.description:
The Plains of Nereka have been watched over by the Knights of Nereka for
several centuries.  Looking far to the west, you can actually spot the
famous Castle Brightsword, the main headquarters of the Knights.  A scraggly
bush is right in front of, looking quite forlorn.

descKeys: eels here and there. off to the southwest you think you can spot a large castle.
r2164.description:
The Caravan Route is running north and southeast here, heading through the
expansive Plains of Nereka.  The road is in fairly good shape, with only
a few ruts from wagon wheels here and there.  Off to the southwest you think
you can spot a large castle.

descKeys: ort. off to the west you see the often-used dulaj road, which runs to deepwater.
r2165.description:
You are at the start/beginning of the great Caravan Route.  The Route leads
back to the south and southeast where it eventually hits such places as
Crossroads, Threshold, Jaarmin Keep, and even Kalinport.  Off to the west you
see the often-used Dulaj Road, which runs to Deepwater.

descKeys: f nereka are to the east and the road leads back to the west, towards deepwater.
r2166.description:
You have reached the end of Dulaj Road.  The road, which starts in the city
of Deepwater, was constructed many years ago but obviously never finished.  A
large mound of dirt is to the north of the road, evidently left over when the
workers abandoned the project.  The Plains of Nereka are to the east and the
road leads back to the west, towards Deepwater.

descKeys: ng for miles. off to the north and east you can see the absinthe mountain range.
r2167.description:
You are on Dulaj Road, a long route that winds its way through the Plains of
Nereka.  The road is about twenty feet wide and is quite dusty.  The plains
run in all directions from this point, stretching for miles.  Off to the north
and east you can see the Absinthe Mountain Range.

descKeys: t traveller from deepwater. the road was not finished for one reason or another.
r2168.description:
Dulaj Road is running through the Plains of Nereka, going from the city of
Deepwater to about the middle of the Plains.  The road was constructed many
years ago in honor of a constant traveller from Deepwater.  The road was not
finished for one reason or another.

descKeys: ins of nereka. off to the north you can see part of the absinthe mountain range.
r2169.description:
The road you are travelling upon is called Dulaj Road, named after a famous
wanderer from the city of Deepwater.  The road is farily well-used, but for
some reason it stops right in the middle of the Plains of Nereka.  Off to the
north you can see part of the Absinthe Mountain Range.

descKeys: ished. perhaps the road workers ran afoul of the ever-present bandit population.
r2170.description:
You are travelling upon Dulaj Road.  The long road, named for an adventurer
from the city of Deepwater, runs from the gates of Deepwater to about the
middle of the Plains of Nereka.  For some reason the road was never completely
finished.  Perhaps the road workers ran afoul of the ever-present bandit
population.

descKeys: oggling. you think you can also see a large castle to the southeast a long ways.
r2173.description:
The road is meandering through the Plains of Nereka, twisting a few times
here and there, but straight for the most part.  Looking far to the south
you can spot a large forest, a huge green expanse that you find mind-boggling.
You think you can also see a large castle to the southeast a long ways.

descKeys: ert city on the southern tip of the continent. dulaj road continues to the east.
r2174.description:
You are standing upon the Dulaj Road, which originates from the city of
Deepwater and runs east through the Plains of Nereka.  Directly south from
here is the long caravan route to Kalinport, the desert city on the southern
tip of the continent.  Dulaj Road continues to the east.

descKeys: down tightly. directly to the east you can see some sort of a 't' intersection.
r2175.description:
The Dulaj Road is running east and west, from the city of Deepwater and on
through the Plains of Nereka.  The road is comprised of a brownish dirt that
has been packed down tightly.  Directly to the east you can see some sort
of a 'T' intersection.

descKeys: e. off to the east lies the plains of nereka, stretching on for miles and miles.
r2176.description:
The road you are standing on is about ten feet wide and seems to be well-used.
To the west you can see the city of Deepwater, and beyond that is the Sea of
Honshale.  Off to the east lies the Plains of Nereka, stretching on for miles
and miles.

descKeys: either caravans or small parties, but is empty for the most part at the moment.
r2177.description:
Dulaj Road takes a turn here, heading back to the west towards Deepwater and
also to the southeast, towards the Plains of Nereka.  The road is normally
filled with traffic, either caravans or small parties, but is empty for the
most part at the moment.

descKeys: f deepwater. the road heads northwest here and then turns west towards the city.
r2178.description:
You are standing on Dulaj Road, just east of the city of Deepwater.  The road
also continues to the east towards the Plains of Nereka.  The road is comprised
of packed dirt, well-used and also maintained by the citizens of Deepwater.
The road heads northwest here and then turns west towards the city.

descKeys: ctly north of here is a small covered area, and then a stables is north of that.
r2179.description:
The Dulaj Road is running west towards Deepwater and also southeast, out
towards the Plains of Nereka.  The road is approximately ten feet wide and
is made out of packed dirt.  Many a caravan has travelled over this road,
heading towards a distant city.  Directly north of here is a small covered
area, and then a stables is north of that.

descKeys: y, but there is a small guardhouse that is always occupied by a few town guards.
r2180.description:
You are just east of Deepwater, standing on the Dulaj Road.  The city sprawls
out to the southeast and northeast, on the north and south side of Aurel Bay.
There are no gates leading into the city, but there is a small guardhouse
that is always occupied by a few town guards.

descKeys: ion of town. directly south of here is a large stable, used by many a traveller.
r2181.description:
You are standing just inside the city of Deepwater, right beside a small guard-
house.  The city is to the north and west of you, heading all the way to the
water.  A well-travelled road leads east towards the Plains of Nereka.  A lot
of people are heading north, evidently towards the merchant section of town.
Directly south of here is a large stable, used by many a traveller.

descKeys: and to the west is an intersection between dulaj road and some other throughway.
r2182.description:
You are travelling upon Dulaj Road, which leads through the southern section
of Deepwater and also on through the Plains of Nereka.  To the east is a small
guardhouse and to the west is an intersection between Dulaj Road and some other
throughway.

descKeys: terside road leads north to the city docks and also south towards the city hall.
r2183.description:
You are standing at the intersection of Dulaj Road and Waterside Road.  It
looks like Dulaj Road runs west towards the residential section of Deepwater,
and east out towards the Plains of Nereka.  Waterside Road leads north to the
city docks and also south towards the city hall.

descKeys: t of them relatively newly-constructed. a large cathedral is just south of here.
r2184.description:
The guard scans the crowd for possible troublemakers.
You are travelling upon Dulaj Road, which runs east and west through the
southern section of Deepwater.  To the east Dulaj Road intersects with Water-
side Road, which goes north and south.  The houses in this area are fairly
decent, most of them relatively newly-constructed.  A large cathedral is just
south of here.

descKeys: with medium-sized homes which house the majority of the residents of deepwater.
r2185.description:
You are just south of the main residential area in Deepwater, travelling
upon Dulaj Road.  The road also heads back east towards the Plains of Nereka.
Up on ahead to the north the area is crowded with medium-sized homes which
house the majority of the residents of Deepwater.

descKeys: ast. there is a wooden door leading west . there is a wooden door leading east .
r2186.description:
You are in the main residential section of Deepwater, in the southwestern
part of the city.  The houses along Dulaj Road in this area are fairly new
and look to be occupied by middle-income families.  Dulaj Road continues
north towards more houses and also south where it curves to the east.
There is a wooden door leading west ( CLOSED ).
There is a wooden door leading east ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: plaque near one of the doors reads 'bling'. there is a wood door leading west .
r2187.description:
You stand before a modest one story house.  The house is made from some good
wood, probably garnered from the Great Forest to the southeast of Deepwater.
The house has stained-glass windows on the front, and the exterior has been
painted white, with a dark blue trim.  The double doors that lead into the
house are at least ten feet tall, and the handles are in the shape of angels.
A small plaque near one of the doors reads 'Bling'.
There is a wood door leading west ( LOCKED ).

descKeys: ion. there is a wooden door leading west . there is a wooden door leading east .
r2188.description:
You are on Dulaj Road, in the heart of the residential section of Deepwater.
The houses here are fairly large, but not overly so.  The road is packed
dirt, but has been treated with something so there is no dust flying around.
Dulaj Road continues south and also north, where it hits some sort of
intersection.
There is a wooden door leading west ( CLOSED ).
There is a wooden door leading east ( CLOSED ).

descKeys: nd south. you see that there is a guard station at the entrance to beach street.
r2189.description:
You are at a small intersection between Dulaj Road and another, smaller
road called Beach Street.  The smaller road stretches a ways to the west,
while Dulaj Road goes north and south.  You see that there is a guard station
at the entrance to Beach Street.

descKeys: rough the residential district and then heads east towards the plains of nereka.
r2190.description:
You are at the end/start of Dulaj Road.  Around you are homes of middle-income
families.  This section is newer than most other sections of the city, having
been constructed less than forty years ago.  Dulaj Road continues south through
the residential district and then heads east towards the Plains of Nereka.

descKeys: the southern end of the city. the road is about ten feet wide and is well-used.
r2191.description:
You are just on Waterside Road just north of the intersection with Dulaj Road.
To the north is the city's docks, which are situated directly on top of Aurel
Bay.  To the south is the city hall, near the southern end of the city.  The
road is about ten feet wide and is well-used.

descKeys: of the city's more popular drinking establishments is to the north a few paces.
r2192.description:
You are walking along Waterside Road, which runs north and south through the
southern portion of Deepwater.  On either side of the road lie small buildings,
evidently housing some of the city's population.  One of the city's more
popular drinking establishments is to the north a few paces.

descKeys: r aurel bay. to the east is a large drinking establishment called the 'wild ox'.
r2193.description:
Waterside road runs north and south through the city of Deepwater.  The road
is wide enough for a few caravans to pass by each other and looks to be in
good shape, no need of repair.  Off to the north you can spot the city docks,
which are directly situated over Aurel Bay.  To the east is a large drinking
establishment called the 'Wild Ox'.

descKeys: travelling from distant ports. you can also see the city hall way to the south.
r2194.description:
You are standing on Waterside Road, which runs north to the docks and also
south through the southern part of Deepwater.  Off to the north past the
docks is Aurel Bay, port to many a ship travelling from distant ports.  You
can also see the city hall way to the south.

descKeys: here and there you pass a citizen of deepwater heading to whatever destination.
r2195.description:
Waterside Road is running north towards the docks and also south towards the
south portion of Deepwater.  Off to the west is a large body of water,
presumably the Sea of Honshale.  Here and there you pass a citizen of
Deepwater heading to whatever destination.

descKeys: aterside road starts to the south and heads through the southern potion of town.
r2196.description:
You are standing on the southern end of the city docks.  The docks stretch
out over the Bay of Aurel, which is ahead to the north and west of you.  The
docks were constructed many years ago, with a few additions here and there
over the years.  Waterside Road starts to the south and heads through the
southern potion of town.

descKeys: aterside road starts to the south and heads through the southern potion of town.
r2197.description:
You are standing on the southern end of the city docks.  The docks stretch
out over the Bay of Aurel, which is ahead to the north and west of you.  The
docks were constructed many years ago, with a few additions here and there
over the years.  Waterside Road starts to the south and heads through the
southern potion of town.

descKeys: waterside road. the docks are very sturdy, having survived many a fierce storm.
r2198.description:
The docks run four ways here.  To the west are berthings for larger ships, to
the east are berthings for smaller boats, to the north the dock continues, and
to the south the docks end, hitting Waterside Road.  The docks are very
sturdy, having survived many a fierce storm.

descKeys: ould have room to be paddled underneath in order to get out to the bay of aurel.
r2199.description:
The docks have been here since the early history of Deepwater.  The first
settlers around this area were fishermen and their families, and they found
that the Bay of Aurel was an excellent area for fishing.  A small dock was
created and later expanded when the fishing industry took off.  This part of
docks is a bit higher than the rest, evidently so the smaller boats on the
eastern side would have room to be paddled underneath in order to get out to
the Bay of Aurel.

descKeys: south you think you can spot the new city hall, near the boundaries of the city.
r2200.description:
You are standing at an intersection of the docks.  The main dock leads north
and south, while an equally large dock leads off to the west, farther out into
the Bay of Aurel.  Way off to the south you think you can spot the new city
hall, near the boundaries of the city.

descKeys: the main section of deepwater and also north towards the seedy part of the city.
r2201.description:
You are travelling upon the main dock of the city.  Smaller and lesser-used
docks sprout out from this one and lead out farther into the Bay.  The dock
continues south towards the main section of Deepwater and also north towards
the seedy part of the city.

descKeys: y smaller boats, while the larger docks to the west are used by the large ships.
r2202.description:
You are at an intersection in the docks.  The main dock is leading north and
south, while a smaller dock leads off to the east.  It looks as if the dock
to the east is used by smaller boats, while the larger docks to the west are
used by the large ships.

descKeys: ed on the eastern side of the docks. directly north of here starts fenster road.
r2203.description:
You are on the city's docks.  The docks spread out to the south, west and also
east.  The larger ships are moored on the bigger docks on the west side, while
the smaller boats are moored on the eastern side of the docks.  Directly north
of here starts Fenster Road.

descKeys: ulace gets a bit more 'seedy', so you hesitate before heading in that direction.
r2204.description:
You are standing at the end/beginning of Fenster Road, just north of the city
docks.  The road continues to the northwest where it hits some sort of guard
check point.  Beyond the check point it looks like the populace gets a bit more
'seedy', so you hesitate before heading in that direction.

descKeys: road continues to the northwest and a smaller road, north way, is north of here.
r2205.description:
The guard glances around.
You are at a guard check point in the northern section of Deepwater.  Several
guards are usually around here, checking out the traffic heading towards the
southern portion of town.  It seems that many unsavory characters have been
vandalizing the southern section of the city, and those citizens will not
stand for it.  Since the southern populace holds more sway in the politics
of the city, they have decided to put up this check point.  However, a strong

descKeys: and also east where it turns again to the north. a small alley is to the north.

called 'North Way' because nobody could come up with a better name, runs south
towards a guard check point and also east where it turns again to the north.
A small alley is to the north.

descKeys: ime. north way is a few steps to the south. there is a wood door leading north .
r2207.description:
This small alley is quite dark.  No sunlight can filter down through the small
opening between two buildings.  Heaps of trash have been piled up around the
alley, and look to have been there for quite some time.  North Way is a few
steps to the south.
There is a wood door leading north ( OPENED ).

descKeys: air! the road seems to end to the north, but it continues to the west from here.

You are travelling along a small road in the northern portion of Deepwater.
The street you are travelling upon, North Way, is full of potholes and is in
need of a good repair!  The road seems to end to the north, but it continues
to the west from here.

descKeys: nd does not look inviting. to the east is a large gate, leading out of the city.
r2209.description:
The road you are on, North Way, ends abruptly here against a large building to
the north.  However, the road does travel back to the south.  Looking at that
large building in front of you, you can see a small alley on the right side.
The alley is quite dark and does not look inviting.  To the east is a large
gate, leading out of the city.

descKeys: , and it therefore follows that rabid has set up another shop here in deepwater.
r2210.description:
This seamy shop seems simply satisfying for the purpose of providing purchases
primarily of potions.  Going on his self-gratifying greatness giving grand
illusions of grandeur, Rabid, now, not of right mind, but notably out of his
noggin (noggling along, of course), has an ongoing, outlasting, and over-
whelming madness to make many meticulous manifestations of extremely effort-
filled yet esasperating examples of well-established status-altering potions,
and it therefore follows that Rabid has set up another shop here in Deepwater.

descKeys: closer to the shore. off to the south you can see the main section of deepwater.
r2211.description:
The docks are extending east towards the main dock area and also west out
farther on the bay.  The larger ships dock out to the west, while the smaller
boats tend to stick closer to the shore.  Off to the south you can see the
main section of Deepwater.

descKeys: that evidently hails from kalinport, judging from the flag flying from its mast.
r2212.description:
You are close to the end of this part of the docks.  Just a little ways to the
west, the dock stops abruptly and only water can be seen past that point.
Right in front of you is a large ship that evidently hails from Kalinport,
judging from the flag flying from its mast.

descKeys: t hold up the pier. looking to the west all you can see is water and more water.

You are standing at the end of a long pier, located near the southern portion
of the city docks.  Looking over the side you can spot several varieties of
fish swimming lazily around the wooden columns that hold up the pier.  Looking
to the west all you can see is water and more water.

descKeys: ear elinost, so it has a strong texture that can withstand just about any abuse.
r2214.description:
You are travelling upon the lesser-used section of the city docks.  The boats
around here tend to be very small and little more than dinghys.  The dock is
made out of a tough wood that was imported from near Elinost, so it has a
strong texture that can withstand just about any abuse.

descKeys: f aurel, you can spot the vast plains of nereka. the docks continue to the west.
r2215.description:
The docks end here, dropping off to the east suddenly.  The moorings around
this part of the docks are not used that often, as they are the farthest from
the open sea.  Looking to the east past the Bay of Aurel, you can spot the
vast Plains of Nereka.  The docks continue to the west.

descKeys: aterside road starts to the south and heads through the southern potion of town.
r2216.description:
You are standing on the southern end of the city docks.  The docks stretch
out over the Bay of Aurel, which is ahead to the north and west of you.  The
docks were constructed many years ago, with a few additions here and there
over the years.  Waterside Road starts to the south and heads through the
southern potion of town.

descKeys: of here. commerce way runs to the east and then south through the merchant area.
r2217.description:
You are at the intersection of Waterside Road and Commerce Way.  The north and
south road, Waterside Road, runs all the way through the southern section of
the city and all the way to the city docks, which are just north of here.
Commerce Way runs to the east and then south through the merchant area.

descKeys: hwest you can actually see aurel bay, and then past that is the sea of honshale.
r2218.description:
Commerce Way is running west towards Waterside Road and also southeast towards
the merchant section of Deepwater.  The road is about ten feet wide and seems
to be well-used.  A ways to the northwest you can actually see Aurel Bay, and
then past that is the Sea of Honshale.

descKeys: nd what you are looking for. you see that a small fish shop is open to the west.

You are standing on Commerce Way, which leads south towards the merchant
section of Deepwater and also towards the northwest where it meets Waterside

descKeys: aterside road starts to the south and heads through the southern potion of town.

descKeys: ng for miles. off to the north and east you can see the absinthe mountain range.

This small temple has been constructed by the followers of Aber.  The room
is used as a meditation point for those who look to Aber for guidance.  A
few straw mats are on the ground, and the walls are bare.  The Monks built

There is a wood door leading south ( OPENED ).

descKeys: nloaded. this dock continues on to the west, while the main dock is to the east.
r2240.description:
You are travelling upon a large dock that has several big ships moored to it's
side.  The ship to the south of you hails from Threshold and is in the process
of having it's cargo unloaded.  This dock continues on to the west, while the
main dock is to the east.

descKeys: orts. off to the west, past the bay's entrance, you can see the sea of honshale.
r2241.description:
The dock takes a turn here, heading east towards the main dock and also to the
northwest towards the end of the dock.  This section of the docks has been set
aside for use by the larger ships that call Deepwater one of their ports.  Off
to the west, past the Bay's entrance, you can see the Sea of Honshale.

descKeys: y water, stretching on for miles and miles. to the north is a small rental shop.
r2242.description:
You are at the end of one of the large docks.  A drop of about thirty feet
awaits the person unlucky enough to fall down into the water.  The dock heads
off to the southeast, where it turns east towards the main dock.  Looking to
the west you can see only water, stretching on for miles and miles.  To the
north is a small rental shop.

descKeys: with clever knots. the owner of this shop, sufesob, should be around somewhere.
r2243.description:
This small shop is situated on the end of a dock.  The shop is covered, but is
also open to the water on all sides.  There are many sailboats here, all tied
to the dock with clever knots.  The owner of this shop, Sufesob, should be
around somewhere.

descKeys: ther out on the bay to the northwest and also towards the main dock to the east.
r2244.description:
This part of the docks has been reserved for the largest ships that moor
here on a regular basis.  Large ships from distant Kalinport and even Threshold
are moored around this area.  The dock continues farther out on the Bay to the
northwest and also towards the main dock to the east.

descKeys: rew can start offloading all of the goods that are contained within their hulls.
r2245.description:
The dock takes a turn here, heading west towards the end of the dock and also
southeast towards the main dock.  Large ships have been moored here, tied up
until an unloading crew can start offloading all of the goods that are contained
within their hulls.

descKeys: like they have nothing better to do. a smaller dock leads south from this point.
r2246.description:
This is the end of a large dock.  To the west you can only see water and more
water, stretching as far as you can see.  Back to the east lies the rest of
Deepwater's docks.  In the water around you are schools of fish, swimming
around like they have nothing better to do.  A smaller dock leads south from
this point.

descKeys: ports and such. the southwest exit leads to the company's private docking area.
r2247.description:
You are in the Deepwater branch of the Kendrite Passages shipping company.
A large desk is in one corner, obviously used by an employee.  A few posters
are on the walls, showing distant ports and such.  The southwest exit
leads to the company's private docking area.

descKeys: sea. the company's private docks continue off to the east and also to the west.
r2248.description:
You think you can see land off in the distance.
The ship pulls up to the docks smoothly.
The ship docks and you make your way down the gangplank.
You disembark from the ship.
The ships of the Kendrite Passages shipping company are berthed here.  The
three-masted schooners are very seaworthy and capable of attaining high
speeds in the open sea.  The company's private docks continue off to the
east and also to the west.

descKeys: e docks continue off to the east and west. ships heading to kalinport dock here.

The traveller looks around.
This is where the trail stops if you are leaving the city, or begins if you
are entering the city.  You are standing before some huge gates, which block
the city from the desert.  To the south is the desert, and back to the
north is the city of Dunagin.

descKeys: outh while the gates lead into the city of dunagin. a sign has been posted here.
r2270.description:
You are standing just south of the city gates of Dunagin.  The gates are kept
closed at all times to protect the city from the wind.  As you glance to the
the south, you notice that the terrain gets increasingly arid.  You have heard
rumors that the citizens of Dunagin try to avoid travelling in the desert as
well as discourage others from traversing the barren wilderness.  The path
into the desert continues to the south while the gates lead into the city of
Dunagin.  A sign has been posted here.

descKeys: ns of wildlife in the area, as you can see some footprints of different animals.
r2271.description:
You are walking on a trail that goes through the forest on this continent.
This forest seems to be filled with many trees, which are very tall. There
are signs of wildlife in the area, as you can see some footprints of
different animals.

descKeys: ough the forest. these creatures have been known to just randomly attack people.
r2272.description:
You are walking on a long trail that goes through the forest on the continent
of Celtia.  This forest is sometimes a very dangerous place for people to
to travel alone, because of all the creatures that wander through the forest.
These creatures have been known to just randomly attack people.

descKeys: ollow the track. the dead trees make it possible for other plants to grow on it.
r2274.description:
You are standing on a small animal track, which twists west and east around the
trees in the forest.  East of here there is a high cliff face.  The trees and
bushes around you really seem to be old and very well preserved, this forest
could definitely be called a primeval forest.  There are some dead trees lying
around in the forest making it hard to follow the track.  The dead trees make
it possible for other plants to grow on it.

descKeys: es and a few small trees and spread across the territory are boulders and rocks.
r2275.description:
You are traveling on a track, which comes from the west and continues to a
cliff face where it comes to a stop.  The cliff could probably be climbed,
as the face offers many cracks to use as a grip.  The vegetation around you is
based on small bushes and a few small trees and spread across the territory are
boulders and rocks.

descKeys: ns of wildlife in the area, as you can see some footprints of different animals.

You are walking on a trail that goes through the forest on this continent.
This forest seems to be filled with many trees, which are very tall. There

descKeys: tall. the ground is covered in leaves that have fallen from the trees over time.
r2277.description:
You are standing on a trail in the forest.  This forest is very large and is
populated by lots of tall trees.  In fact you can barely see the sky because
the trees are so tall.  The ground is covered in leaves that have fallen from
the trees over time.

descKeys: think better of it. there are also many trees along the trail that you can see.
r2278.description:
As you look around you notice that the trail here is full of many types of
flowers.  These flowers seem very appealing to the eye, and you have a sudden
urge to pick them, but you think better of it.  There are also many trees
along the trail that you can see.

descKeys: ough the forest. these creatures have been known to just randomly attack people.

descKeys: seems to be covered by leaves and an occasional footprint from a forest animal.
r2280.description:
You are in a forest on the continent of Celtia.  This forest is a very big
place, in fact the trees are so large that you can barely see the sky above.
The ground here seems to be covered by leaves and an occasional footprint
from a forest animal.

descKeys: the huge gate to city northeast of here. you have heard that this city is huge!
r2281.description:
There seems to be a small gap in the trees here that allows you to see a huge
wall a little north of you.  This must be the wall protecting the city of
Carid.  You are able to see the huge gate to city northeast of here.  You have
heard that this city is huge!

descKeys: re excited to see for yourself. to the west the trail continues into the forest.
r2282.description:
To the north you can see some gates through the trees.  These must be the
gates that allow entrance to the city of Carid.  You've heard a lot of rumors
about how big Carid is so naturally you are excited to see for yourself.  To
the west the trail continues into the forest.

descKeys: into the forest to the south, ultimately taking you to the port city of dunagin.
r2283.description:
You are standing outside of some huge gates that obviously allow entrance to
the city of Carid.  These gates seem to be made out of some form of really
dark and hard wood.  Since the gates are always open, you can just head north
to go into Carid.  The trail heads deeper into the forest to the south,
ultimately taking you to the port city of Dunagin.

descKeys: e you are on the outskirts of the city the trees are still thick off the street.
r2284.description:
You are standing just inside the gates to the city of Carid.  These gates are
huge, and seem to be made out of some kind of dark wood.  Due to the volume
of people you can see on this street, you get the feeling that it is one of
the main streets in Carid.  The street is lined with bushes on the eastern
side and tall grass on the western side.  Since you are on the outskirts of
the city the trees are still thick off the street.

descKeys: e trees are thinning out a little, probably due to the construction of the city.
r2285.description:
You are on Carid Avenue, one of the main streets that goes through the city
of Carid.  To the south you can see the gates that allow entrance to the
city.  You think you also see some kind of tower off to the southeast, but
you cant be sure.  To the north it looks as if the trees are thinning out a
little, probably due to the construction of the city.

descKeys: f the street you can see a lot of tall grass with various tools discarded in it.
r2286.description:
In this part of town the trees have really thinned out, and are only sparsely
present.  You see signs of large number of people living here all over the
place.  Along the side of the street you can see a lot of tall grass with
various tools discarded in it.

descKeys: 've heard how big carid is, and you are excited to be exploring it for yourself.
r2287.description:
You are on Carid Avenue, one of the main roads that runs through the city of
Carid.  This road appears to run in an overall north-south direction.  To the
distant south you can see the dense gathering of trees that is  common for
this forest.  You've heard how big Carid is, and you are excited to be
exploring it for yourself.

descKeys: treet head off to the west, while carid avenue continues to the north and south.
r2288.description:
You are at the intersection of Carid Avenue and Fort Street.  This seems to
be a well-traveled part of town judging by the amount of people you see.
Fort Street head off to the west, while Carid Avenue continues to the north
and south.

descKeys: ut into creating this town, clearing the trees alone must have been a huge task.
r2289.description:
You are on Carid Avenue just north of what looks to be a fairly busy
intersection.  This street seems to traverse a general north-south direction
throughout the city of Carid.  You can tell that much work was put into
creating this town, clearing the trees alone must have been a huge task.

descKeys: that travel on this road. fort street travels in a general east-west direction.
r2290.description:
You are on Fort Street, just west of the intersection with Carid Avenue.
This street does not seem to be as big or busy as Carid Avenue, but you can
still tell there is a decent amount of people that travel on this road.  Fort
Street travels in a general east-west direction.

descKeys: st likely a lot of the trees were chopped down for the construction of the city.
r2291.description:
You are on a side street off of Carid Avenue which is called Fort Street.  In
this part of town you can see the sky a little better since there are not as
many trees obstructing your view.  Most likely a lot of the trees were
chopped down for the construction of the city.

descKeys: r ones in carid, but you can tell that it still sees its fair share of business.
r2292.description:
You are on a small street in the city of Carid called Fort Street.  This
street seems to run in in a general east-west direction.  There doesnt seem
to be as much traffic on this street as the bigger ones in Carid, but you can
tell that it still sees its fair share of business.

descKeys: ees seem to be a little smaller than the ones you remember seeing in the forest.
r2293.description:
This part of town seems to be a little less busy that when you were on Carid
Avenue.  Here you can see some of the few trees that were left during the

descKeys: the sewage is brought into the pool from the north, and drains off to the east.
r2373.description:
You are standing in a large room on the second level of the Kalinport
sewers.  The smell has become so bad at this point that you think that
you might see your lunch again.  Just to the east there is a large pool
of sewage.  The sewage is brought into the pool from the north, and
drains off to the east.

descKeys: st of here, passing over the stream of sewage that is flowing in from the north.
r2374.description:
You are in the northwest corner of a large room on the second level of
the Kalinport sewers.  There is a large pool of sewage in the center of
the room.  A bridge is just to the east of here, passing over the stream
of sewage that is flowing in from the north.

descKeys: st. a wind blows quickly past you and the sun's brightness is very overwhelming.
r2375.description:
As you look to the south, the terrain becomes increasingly arid, and the
ground beneath your feet slowly becomes more sandy.  You can hear some
howling in the distance.  Toward the northeast you can vaguely see the city
gates of Dunagin while the desert continues to the south and southwest.  A
wind blows quickly past you and the sun's brightness is very overwhelming.

descKeys: find information concerning how to get into the colosseum. above you is a sign.
r2376.description:
You are standing before a large gate that must lead into the colosseum.  All
around you are people who are either waiting to get in or loitering.  You
notice a booth near the gate where you could possibly find information
concerning how to get into the colosseum.  Above you is a sign.

descKeys: se the desert in your mind, but that does not seem to help make you feel better.
r2377.description:
As you walk along, the desert wind smacks your face with a huge forceful blow
of hot sand.  As you regain your composure, you have the strange feeling
that the blow was on purpose.  You curse the desert in your mind, but that does
not seem to help make you feel better.

descKeys: bites at your exposed skin, you begin to wonder if should head for some shelter.
r2378.description:
Toward the northeast you can vaguely discern the Dunagin and its gates.  The
desert seems to get warmer and more desolate as you look to the south.  As
the haunting desert wind bites at your exposed skin, you begin to wonder if
should head for some shelter.

descKeys: ghly lost and despite how hardy you think you are, you become easily frustrated.
r2379.description:
The wind gives you the feeling of a thousand knives piercing your body!
The piping hot sand burns the bottom of your feet!
A gust of wind suddenly knocks you to the sand.  As you remove yourself from
the desert floor, you realize that you do not know from what direction you
came to this area.  As you hate to admit it, but you are thoroughly lost and
despite how hardy you think you are, you become easily frustrated.

descKeys: y through the desert despite the danger of which the citizens of dunagin warned.
r2380.description:
The piping hot sand burns the bottom of your feet!
You come upon a corpse that has almost completely decayed.  No doubt that it
is the corpse of a long dead adventurer who risked his life to traverse the
desert.  You wonder what inspired the adventurer to journey through the
desert despite the danger of which the citizens of Dunagin warned.

descKeys: most as if you are being watched or even tested. but by whom or what is unknown.
r2382.description:
The wind gives you the feeling of a thousand knives piercing your body!
The piping hot sand burns the bottom of your feet!
The sand looks absolutely endless.  Unforunately for you, the wind seems to
blow sand over every track that you make.  Therefore returning along the same
path is virtually impossible.  It's almost as if you are being watched or
even tested.  But by whom or what is unknown.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.
r2387.description:
The Great Forest totally envelopes you, almost cutting you off from any sort
of view out of the trees.  The area gives you a sense of awe, gazing at the
surrounding greenery.  You are on a large road, about twenty feet in width,
that is used by the caravans running the north-south routes from Threshold
to Kalinport.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r2413.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

descKeys: tled lands to the north. you can see a large hole in the ground off to the east.

all around you, blocking your view somewhat.  Looking around, you do not
see a speck of vegetation, only the rolling sands as far as you can see.
You are on the main caravan route between Kalinport to the south and the
settled lands to the north.  You can see a large hole in the ground off to
the east.

descKeys: erence room below the pub. there are pictures on the wall, right behind the bar.
r2549.description:
Namssas takes a drag off a Namssas Cigar.
The Viper's Nest has been here in Threshold for a long time.  Some people say
that the pub was established by one of Threshold's earliest settlers.  It has
certainly gained enough fame and recognition around the area as serving the
finest and most varied drinks around.  A few tables are situated away from
the main bar, which runs along one wall.  A narrow set of stairs is near the
northern wall, going upwards to the pub's rentable rooms and also downwards to
a large conference room below the pub.  There are pictures on the wall, right
behind the bar.

descKeys: live around their sentient neighbors. you see that a large road is to the east.
r2550.description:
The trail winds its way around the trees in a seemingly unorderly fashion.
Here and there you spot some local wildlife, shying away from you.  Squirrels
and small deer are running rampant in these parts, trying to live around their
sentient neighbors.  You see that a large road is to the east.

descKeys: walking along this throughway calms you with its solitude and peaceful reverie.
r2551.description:
The trail narrows a bit here by about four or five feet on each side.  Tall
green trees line the road, with some having branches that hang almost down to
the walkway.  Walking along this throughway calms you with its solitude and
peaceful reverie.

descKeys: peering through the packed trees, you can sometimes spot a small animal or bird.
r2552.description:
The trees climb high into the sky, almost reaching the far-away sky it seems.
Small scrubs and bushes line the path, trying to eek out an existence from the
root-riddled soil.  Peering through the packed trees, you can sometimes spot
a small animal or bird.

descKeys: o not be used often, while the way to the west seems to head towards the plains.
r2553.description:
The forest path splits off here in three directions.  The western path is
littered with footprints, while the other two paths seem peaceful enough.
The path heading south looks to not be used often, while the way to the west
seems to head towards the plains.

descKeys: area are quite large, and very green. the path itself is made from packed dirt.
r2554.description:
You are on a small path that winds through a small forest.  The path seems to
widen out to the northwest and also to the east, but gets smaller to the south.
The trees in this area are quite large, and very green.  The path itself
is made from packed dirt.

descKeys: t used that often, so you might want to watch your step in going that direction.
r2555.description:
The path takes a sharp turn here, heading south where the trees open up, and
also east towards an area containing larger trees.  The southern path looks
like it is not used that often, so you might want to watch your step in going
that direction.

descKeys: e and are very green. the trail is made out of packed dirt, and looks well-used.
r2556.description:
You are on a small trail that is leading north, where it hits a larger trail,
and west where it continues on through the forest.  The trees that line the
trail are fairly large and are very green.  The trail is made out of packed
dirt, and looks well-used.

descKeys: ight, and by looking west you can see that the trail turns slightly to the left.
r2557.description:
The trail is running east and west, heading through the forest.  The trail is
only about three feet wide, and some places are harder to navigate than others.
Off to the east the trail turns to the right, and by looking west you can see
that the trail turns slightly to the left.

descKeys: thirty feet long, however. the other trees in this area look green and healthy.
r2558.description:
The trail curves slightly here, heading both east and also southwest.  A large
tree is lying on its side close to the path, evidently dead a long time.  It
has to be about thirty feet long, however.  The other trees in this area look
green and healthy.

descKeys: nd looks to not be natural. the trail, however, continues back to the northeast.
r2559.description:
The trail looks to end to the south at this point, heading into a large
clearing that is in the forest.  The clearing is about forty feet in diameter,
and looks to not be natural.  The trail, however, continues back to the
northeast.

descKeys: life. looking to the north, you can see a small town. a tree is in front of you.
a tree is in front of you. the moon is somewhere between eye and contemplation.
r2560.description:
This area of the swamp looks somewhat like a small and marshy lake.  The bog
is filled with sounds, mainly from the wildlife who frequent this area.
If you are still, maybe you can spot some of this wandering wildlife.
Looking to the north, you can see a small town. A tree is in front of you.

descKeys: ts of plants growing in and around it. you can head east or west along the path.
r2561.description:
You continue to venture through the depths of the thick swamp.  There are
lots of trees and other types of underbrush that have been living and growing
within the realm of the swamp for quite a long time.  South of the path,
there is a small lake.  The bank of the lake is about ten or fifteen feet
south of you, and there are lots of plants growing in and around it.  You can
head east or west along the path.

descKeys: lake is covered with small webbed footprints. there is a small dock to the west.
r2562.description:
You have stumbled across a small lake, situated in the middle of a huge and
desolate swamp.  The lake extends to the southwest for a long ways, with you
not being able to spot the far shore.  The shore of the lake is covered with
small webbed footprints.  There is a small dock to the west.

descKeys: u cannot even see the bottom. however it looks like you could 'enter' the water.
r2563.description:
You are standing on a very small dock that is situated on Lena Lake.  The
lake itself is not terribly large, but stretches out a good ways to the west
and southwest.  Back to the east is dry land, smack dab in the middle of
a huge swamp.  The water of Lena Lake is not clear, as you cannot even see
the bottom.  However it looks like you could 'enter' the water.

descKeys: lake is covered with small webbed footprints. there is a small dock to the west.
r2564.description:
You have stumbled across a small lake, situated in the middle of a huge and
desolate swamp.  The lake extends to the southwest for a long ways, with you
not being able to spot the far shore.  The shore of the lake is covered with
small webbed footprints.  There is a small dock to the west.

descKeys: cross the northern continent. the path winds around a bit, making you a tad ill.
r2565.description:
The region of Kal-Thax stretches out before you to the north, with the dwarven
stronghold being a prominent fixture on the landscape. To the east you see that
the Absinthe Mountains continue on their trek across the northern continent.
The path winds around a bit, making you a tad ill.

descKeys: mall ledge that looks incomplete. there must have been some sort of a rockslide.
r2566.description:
The path is very rocky here, and is in badly need of repair.  The trail is
almost at an impass, as you can barely walk over the sharp rocks.  Looking
up the side of the mountain, you can see a small ledge that looks incomplete.
There must have been some sort of a rockslide.

descKeys: looking at the small grove, a small fox bursts out of hiding and skitters away.

path leading east towards the mountains.name: path leading east towards the mountains

r2567.description:
A large collection of green fir trees is right off the path, catching your eye
as you are strolling past.  They look out of place among these small scrubs
and bushes that line the path.  As you are looking at the small grove, a small
fox bursts out of hiding and skitters away.

descKeys: you, sending a slight shiver down your spine, effectively giving you the chills.
r2568.description:
The path winds around several large boulders, weaving in and out between them.
The boulders are rounded with age, and have vegetation growing on their rocky
surfaces.  A brisk wind almost rips through you, sending a slight shiver down
your spine, effectively giving you the chills.

descKeys: eight! you can also see a small stable that is on the western side of the trail.
r2569.description:
You are standing just south of the dwarven stronghold.  The stronghold has
been the centerpoint of Kal-Thax ever since it was settled those many centuries
past.  The gates of the stronghold rise approximately thirty feet in the air,
with the wall surrounding the fortress being over fifty feet in height!
You can also see a small stable that is on the western side of the trail.

descKeys: o and from the dwarven stronghold. there is a small sign here that you can read.
r2570.description:
You are standing in a covered area just east of the stables.  This area is
used by Stronghold merchants to prepare their Caravans for the long journey
to the other regions.  A large tent-like material has been stretched
overhead, keeping any rain out of the area.  To the east you can see the
trail that leads to and from the Dwarven Stronghold.  There is a small sign
here that you can read.

descKeys: a, used for preparing caravans for transport. there is a small sign on one wall.
r2571.description:
You are standing in a large stable, owned by the Stronghold Merchant's Guild.
Many stalls full of ponies are here, each one filled with two or three of
the beasts.  North and northeast of you is the Dwarven Stronghold.  Directly
east of here is an open area, used for preparing caravans for transport.
There is a small sign on one wall.

descKeys: to the north through the large gates, and a small mountain path is to the south.
r2572.description:
You are standing between two huge stone gates.  At the moment, the gates are
in an open position, or else you would never be able to enter the dwarves'
well-fortified stronghold.  The dwarven stronghold is to the north through the
large gates, and a small mountain path is to the south.

descKeys: urface is made out of some hard material most likely made with rocks and mortar.
r2573.description:
Stone Street, which circles most of the stronghold, intersects with the main
throughway of the stronghold.  The throughway leads north into the market
area, and south towards the front gates of the fortress.  The street's surface
is made out of some hard material most likely made with rocks and mortar.

descKeys: eserved for the lower-income families, as evident by the building's small sizes.
r2574.description:
Stone Street is running east and southwest here, to the stronghold's through-
way and farther into the residential districts respectively.  The small housing
district around these parts is probably reserved for the lower-income families,
as evident by the building's small sizes.

descKeys: south lies one of the huge walls which protect the stronghold from any invasion.
r2575.description:
You are walking through a residential neighborhood in the dwarven stronghold.
Stone Street runs itself through most of the districts, be it housing or
business districts.  Just to your south lies one of the huge walls which
protect the stronghold from any invasion.

descKeys: d are made out of a hard stone-like mixture. a blacksmith's shop is to the east.
r2576.description:
Stone Street runs through a small residential district here, passing through
dimunitive houses and complexes.  The dwarves' homes tend to be squat and also
unardorned.  They are about seven to eight feet tall and are made out of a
hard stone-like mixture.  A blacksmith's shop is to the east.

descKeys: northern wall. various tools of the trade are around here, carefully cared for.
r2577.description:
You are in a blacksmith's shop.  The shop has been around a while, as Dwarves
tend to like working with metal.  An anvil is near the center of the shop,
and a forge is close by the northern wall.  Various tools of the trade are
around here, carefully cared for.

descKeys: est, while a shop you can buy and sell items appears to be toward the northeast.
r2578.description:
There are several stone buildings lining either side of the roadway.  It seems
that this part of the stronghold has been constructed with the mercantile
trading system in mind.  The main market square of the Stronghold appears to be
north of here.  You notice a smithy toward the northwest, while a shop you can
buy and sell items appears to be toward the northeast.

descKeys: egular good's shop can be seen to the east. a hall of sorts is to the southeast.
r2579.description:
This is the market square of the dwarven stronghold in Kal-Thax.  Large and
small shops are all around this area, each offering their own fine selections
of quality goods.  A small armory is to the west, and a regular good's shop
can be seen to the east.  A hall of sorts is to the southeast.

descKeys: ion to their advantage, setting up stands to hawk their many wares and services.
r2580.description:
The throughway and Stone Street intersect here, forming a busy crossroads.
Several vendors have used the presence of the large crowds of people going
through this intersection to their advantage, setting up stands to hawk their
many wares and services.

descKeys: n mines can be seen in the northern distance. there is a small shop to the west.
r2581.description:
The throughway's width narrows a bit here, shortening to about ten feet at its
widest.  A few scattered buildings line the road, looking quite unattractive
and unadorned.  The intersection of the throughway and Stone Street is to the
south, while the dwarven mines can be seen in the northern distance.  There
is a small shop to the west.

descKeys: the market square. there is not much traffic around this part of the stronghold.
r2582.description:
You are standing about thirty feet from the entrance to the dwarven mines,
which is to the north from here.  The throughway runs right up to the mines
and also runs south through the market square.  There is not much traffic
around this part of the stronghold.

descKeys: own there, as well as their entire horde of treasure, or so it has been rumored.
r2583.description:
You have reached the entrance to the mines underneath the stronghold. Entrance
to the mines is strictly regulated by the stronghold's guards, as there are
many untold secrets of the dwarves down there, as well as their entire horde
of treasure, or so it has been rumored.

descKeys: owards the mountain. off to the east you can also see a small compound of sorts.
r2584.description:
You are on a small path that is winding through the lower hills of Mt Kulajo.
You can either head west where the path runs into a much larger path that leads
south and northeast or towards the east where this small path heads towards
the mountain.  Off to the east you can also see a small compound of sorts.

descKeys: and small trees, and those seem to thin out the closer you get to the mountain.
r2585.description:
The small path is heading east and west here, running through the lower hills
of Mt. Kulajo.  The path is about three feet wide and looks to be little-
used.  Off the path is a collection of large bushes and small trees, and those
seem to thin out the closer you get to the mountain.

descKeys: aining altitude to the southeast, while it seems to slope downwards to the west.
r2586.description:
The small path makes a slight turn here, heading to the west and also off to
the southeast, where it curves again.  Directly to the east is a large grove
of trees, which seems to be the reason for the path making the turn.  It seems
as if the path is gaining altitude to the southeast, while it seems to slope
downwards to the west.

descKeys: t where it leaves the grove. a small compound of sorts is also to the northeast.
r2587.description:
You are on a small path that meanders through the hills in front of a large
mountain.  On either side of the path lies a large grove of trees.  The trees
are close together and it looks like someone purposefully planted them.  The
path leads to the northeast and northwest where it leaves the grove.  A small
compound of sorts is also to the northeast.

descKeys: at is there. the small path you are on leads southwest through a grove of trees.
r2588.description:
You are standing in front of a small compound which looks like some sort of
monastery.  An archway leads east into the compound's garden area.  Past that
you cannot discern what is there.  The small path you are on leads southwest
through a grove of trees.

descKeys: her section of the garden. large rose bushes and sunflower plants line the path.
r2589.description:
You head to the other section of the garden.
The small garden you are standing in looks to be well-tended by someone who
knows what they are doing.  A little path runs through the garden going west
towards a large archway that presumably leads out of the monastery, and also
east where it runs through another section of the garden.  Large rose bushes
and sunflower plants line the path.

descKeys: small path leads to the southeast, towards what looks like the living quarters.
r2590.description:
You travel east, heading to the other section of the garden.
The small path is wandering its way through a garden near the entrance of the
monastery.  The garden is full of rose bushes, sunflower plants, tomato plants,
and corn stalks.  Off to the east is a large hall, built a long time ago and
is capable of holding many monks in prayer.  Another small path leads to the
southeast, towards what looks like the living quarters.

descKeys: semi-circle. near the northern wall is a raised dais with a single mat atop it.
r2591.description:
You head into the main prayer hall.
You are in a large hall which serves as the center of the Aber teachings.
Each of the four walls is lined with medium-sized marble statues.  The statues
are of various creatures, most of them normal wildlife.  Foxes, squirrels,
bears, wolves, and yetis are all represented.  Small yellow mats are on the
ground, layed out in a semi-circle.  Near the northern wall is a raised dais
with a single mat atop it.

descKeys: g quite forlorn. it looks like the caravan route runs north and south from here.
r2592.description:
The Plains of Nereka have been watched over by the Knights of Nereka for
several centuries.  Looking far to the west, you can actually spot the
famous Castle Brightsword, the main headquarters of the Knights.  A scraggly
bush is right in front of you, looking quite forlorn.  It looks like the
Caravan Route runs north and south from here.

descKeys: dusty ground. the road you are on, the caravan route, continues north and south.
re but is having a difficult time of gathering nutrients from this dusty ground.
r2593.description:
The Plains seemingly run on forever, stretching out in every direction around
you.  Far off to the north you think you can spot where the Plains of Nereka
end and a vast body of water starts.  A small tree is trying to grow here but
is having a difficult time of gathering nutrients from this dusty ground.

descKeys: same season. the plains stretch in all directions around you, seemingly endless.
r2595.description:
A small collection of bushes is right in front of you, looking out of place
on the vast plains.  It seems that the bushes' seeds landed here during a
heavy rainstorm and took root, sprouting up later in that same season.  The
plains stretch in all directions around you, seemingly endless.

descKeys: to the north, and to the south the plains stretch out as far as the eye can see.
r2597.description:
You are standing at the base of, what seems like, a fairly long trail.  The
path itself is nothing more than dry dirt.  Along the sides of the path grows
long, green grass.  The path continues to the north, and to the south the
plains stretch out as far as the eye can see.

descKeys: tice some very large footprints. far to the northeast is a large mountain range.
r2598.description:
You are walking on a simple dirt path.  Along the sides of the path green
grass grows.  Up the path to the north you can see hills on the horizon.
As you are looking at the path you notice some very large footprints.  Far
to the northeast is a large mountain range.

descKeys: some large footprints. the path turns northeast and also continues to the south.
r2599.description:
The path is starting to take its toll on your feet.  The path consists of
nothing more than dry, packed dirt.  The grass, which is growing on the side
of the path, is getting less dense as you move away from the plains.  On the
path are some large footprints.  The path turns northeast and also continues
to the south.

descKeys: e path. you begin to wonder why you are still walking along such a tedious path.
r2600.description:
The terrain is becoming quite hilly here.  The path is curently leading
northeast between two large hills.  There is barely any grass growng along
the sides of the path.  You begin to wonder why you are still walking along
such a tedious path.

descKeys: an make out the entrance of a cave. there are some large footprints in the path.
r2601.description:
You are standing on a path between two large hills.  The path is nothing
more than dry dirt.  To the north you can make out the entrance of a cave.
There are some large footprints in the path.

descKeys: in the side of the hill. a trail of large footprints leads off to the northwest.
r2602.description:
You have reached what appears to be a fork in the path.  To the northwest
the path continues on into the hills, and to the north you can see a large
cave in the side of the hill.  A trail of large footprints leads off to the
northwest.

descKeys: awk flying high overhead lets out a shrill scream, causing you to jump slightly.
r2603.description:
The path is heading northwest and southwest, winding its way throughout the
hilly area.  The green grass growing right off the path is getting quite
sparse.  A lone hawk flying high overhead lets out a shrill scream, causing
you to jump slightly.

descKeys: just off the path. looking around, you do not readily see any other such trees.
r2604.description:
The path turns here, heading north towards a dead-end and also southeast,
going through the hills.  A small green tree is trying to eek out its meager
existance to your right, just off the path.  Looking around, you do not
readily see any other such trees.

descKeys: ng been picked clean from someone or something. the path continues to the south.
r2605.description:
You are at a dead-end on the small dirt path.  Looking around, you can spot
several piles of bones laying around, bleached from exposure to the sun.  A
large skeleton of a cattle-like creature is to your right, having been
picked clean from someone or something.  The path continues to the south.

descKeys: a huge and imposing castle, bristling with activity from the knights of nereka.
r2607.description:
You are standing in the Plains of Nereka.  The Plains stretch on for miles
with nary a tree or bush to be found, except near the bordering regions.
A ways to the west you can see a huge and imposing castle, bristling with
activity from the Knights of Nereka.

descKeys: used by the caravans running the north-south routes from threshold to kalinport.

r2626.description:
You are standing on a small path that runs east and west through the Viluten
Mountains.  To the east you can see a large road, probably the well-used
Caravan Route that leads up the eastern coast of the continent.  A small
ledge is on one of the mountainside's nearest you.

descKeys: own, you see a few footprints on the small path that look quite recently placed.
r2627.description:
The path is running through two large cliff faces here, towering above you.
To the east a ways you can barely see a larger road that leads north and
south.  Looking down, you see a few footprints on the small path that look
quite recently placed.

descKeys: n. a large pine tree is right off the path, standing about fifty feet in height.
r2628.description:
The path comes to the end/beginning of two large cliffs, each flanking the
route, towering over you.  Heading east will cause you to pass between the
two cliffs, while the area south of here is a bit more open.  A large pine
tree is right off the path, standing about fifty feet in height.

descKeys: your position. the path also heads north from here, going through a large pass.
r2629.description:
The Knight paces around, staring at the cliff.
You seem to be wandering around in the Viluten Mountains, travelling upon
a small dirt path that winds around.  Looking to the west, you can see that
the path ends up against a cliff, about fifty feet from your position.  The
path also heads north from here, going through a large pass.

descKeys: ou can see that the path curves a bit to the left, heading through a large pass.
r2630.description:
The path runs up to a large cliff face to the west and just stops suddenly.
It seems that whoever made this path perhaps climbed the rock, but you cannot
see anything up there.  Looking back to the east, you can see that the path
curves a bit to the left, heading through a large pass.

descKeys: orest. to the south, you can see some mountains standing high against the trees.
r2631.description:
You have just entered a trail that seems to run deep into the forest.  You
cannot see off in the distance, because there are many trees in this part of
the forest.  To the south, you can see some mountains standing high against
the trees.

r2646.description:
You are in the local shop, the Threshold Supply Depot.  The local merchant
who runs this small shop has been here for some fifty years and is in no
hurry of retirement.  Many shelves full of various items line the walls.
An exit leads south where it hits Frontiers Street.

descKeys: small holes like his dot the plains, home to thousands of such varied varmints.
r2648.description:
A slight breeze is blowing around you, stirring up some dust, partially
obscurring your vision.  A small prairie dog pokes his head out of an
almost hidden hole, stares at you for a second, then pops back down into
the hole.  Small holes like his dot the plains, home to thousands of such
varied varmints.

Dulaj Road is running through the Plains of Nereka, going from the city of
Deepwater to about the middle of the Plains.  The road was constructed many

r2685.description:
You are in the Church of Kertaine.  This large cathedral was constructed only
a few short years ago.  The elders of the Church decided to move the main
worship center to a larger city.  Moving from Threshold to here was not easy,
but they made it through it.  Speaking of Threshold, the house of worship
is still there, although it is not used quite so frequently any more.  The
main part of the cathedral is to the west.

This large stable is used when travellers come to Deepwater and are in need
of lodging for their mounts.  People can also rent mounts here, as long as
the Stablehand is nearby.  The stable continues to the south.  One of the main
streets of Deepwater is to the north.

descKeys: you can see the famous dulaj road. there is a small sign here that you can read.
r2687.description:
You are standing in a covered area just south of the stables.  This area is
used by Deepwater merchants to prepare their Caravans for the long journey
to the other regions.  A large tent-like material has been stretched
overhead, keeping any rain out of the area.  To the south you can see the
famous Dulaj Road.  There is a small sign here that you can read.

descKeys: re in this area, penned in large stalls. the rest of the stable is to the north.
r2688.description:
You are in the southern end of the Deepwater Stables.  These stables have
been around for some time, as they are popular with travellers.  A few of
the larger horses are in this area, penned in large stalls.  The rest of the
stable is to the north.

descKeys: y having two or three guards stationed within. a smithy is now open to the east.
r2689.description:
You are standing on Commerce Way, which runs north and south throughout the
merchant section of Deepwater.  The road is usally well-traveled, with people
heading to and from the merchants' area.  To the south is a small guardhouse,
usually having two or three guards stationed within.  A smithy is now open
to the east.

descKeys: hat leads to the east is hanging open. commerce way is out the door to the west.
r2690.description:
You are in a newly-built blacksmith's shop.  A large anvil is in one corner
of the room, and an even larger forge is right in the middle.  A cooling
trench is near the forge as well.  A small door that leads to the east is
hanging open.  Commerce Way is out the door to the west.

descKeys: thing to buy. a well-used shop is to east, while a new bank is open to the west.
r2691.description:
You are currently in the merchant section of Deepwater, located near the south-
eastern portion of town.  Shops and other establishments line the road on
either side.  Several small groups of people are gathered in and around these
shops, looking for something to buy.  A well-used shop is to east, while a
new bank is open to the west.

descKeys: . an exit to the west leads to other parts of the merchant section of deepwater.
r2692.description:
You are standing in the main general store of Deepwater.  The owner of this
establishment buys and sells all sorts of items, from the mundane to the
exotic.  Many shelves cover the walls filled with all sorts of different items.
An exit to the west leads to other parts of the merchant section of Deepwater.

Nereka.  The road is about twenty feet wide and is quite dusty.  The plains
run in all directions from this point, stretching for miles.  Off to the north
and east you can see the Absinthe Mountain Range.

descKeys: a huge and imposing castle, bristling with activity from the knights of nereka.
r2719.description:
You are standing in the Plains of Nereka.  The Plains stretch on for miles
with nary a tree or bush to be found, except near the bordering regions.
A ways to the west you can see a huge and imposing castle, bristling with
activity from the Knights of Nereka.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r2721.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
the lush green forests to the north.  Judging from the rounded peaks and
mountain sides, the Vilutens are extremely ancient, having been around long
before any civilized race existed on the continent.  You are presently in a
deep ravine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through
the Vilutens.

descKeys: ine, used by the caravans from the north and south to pass through the vilutens.
r2722.description:
The Viluten Mountains separate the harsh Kalamshite desert to the south and
